senses.meaning: 查问，考虑；（口语，表示怀疑或阻止）等等看，走着瞧
senses.example_en: He thinks he can take my job, but we'll see about that!
senses.example_zh: 他以为能抢走我的饭碗，咱们走着瞧！

senses.meaning: 送（客人）到大门口，送客出门
senses.example_en: There's no need to see me out; I know the way to the front door.
senses.example_zh: 不必送我出门了，我认得去大门的路。

senses.meaning: 熬过，度过（特定时期）；够用至…结束
senses.example_en: The elderly man was not expected to see out the harsh winter.
senses.example_zh: 那位老人原本被认为很难熬过这个严冬。

senses.example_en: She decided to stay with the company to see out her contract.
senses.example_zh: 她决定继续留在公司，直到履行完合同期。

senses.example_en: The receptionist will see the new client in as soon as the meeting room is ready.
senses.example_zh: 会议室一准备好，前台接待员就会领新客户进来。

senses.meaning: 迎接，庆祝（新年、新纪元等）的到来
senses.example_en: Thousands gathered in the square to see in the New Year with fireworks.
senses.example_zh: 数千人聚集在广场上，以烟花迎接新年的到来。

senses.meaning: 参观，游览，察看（建筑或景点）
senses.example_en: The estate agent took us to see around the newly renovated apartment.
senses.example_zh: 房产中介带我们参观了那套刚翻修过的公寓。

senses.meaning: 仔细视察，巡视，逐个察看（房屋、地产）
senses.example_en: We arranged an appointment to see over the house before making an offer.
senses.example_zh: 在出价之前，我们预约去仔细察看了一番那栋房子。

senses.meaning: 调查，探察…的真相或内部情况
senses.example_en: The committee promised to see into the allegations of financial misconduct.
senses.example_zh: 委员会承诺将深入调查有关财务不端行为的指控。

senses.meaning: 洞察，看穿（某人的内心或本质）
senses.example_en: A perceptive mentor can see into a student's hidden potential.
senses.example_zh: 一位富有洞察力的导师能看清学生身上隐藏的潜能。

senses.meaning: 护送…穿过（马路、河流等危险地带）
senses.example_en: The crossing guard saw the schoolchildren safely across the busy avenue.
senses.example_zh: 交通协管员护送小学生们安全穿过了繁忙的大街。

senses.example_en: It is quite late, so I will see you back to your hotel.
senses.example_zh: 时间不早了，我送你回酒店吧。

senses.example_en: He offered to see her home after the party ended past midnight.
senses.example_zh: 聚会过午夜结束后，他主动提出护送她回家。

senses.meaning: 送（某人）下楼；护送离开楼上区域
senses.example_en: My assistant will see you down to the lobby and call a taxi for you.
senses.example_zh: 我的助理会送你下楼到大厅，并为你叫一辆出租车。

senses.meaning: 押送/驱逐出场，将…驱离场地
senses.example_en: Security guards quickly intervened and saw the disorderly patron off the premises.
senses.example_zh: 安保人员迅速介入，将那名扰乱秩序的顾客驱离了现场。

idioms.meaning: 意见一致，看法相同
idioms.example_en: Although they are business partners, they rarely see eye to eye on long-term strategy.
idioms.example_zh: 他们虽然是商业合伙人，但在长期战略上却极少达成共识。

idioms.meaning: 勃然大怒，火冒三丈
idioms.example_en: Whenever he hears people belittling his family's sacrifices, he sees red.
idioms.example_zh: 每当听到有人贬低他家庭做出的牺牲，他就会火冒三丈。

idioms.meaning: 恍然大悟，改邪归正；问世，公之于众
idioms.example_en: After years of making poor financial bets, he finally saw the light and began saving regularly.
idioms.example_zh: 在经历了多年的糟糕金融投机之后，他终于幡然醒悟，开始定期存钱。

idioms.meaning: 认为合适，自以为妥当
idioms.example_en: The editor saw fit to delete the most controversial paragraphs without consulting the author.
idioms.example_zh: 编辑在未征询作者意见的情况下，自行决定删除了最具争议的段落。

idioms.phrase: as far as the eye can see
idioms.meaning: 一望无际，极目所致
idioms.example_en: In the desert, shimmering golden dunes stretch out as far as the eye can see.
idioms.example_zh: 在沙漠中，金色的沙丘泛着波光，一望无际地延展向天边。

idioms.phrase: see sth coming a mile off
idioms.meaning: 早就看出来，料事如神，早就预见到
idioms.example_en: Their messy breakup was no surprise to anyone; our friends saw it coming a mile off.
idioms.example_zh: 他们难看的收场让大家都不感到意外，朋友们早就预见到了这一天。

idioms.meaning: 风光不再，破败衰落
idioms.example_en: This antique leather armchair has certainly seen better days, but it is still remarkably comfortable.
idioms.example_zh: 这把老式真皮扶手椅确实风光不再、略显破旧，但坐起来依然非常舒适。

idioms.meaning: 静观其变，拭目以待
idioms.example_en: We cannot predict how the market will respond to the interest rate hike; we will just have to wait and see.
idioms.example_zh: 我们无法预测市场会对加息做出何种反应，我们只能拭目以待、静观其变。

collocations.meaning: 明白意义所在，领会意图
collocations.example_en: I understand your technical explanation, but I still fail to see the point of changing the entire interface.
collocations.example_zh: 我听懂了你的技术解释，但我仍然没看出来彻底更换界面的意义何在。

collocations.meaning: 明白事理，接受劝告，服理
collocations.example_en: We argued with him for two hours before he finally saw reason and agreed to compromise.
collocations.example_zh: 我们劝了他两个小时，他才终于听劝并同意做出妥协。

collocations.example_en: If that persistent chest cough does not clear up by Friday, you must go see a doctor.
collocations.example_zh: 如果那顽固的咳嗽到周五还没好，你必须去医院看医生。

collocations.meaning: 看出幽默风趣之处，苦中作乐
collocations.example_en: Even when the tent collapsed during the rainstorm, Sarah managed to see the funny side of the disaster.
collocations.example_zh: 即便暴风雨中帐篷被吹塌了，萨拉依然能从中找到风趣可乐的一面。

collocations.example_en: The manager saw no harm in letting the team work from home on Friday afternoons.
collocations.example_zh: 经理觉得周五下午让团队在家办公无伤大雅。

collocations.example_en: Her grandfather saw active service as a navy officer in the Mediterranean during the war.
collocations.example_zh: 她祖父在战争期间作为海军军官在地中海服过现役并参加了战斗。

collocations.example_en: The hospital saw a marked improvement in patient recovery times following the procedural overhaul.
collocations.example_zh: 在该流程全面改革之后，医院见证了患者康复时间的显著缩短。

senses.example_en: She works out at the local gym three times a week.
senses.example_zh: 她每周在当地健身房锻炼三次。

senses.example_en: We need to work out the total cost before booking the venue.
senses.example_zh: 在预订场地之前，我们需要把总费用算出来。

senses.example_en: Don't worry too much; everything will work out in the end.
senses.example_zh: 别太担心，一切最终都会好起来的。

senses.meaning: 致力于，从事于（某项目或技能）
senses.example_en: He is currently working on his second novel.
senses.example_zh: 他目前正在创作他的第二部小说。

senses.example_en: I haven't convinced my dad yet, but I'm working on him.
senses.example_zh: 我还没说服我爸，但我正在努力做他的工作。

senses.meaning: 激起，唤起（食欲、情绪、热情等）
senses.example_en: A long walk in the countryside always helps me work up an appetite.
senses.example_zh: 在乡间漫步一番总能让我胃口大开。

senses.example_en: She started as an intern and worked up a successful career in publishing.
senses.example_zh: 她从实习生做起，逐步在出版界开创了成功的事业。

senses.meaning: 克服，理清（负面情绪、心理创伤或复杂困难）
senses.example_en: Therapy helped her work through her childhood grief.
senses.example_zh: 心理咨询帮助她走出了童年的悲伤阴影。

senses.meaning: 逐步完成，耐心地处理（清单或任务）
senses.example_en: It took us the entire afternoon to work through the pile of documents.
senses.example_zh: 我们花了一下午才逐一处理完这叠文件。

senses.meaning: 通过体力运动消除，发泄（压力、热量或怒气）
senses.example_en: Going for a run is the best way for him to work off stress.
senses.example_zh: 对他来说，跑步是排解压力的最佳方式。

senses.meaning: 以工代偿，用工作偿还（债务）
senses.example_en: He offered to paint the house to work off his debt.
senses.example_zh: 他主动提出粉刷房屋来抵清欠款。

senses.meaning: 抽时间把……安排进（紧凑日程）
senses.example_en: The dentist is very busy, but she can work you in at four o'clock.
senses.example_zh: 牙医日程很满，但她可以在四点钟抽空见你。

senses.meaning: 巧妙地融入，添加（想法、食材或细节）
senses.example_en: Try to work some humor into your opening remarks.
senses.example_zh: 尽量在你的开场白中融入一点幽默。

senses.meaning: 为……而努力，争取实现（目标）
senses.example_en: Both nations are actively working towards a lasting peace agreement.
senses.example_zh: 两国都在积极努力达成一项持久的和平协议。

senses.meaning: 避开，绕过（困难、限制或障碍）
senses.example_en: The software bug was serious, but the engineering team found a way to work around it.
senses.example_zh: 这个软件故障很严重，但工程团队找到了绕过它的解决办法。

senses.meaning: 逐渐增加到，逐步上升到（某一水平）
senses.example_en: Start by jogging ten minutes a day and gradually work up to an hour.
senses.example_zh: 从每天慢跑十分钟开始，逐步增加到一个小时。

senses.example_en: It took him weeks to work up to asking for a promotion.
senses.example_zh: 他做了几个星期的心理建设才鼓起勇气要求升职。

senses.example_en: Gently work the moisturizer into your skin until fully absorbed.
senses.example_zh: 将保湿霜轻轻揉进皮肤，直至完全吸收。

senses.meaning: 使（某人/自己）陷入（某种情绪或精神状态）
senses.example_en: He had worked himself into a state of panic before the exam.
senses.example_zh: 考试前他就已经把自己搞得恐慌不已。

senses.example_en: She sat quietly in the corner, working away at her laptop.
senses.example_zh: 她静静地坐在角落里，在笔记本电脑前埋头苦干。

senses.meaning: 重新仔细修改，彻底翻修
senses.example_en: The editor gave the manuscript a thorough working over.
senses.example_zh: 编辑对这份书稿进行了彻底的修改打磨。

senses.example_en: The thugs worked him over in a back alley.
senses.example_zh: 那帮暴徒在后巷狠狠揍了他一顿。

senses.meaning: 努力改善，致力于提升（技能或关系）
senses.example_en: A successful marriage requires both partners to work at it every day.
senses.example_zh: 一段美满的婚姻需要双方日复一日地共同努力经营。

senses.example_en: His lack of managerial experience might work against him in the interview.
senses.example_zh: 缺乏管理经验可能会在面试中对他产生不利影响。

senses.example_en: I really enjoy working with such a talented group of designers.
senses.example_zh: 我非常享受与这样一群才华横溢的设计师一起工作。

senses.meaning: 善用，妥善处理（现有条件、限制或材料）
senses.example_en: We don't have a huge budget, so we must work with what we have.
senses.example_zh: 我们预算不多，所以必须就地取材、因陋就简。

senses.meaning: 逆向推导，从结果反向追溯
senses.example_en: To set the project timeline, start from the final deadline and work back.
senses.example_zh: 要设定项目时间表，应从最终截止日期开始倒推规划。

idioms.meaning: 创造奇迹；产生极佳效果
idioms.example_en: A cup of warm chamomile tea can work wonders when you are struggling with insomnia.
idioms.example_zh: 当你饱受失眠困扰时，一杯温热的洋甘菊茶能产生奇效。

idioms.meaning: 极其奏效；万试万灵
idioms.example_en: I applied his troubleshooting trick to my laptop, and it worked like a charm.
idioms.example_zh: 我把他排查故障的小窍门用在笔记本上，立刻灵验奏效了。

idioms.meaning: 面临艰巨任务；有硬仗要打
idioms.example_en: With a deadline only two days away, the audit team will certainly have their work cut out.
idioms.example_zh: 距离截止日期仅剩两天，审计团队肯定面临极其繁重的任务。

idioms.meaning: 日常工作的一部分；家常便饭
idioms.example_en: Rescuing frightened cats from tall trees is all in a day's work for local firefighters.
idioms.example_zh: 从高树上营救受惊的猫咪对于当地消防员来说只是家常便饭。

idioms.phrase: work one's fingers to the bone
idioms.meaning: 拼命苦干；辛劳累断筋骨
idioms.example_en: She worked her fingers to the bone for decades to send all her three children to college.
idioms.example_zh: 几十年来她辛劳苦干，终于供三个孩子全都念完了大学。

idioms.meaning: 极其勤勉地拼命工作
idioms.example_en: He worked like a dog for months to ensure the startup's successful initial public offering.
idioms.example_zh: 他拼命苦干了数月，确保了这家初创公司成功首次公开募股。

collocations.example_en: Employees were offered extra bonuses if they agreed to work overtime during the holiday season.
collocations.example_zh: 员工如果同意在节假日期间加班，将获得额外的奖金。

collocations.example_en: The modern tech firm allows its software engineers to work remotely from anywhere in the world.
collocations.example_zh: 这家现代科技公司允许其软件工程师在世界任何地方远程办公。

collocations.example_en: The hiring manager emphasized that the ideal candidate must be capable of working under extreme pressure.
collocations.example_zh: 招聘经理强调，理想的候选人必须能够在极端压力下胜任工作。

collocations.meaning: 把...投入使用；使...发挥效益
collocations.example_en: He decided to put his savings to work by investing in diversified index funds.
collocations.example_zh: 他决定投资多元化指数基金，让自己的积蓄产生效益。

collocations.example_en: Without wasting any time, the repair crew set to work fixing the ruptured pipeline.
collocations.example_zh: 维修人员没有浪费任何时间，立即动手抢修破裂的管道。

collocations.example_en: She chose to work full-time after graduation to gain immediate professional experience.
collocations.example_zh: 毕业后她选择全职工作，以便立即获取专业从业经验。

senses.example_en: We used up all the flour baking cookies this morning.
senses.example_zh: 今天早上烤饼干把我们所有的面粉都用光了。

senses.meaning: 利用（弱点、言论等）来对付，打击
senses.example_en: Anything you confess now could be used against you in court.
senses.example_zh: 你现在承认的任何事情都可能在法庭上被用作对你不利的证据。

senses.example_en: During the power outage, they used candles as their only light source.
senses.example_zh: 停电期间，他们把蜡烛当作唯一的光源。

senses.meaning: 把……用于（特定用途或目标）
senses.example_en: What kind of tool do you normally use for stripping wire?
senses.example_zh: 你平时一般用什么工具剥电线皮？

senses.meaning: 在……中采用，使用（材料、成分或技术）
senses.example_en: Olive oil is extensively used in Mediterranean cooking.
senses.example_zh: 橄榄油被广泛应用于地中海料理中。

senses.meaning: 在……身上施加，使用（手段、技巧或药品）
senses.example_en: Do not use this ointment on broken or irritated skin.
senses.example_zh: 切勿将此药膏涂抹在破损或发炎的皮肤上。

senses.meaning: 将（款项、补贴等）用于支付……
senses.example_en: She decided to use her year-end bonus towards a deposit on an apartment.
senses.example_zh: 她决定把年终奖拿来支付公寓的首期定金。

senses.meaning: 过去常常（通常以 used to 形式后接动词原形）
senses.example_en: My grandfather used to take a walk along the river every evening.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父过去常常每天傍晚沿着河边散步。

senses.meaning: 用以，用于（be used to do 表示用途）
senses.example_en: Solar panels are used to generate clean electricity for the household.
senses.example_zh: 太阳能电池板用于为家庭生产清洁电力。

idioms.meaning: 急需/很想得到；来一个正合适
idioms.example_en: After five continuous hours of meetings, I could really use a strong cup of black coffee.
idioms.example_zh: 连续开了五个小时的会，我真想来一杯浓浓的黑咖啡。

idioms.meaning: 利用；使用
idioms.example_en: Students should make full use of the university library's comprehensive digital archives.
idioms.example_zh: 学生们应当充分利用大学图书馆丰富的数字化档案资源。

idioms.meaning: 物尽其用；使...发挥良好作用
idioms.example_en: She decided to put her multilingual skills to good use by volunteering as an international liaison.
idioms.example_zh: 她决定发挥自己的多语种优势，志愿担任国际联络员以物尽其才。

idioms.meaning: 毫无用处；无济于事
idioms.example_en: Arguing over who was at fault is of no use now that the project has been cancelled.
idioms.example_zh: 既然项目已经被取消，现在争论到底是谁的错也无济于事了。

idioms.meaning: 何必呢；有什么用（表示无奈或放弃）
idioms.example_en: What's the use of worrying constantly about things that are entirely beyond our control?
idioms.example_zh: 整天为那些完全超出我们掌控的事情担忧又有什么用呢？

idioms.meaning: 不需要；极度讨厌/看不惯某人或某事
idioms.example_en: Our straightforward manager has no use for hypocrites who flatter rather than deliver results.
idioms.example_zh: 我们直率的经理极为厌恶那些只会阿谀奉承而不做实事的人。

collocations.example_en: The new transit payment system will officially come into use early next month.
collocations.example_zh: 新的公交支付系统将于下月初正式投入使用。

collocations.example_en: Many archaic English idioms have gradually fallen out of common use over time.
collocations.example_zh: 许多古旧的英语习语随着时间的推移已逐渐不再被常用。

collocations.example_en: This rugged laptop is engineered specifically to withstand heavy use in harsh outdoor environments.
collocations.example_zh: 这款坚固型笔记本电脑专为承受恶劣户外环境中的高频使用而设计。

collocations.meaning: 一直在使用中；持续占用
collocations.example_en: The communal kitchen microwave is in constant use throughout the lunch rush hour.
collocations.example_zh: 在午餐高峰期间，公共厨房的微波炉一直处于被使用的状态。

collocations.example_en: The primary selling point of the new mobile operating system is its remarkable ease of use.
collocations.example_zh: 这款新手机操作系统的主要卖点在于其出色的易用性。

collocations.meaning: 谨慎行事；自行斟酌裁决
collocations.example_en: Airport security officers are advised to use discretion when dealing with anxious travelers.
collocations.example_zh: 建议机场安检人员在对待焦虑的旅客时酌情谨慎行事。

senses.example_en: As soon as they saw how profitable the project was, several investors wanted in.
senses.example_zh: 一看到这个项目利润丰厚，好几位投资人都想入伙。

senses.example_en: The cat is scratching at the back door because it wants in.
senses.example_zh: 猫咪在抓后门，它想进屋了。

senses.meaning: 想要退出/摆脱（协议、关系或困境）
senses.example_en: She felt trapped in the partnership and decided she wanted out.
senses.example_zh: 她觉得自己被合伙关系束缚住了，决定退出。

senses.example_en: The dog was whining by the front door, clearly wanting out.
senses.example_zh: 小狗在前门边呜呜直叫，显然是想出去。

senses.meaning: 缺少/匮乏（多用于否定句表示“一无所缺/应有尽有”）
senses.example_en: Growing up in a wealthy family, the children wanted for nothing.
senses.example_zh: 生长在富裕家庭，孩子们衣食无忧，应有尽有。

senses.example_en: I lent him my favorite jacket, but now I want it back.
senses.example_zh: 我把我最喜欢的夹克借给了他，但现在我想把它要回来。

senses.meaning: 希望与某人复合/重归于好
senses.example_en: Months after the breakup, he realized he still wanted her back.
senses.example_zh: 分手几个月后，他意识到自己依然渴望与她复合。

senses.example_en: Ring the bell if you want off at the next stop.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想在下一站下车，就按一下铃。

senses.meaning: 想退出/免除（项目或任务）
senses.example_en: The workload became unmanageable, and two team members wanted off the project.
senses.example_zh: 工作负荷变得难以承受，两名团队成员希望能退出该项目。

senses.meaning: 希望某人过来（家里或办公室）
senses.example_en: My parents want us over for dinner this Sunday.
senses.example_zh: 我父母希望我们这周日过去一起吃晚饭。

senses.meaning: 想被抱起来（常用于小孩或宠物）
senses.example_en: The toddler raised his arms, signaling that he wanted up.
senses.example_zh: 那个蹒跚学步的孩子举起双手，表示想让人抱起来。

senses.example_en: The puppy was too small to climb the stairs, but it clearly wanted up.
senses.example_zh: 小狗太小爬不了楼梯，但它显然很想上楼。

senses.meaning: 想下来/落地（常用于小孩或宠物）
senses.example_en: After sitting on my lap for a few minutes, the cat started wiggling because it wanted down.
senses.example_zh: 在我腿上坐了几分钟后，猫开始扭动身子，想要下地了。

senses.example_en: She stood at the top of the steep staircase, crying because she wanted down.
senses.example_zh: 她站在陡峭的楼梯顶端大哭，因为她想下楼去。

idioms.meaning: 因缺少/缺乏…
idioms.example_en: The expedition failed not from lack of courage, but for want of proper supplies.
idioms.example_zh: 探险队的失败并非因为缺乏勇气，而是因为缺少充足的物资。

idioms.meaning: 坚决不想参与某事；不愿与…有任何瓜葛
idioms.example_en: He made it clear that he wanted no part of their dishonest scheme.
idioms.example_zh: 他明确表示，绝不想卷入他们不光彩的阴谋中。

idioms.phrase: you don't want to do that
idioms.meaning: （委婉的劝告或警告）你最好别那样做
idioms.example_en: You don't want to open that email attachment; it looks suspicious.
idioms.example_zh: 你最好别打开那个邮件附件，它看起来很可疑。

idioms.meaning: 想要两全其美；既要…又要…（多指妄图兼得不可兼得之物）
idioms.example_en: You can't have flexible hours and a rigid corporate salary; you can't want it both ways.
idioms.example_zh: 你不可能既要弹性工时又要体制内死工资，世上哪有两全其美的事。

idioms.phrase: what do you want from me?
idioms.meaning: （表示挫败或无奈）你究竟想让我怎样？
idioms.example_en: I've already apologized twice; what do you want from me?
idioms.example_zh: 我已经道过两次歉了，你到底还想让我怎样？

idioms.meaning: 找不到合适的词句表达（多作 not want for words 伶牙俐齿/从不词穷）
idioms.example_en: She was so overwhelmed with gratitude that for once she wanted for words.
idioms.example_zh: 她感激涕零，破天荒地一时语塞、找不出合适的话来。

collocations.example_en: She wanted the promotion desperately after years of dedication.
collocations.example_zh: 奉献了这么多年，她极度渴望得到这次晋升。

collocations.phrase: want nothing to do with sb/sth
collocations.meaning: 不想与某人/某事发生任何牵扯
collocations.example_en: Ever since the argument, he wants nothing to do with his former partners.
collocations.example_zh: 自从那次争吵后，他就不想和过去的合伙人有任何瓜葛了。

collocations.meaning: 要求给出解释/寻求真相与答案
collocations.example_en: The victims' families are demanding justice and want answers from officials.
collocations.example_zh: 受害者家属要求伸张正义，并要求官方给出确切说法。

collocations.meaning: 寻求释怀；想要一个彻底的了结
collocations.example_en: Meeting her ex-husband one last time helped her find the closure she wanted.
collocations.example_zh: 最后见前夫一面，帮助她获得了梦寐以求的心灵释怀。

collocations.phrase: want nothing more than to do sth
collocations.example_en: After a grueling shift, he wanted nothing more than to sleep undisturbed.
collocations.example_zh: 在高强度值班结束后，他别无所求，只想安安静静睡一觉。

collocations.example_en: We can rearrange the furniture however you want.
collocations.example_zh: 我们可以完全按照你的想法重新摆放家具。

senses.example_en: I came across an old photo album while cleaning the attic.
senses.example_zh: 我在清理阁楼时偶然发现了一本旧相册。

senses.example_en: He came across as confident and articulate during the interview.
senses.example_zh: 在面试中，他给人留下了自信且善于表达的印象。

senses.meaning: （观点或信息）被理解/表达清楚
senses.example_en: Your main argument didn't really come across in the presentation.
senses.example_zh: 在演讲中，你的核心论点并没有真正表达清楚。

senses.example_en: How is your new book coming along?
senses.example_zh: 你的新书写得进展如何了？

senses.example_en: We're going to the cinema—do you want to come along?
senses.example_zh: 我们要去看电影，你想一起去吗？

senses.example_en: Opportunities like this don't come along very often.
senses.example_zh: 这样的好机会可不是经常有的。

senses.example_en: The antique chair came apart when he sat on it.
senses.example_zh: 当他坐上去时，那把古董椅子散架了。

senses.example_en: Under intense pressure, his carefully laid plans began to come apart.
senses.example_zh: 在巨大的压力下，他精心策划的计划开始土崩瓦解。

senses.example_en: Don't worry, she will eventually come around to our way of thinking.
senses.example_zh: 别担心，她最终会转变想法赞同我们的。

senses.example_en: The patient came around a few hours after the surgery.
senses.example_zh: 手术几小时后，病人苏醒了过来。

senses.example_en: Why don't you come around for coffee this evening?
senses.example_zh: 今晚顺道过来喝杯咖啡怎么样？

senses.meaning: （定期事件）再次来临/周而复始
senses.example_en: Christmas seems to come around quicker every year.
senses.example_zh: 圣诞节似乎一年比一年来得更快。

senses.example_en: What time did you come back from the trip?
senses.example_zh: 你旅行什么时候回来的？

senses.meaning: 重新流行/卷土重来/复出
senses.example_en: Flared jeans seem to have come back into fashion.
senses.example_zh: 喇叭裤似乎又重新流行起来了。

senses.example_en: Once I saw her face, all the memories came back.
senses.example_zh: 一看到她的脸，所有的回忆都涌上了心头。

senses.example_en: She came back with a witty response that silenced her critic.
senses.example_zh: 她机智地回怼了一句，让批评她的人哑口无言。

senses.meaning: 设法获得/搞到（尤指难得之物）
senses.example_en: Affordable housing is very hard to come by in this city.
senses.example_zh: 在这座城市，价格合理的住房非常难得。

senses.example_en: Feel free to come by my office anytime if you have questions.
senses.example_zh: 如果有任何疑问，欢迎随时顺道来我办公室。

senses.example_en: We decided to buy the house once the price came down.
senses.example_zh: 一旦房价降下来，我们就决定买下那栋房子。

senses.example_en: The rain was really coming down, so we took shelter under a bridge.
senses.example_zh: 大雨瓢泼而下，所以我们躲到了桥下。

senses.example_en: This traditional recipe has come down through generations.
senses.example_zh: 这个传统食谱代代相传至今。

senses.example_en: The committee came down in favor of building the new library.
senses.example_zh: 委员会最终决定支持兴建新图书馆。

senses.example_en: In the end, success comes down to hard work and persistence.
senses.example_zh: 归根结底，成功取决于努力与坚持。

senses.meaning: 染上/患上（非致命疾病，如感冒）
senses.example_en: I think I'm coming down with the flu because my throat hurts.
senses.example_zh: 我想我是感冒了，因为我嗓子疼。

senses.meaning: 挺身而出；主动自荐/提供帮助或证词
senses.example_en: Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
senses.example_zh: 警方已呼吁目击证人挺身而出提供线索。

senses.example_en: She comes from a small coastal town in Spain.
senses.example_zh: 她来自西班牙的一个海滨小镇。

senses.example_en: Much of his anxiety comes from overthinking small problems.
senses.example_zh: 他的大部分焦虑都源于对细枝末节的过度思虑。

senses.example_en: The morning train from Chicago has just come in.
senses.example_zh: 从芝加哥开来的早班列车刚刚进站。

senses.example_en: Fresh strawberries are coming in early this year.
senses.example_zh: 今年新鲜草莓上市得比较早。

senses.example_en: Her horse came in second in the final race.
senses.example_zh: 她的马在决赛中获得了第二名。

senses.example_en: Keep that extra blanket handy; it will come in useful tonight.
senses.example_zh: 把那条多余的毯子放在手边，今晚会派上用场的。

senses.example_en: He came into a small fortune after his grandfather passed away.
senses.example_zh: 祖父去世后，他继承了一笔不菲的财产。

senses.meaning: 开始具备/卷入（如进入视野、发挥作用等）
senses.example_en: Several unexpected factors came into play during the negotiation.
senses.example_zh: 谈判过程中，几个意想不到的因素开始发挥作用。

senses.example_en: A button came off my shirt while I was rushing to work.
senses.example_zh: 我急匆匆赶去上班时，衬衫上的一颗扣子掉了。

senses.example_en: Their bold marketing strategy actually came off.
senses.example_zh: 他们大胆的营销策略居然真的奏效了。

senses.example_en: He came off well in the debate, winning over many undecided voters.
senses.example_zh: 他在辩论中表现出色，赢得了许多摇摆选民的支持。

senses.meaning: 快点/加油（用于催促或鼓励）
senses.example_en: Come on, or we'll miss the start of the movie!
senses.example_zh: 快点，不然我们就赶不上电影开场了！

senses.meaning: （疾病、情绪、天气等）悄然袭来/发作
senses.example_en: I can feel a severe headache coming on.
senses.example_zh: 我感觉一阵剧烈的头痛正悄悄袭来。

senses.example_en: The street lights come on automatically at dusk.
senses.example_zh: 黄昏时分，路灯会自动亮起。

senses.example_en: Her English has really come on since she moved to London.
senses.example_zh: 自从移居伦敦后，她的英语水平有了很大长进。

senses.example_en: His next novel is scheduled to come out this November.
senses.example_zh: 他的下一部小说定于今年十一月出版。

senses.example_en: The full truth about the scandal finally came out.
senses.example_zh: 这桩丑闻的全部真相最终大白于天下。

senses.example_en: The cake came out much better than I expected.
senses.example_zh: 这个蛋糕烤出来的效果比我预期的好得多。

senses.example_en: The cherry blossoms are beginning to come out in the park.
senses.example_zh: 公园里的樱花正开始绽放。

senses.example_en: Can you come over and help me move this heavy table?
senses.example_zh: 你能过来帮我搬一下这张重桌子吗？

senses.example_en: A wave of dizziness suddenly came over her.
senses.example_zh: 一阵眩晕感突然向她袭来。

senses.example_en: He came over as slightly arrogant during the discussion.
senses.example_zh: 在讨论过程中，他表现得略显傲慢。

senses.example_en: With proper treatment, he came through the illness without complications.
senses.example_zh: 经过合理治疗，他战胜了病痛且没有出现并发症。

senses.meaning: 兑现承诺/在关键时刻提供支持
senses.example_en: When we desperately needed funding, our investors came through.
senses.example_zh: 当我们极度需要资金时，投资人们兑现了承诺施以援手。

senses.meaning: （官方信息/款项/批准）传达/获批
senses.example_en: My visa finally came through after six weeks of waiting.
senses.example_zh: 经过六周的等待，我的签证终于批下来了。

senses.example_en: When the boxer came to, he was lying in the locker room.
senses.example_zh: 当拳击手苏醒过来时，他正躺在更衣室里。

senses.example_en: The dinner bill came to eighty dollars including the tip.
senses.example_zh: 晚饭账单算上小费总共是八十美元。

senses.meaning: 谈及/涉及（常用于 when it comes to）
senses.example_en: When it comes to negotiation, she is unmatched in our firm.
senses.example_zh: 说到商务谈判，她在我们律所可以说是无人能敌。

senses.example_en: The issue of budget cuts came up during the board meeting.
senses.example_zh: 削减预算的问题在董事会议上被提及。

senses.example_en: I'm sorry I can't attend; something urgent has just come up.
senses.example_zh: 很抱歉我不能出席了，刚刚突然发生了一件急事。

senses.meaning: 升起（太阳/月亮）；走近/上前
senses.example_en: A stranger came up to me and asked for directions.
senses.example_zh: 一个陌生人走到我面前问路。

senses.meaning: 想出/提出（计划、主意、解决办法）
senses.example_en: She came up with a brilliant solution to the logistical problem.
senses.example_zh: 她想出了一个绝妙的方案来解决这个物流问题。

senses.example_en: They had only forty-eight hours to come up with the deposit.
senses.example_zh: 他们只有四十八小时来筹措出这笔定金。

idioms.meaning: 逐渐接受/妥协/面对（严酷的现实）
idioms.example_en: It took him years to come to terms with the end of his athletic career.
idioms.example_zh: 他花了好几年时间才坦然接受自己运动生涯的结束。

idioms.meaning: 坦白交代；全盘招供
idioms.example_en: The accountant decided to come clean about the irregular financial entries.
idioms.example_zh: 会计决定全盘坦白那些违规的财务账目。

idioms.meaning: 派上用场；很有用
idioms.example_en: Keep this pocketknife with you; you never know when it might come in handy.
idioms.example_zh: 随身带上这把折叠刀，说不定什么时候就能派上大用场。

idioms.meaning: 兜了一圈回到原点；重回起点
idioms.example_en: His career came full circle when he returned to teach at the high school he once attended.
idioms.example_zh: 当他回到曾经就读的高中任教时，他的职业生涯仿佛兜了个圈又回到了原点。

idioms.meaning: 成年；走向成熟/达到鼎盛期
idioms.example_en: Artificial intelligence has truly come of age over the past few years.
idioms.example_zh: 在过去的几年里，人工智能技术已真正走向成熟阶段。

idioms.meaning: 遭受猛烈批评/抨击
idioms.example_en: The company came under fire for failing to protect user privacy.
idioms.example_zh: 该公司因未能保护用户隐私而遭到了口诛笔伐。

idioms.meaning: 无论发生什么；不管怎样
idioms.example_en: I will stand by your side and support your choice, come what may.
idioms.example_zh: 无论发生什么，我都将站在你身边支持你的选择。

collocations.example_en: The golden era of cheap energy has finally come to an end.
collocations.example_zh: 廉价能源的黄金时代终于落下了帷幕。

collocations.example_en: New evidence came to light during the secondary investigation.
collocations.example_zh: 在二次调查过程中，新的证据浮出了水面。

collocations.example_en: The strict environmental regulations will come into effect starting next January.
collocations.example_zh: 严格的环保法规将于明年一月起正式生效实施。

collocations.example_en: Production came to a complete halt due to a widespread power outage.
collocations.example_zh: 由于大范围停电，生产陷入了彻底停滞状态。

collocations.example_en: Her abrupt resignation came as a massive surprise to everyone on the board.
collocations.example_zh: 她的突然辞职让董事会里的每一个人都深感震惊与意外。

collocations.example_en: After evaluating all data, researchers came to the conclusion that the hypothesis was sound.
collocations.example_zh: 在评估所有数据后，研究人员得出了该假说完全成立的结论。

senses.example_en: What exactly do you mean by that remark?
senses.example_zh: 你那句话究竟是什么意思？

senses.example_en: This gift was originally meant for my sister, but you can have it.
senses.example_zh: 这件礼物原本是打算送给我妹妹的，不过你可以拿去。

senses.meaning: 预定使……成为，打算让……承担
senses.example_en: His parents had always meant him for the family business.
senses.example_zh: 他的父母一直打算让他继承家族企业。

senses.example_en: I'm sorry I stepped on your foot; I didn't mean to do it.
senses.example_zh: 对不起踩到了你的脚，我不是故意的。

senses.meaning: 天生适合，命中注定属于
senses.example_en: From the moment they met, they knew they were meant for each other.
senses.example_zh: 从相遇的那一刻起，他们就知道彼此是天造地设的一对。

senses.example_en: This medication is not meant for children under the age of twelve.
senses.example_zh: 这种药物不适用于十二岁以下的儿童。

senses.example_en: You were meant to hand in the report yesterday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 你照理应该在昨天下午就提交这份报告的。

senses.example_en: The new law is meant to protect consumers from online fraud.
senses.example_zh: 这项新法律旨在保护消费者免受网络诈骗。

senses.meaning: 本意是作为，当作……来表达
senses.example_en: It was meant as a constructive suggestion, not a personal attack.
senses.example_zh: 这本是建设性的提议，绝非针对个人的攻击。

senses.meaning: 对……有重要意义，对……很有价值
senses.example_en: Your constant support really means a lot to our team.
senses.example_zh: 你一直以来的支持对我们团队来说意义重大。

senses.meaning: 对……毫无价值，对……无关紧要
senses.example_en: All those empty promises mean nothing to the striking workers.
senses.example_zh: 那些空洞的承诺对罢工工人而言毫无意义。

idioms.meaning: 态度严肃认真；动真格的，绝非儿戏
idioms.example_en: When the CEO canceled the weekend off, we knew she meant business.
idioms.example_zh: 当首席执行官取消了周末休假时，我们知道她是动真格的了。

idioms.meaning: 我是认真的；我绝不开玩笑
idioms.example_en: Stop tracking mud across the clean carpet right now—I mean it!
idioms.example_zh: 立刻别把泥巴踩在干净的地毯上了——我是认真的！

idioms.meaning: 对某人来说至关重要；是某人的全部
idioms.example_en: Her children mean the absolute world to her.
idioms.example_zh: 她的孩子们对她来说就是全世界。

idioms.meaning: 理解某人的想法；明白某人的意思
idioms.example_en: Now that you point out the flaw in the layout, I see what you mean.
idioms.example_zh: 既然你指出了版面上的缺陷，我明白你的意思了。

idioms.meaning: 绝无冒犯之意；无心之失
idioms.example_en: No offense meant, but your calculations don't quite add up.
idioms.example_zh: 无意冒犯，但你的计算结果似乎有些不对劲。

idioms.meaning: 你懂我意思吧（口语中用于寻求对方认同或共鸣）
idioms.example_en: It's just exhausting dealing with bureaucracy all day, you know what I mean?
idioms.example_zh: 整天应付官僚程序真让人筋疲力尽，你懂我意思吧？

collocations.example_en: Don't be angry with your mother; she meant well when she tidied your desk.
collocations.example_zh: 别生你母亲的气，她收拾你的书桌完全是出于一片好意。

collocations.meaning: 预示着麻烦；意味着惹上祸事
collocations.example_en: Those dark gathering storm clouds mean trouble for our sailing trip.
collocations.example_zh: 那些聚积的乌云意味着我们的航行要遇到大麻烦了。

collocations.example_en: The barking dog sounds terrifying, but he doesn't mean any harm.
collocations.example_zh: 那只狗叫起来声音吓人，但它并无恶意。

collocations.meaning: 说话算数；言出必行；说的是真心话
collocations.example_en: If he promised to back your project, you can trust that he means what he says.
collocations.example_zh: 如果他答应支持你的项目，你可以相信他绝对说到做到。

collocations.meaning: 字字发自肺腑；完全是由衷之言
collocations.example_en: I thanked them profusely for their hospitality, and I meant every word.
collocations.example_zh: 我对他们的热情款待连连致谢，且字字句句发自肺腑。

collocations.example_en: Having the support of her family meant everything to the young athlete.
collocations.example_zh: 得到家人的全力支持，对这位年轻的运动员而言意味着一切。

senses.meaning: （尤指在困难或繁忙时）帮忙，协助分担
senses.example_en: Could you help out with the dishes while I prepare dinner?
senses.example_zh: 我做晚饭的时候你能帮忙洗下碗吗？

senses.meaning: 给某人盛（饭）、夹（菜）或斟（饮料）
senses.example_en: The host warmly helped each guest to another slice of roast beef.
senses.example_zh: 主人热情地给每位客人又夹了一块烤牛肉。

senses.meaning: 搀扶起，扶起（摔倒或坐着的人）
senses.example_en: She slipped on the ice, but a passerby quickly helped her up.
senses.example_zh: 她在冰上滑倒了，但一位路人很快把她扶了起来。

senses.meaning: 帮某人脱去（大衣、外套等）
senses.example_en: The waiter stepped forward to help her off with her heavy winter coat.
senses.example_zh: 服务员上前帮她脱下了厚重的冬大衣。

senses.meaning: 帮某人穿上（大衣、夹克等外套）
senses.example_en: He courteously helped his grandmother on with her woolen cardigan.
senses.example_zh: 他礼貌地帮祖母穿上了羊毛开衫。

senses.meaning: 搀扶某人下来（从高处、梯子或车上）
senses.example_en: The firefighter carefully helped the frightened child down from the tree.
senses.example_zh: 消防员小心翼翼地把受惊的孩子从树上扶了下来。

senses.meaning: 搀扶或引导某人进入（车辆、轮椅、房间等）
senses.example_en: The nurse gently helped the patient into the wheelchair.
senses.example_zh: 护士温柔地搀扶病人坐进轮椅。

senses.meaning: 搀扶某人离开或走出（车厢、房间等）
senses.example_en: He opened the taxi door and helped his elderly father out of the car.
senses.example_zh: 他打开出租车门，搀扶年迈的父亲下了车。

senses.example_en: An emergency loan helped the firm out of its financial crisis.
senses.example_zh: 一笔紧急贷款帮助这家公司渡过了财务危机。

senses.example_en: She helped the toddler out of his wet snowsuit.
senses.example_zh: 她帮幼儿脱掉了湿漉漉的防寒服。

senses.example_en: Adequate rest and good nutrition will help your recovery along.
senses.example_zh: 充足的休息和良好的营养会促进你的康复。

senses.example_en: The nurse helped the injured soldier along the hospital corridor.
senses.example_zh: 护士搀扶着受伤的士兵沿着医院走廊前行。

senses.meaning: 推动，促进（事业、计划或运动）向前发展
senses.example_en: Generous public donations have helped forward the cancer research project.
senses.example_zh: 公众的慷慨捐赠推进了这项癌症研究项目的进展。

idioms.meaning: 忍不住；禁不住（做某事）
idioms.example_en: I couldn't help laughing when the puppy chased its own tail in circles.
idioms.example_zh: 当看到小狗绕着圈追自己的尾巴时，我忍不住笑出了声。

idioms.meaning: 不得不；只能（做某事）
idioms.example_en: Listening to his tragic story, we could not help but sympathize with him.
idioms.example_zh: 听完他悲惨的遭遇，我们禁不住深表同情。

idioms.meaning: 请自便；请随意取用（食物、饮品或物品）
idioms.example_en: There's fresh coffee and warm bagels on the counter, so please help yourself.
idioms.example_zh: 吧台上备有新鲜咖啡和热百吉饼，请各位随意享用。

idioms.phrase: not if I can help it
idioms.meaning: 只要我能阻止，就绝不让它发生；绝不答应
idioms.example_en: They won't shut down the neighborhood library—not if I can help it.
idioms.example_zh: 他们休想关掉社区图书馆——只要我能阻止，就绝不答应。

idioms.meaning: 聚沙成塔；微小的努力也能发挥作用
idioms.example_en: Even donating a single dollar helps the shelter, because every little helps.
idioms.example_zh: 即使只向收容所捐赠一美元也有所助益，因为聚沙成塔，滴水成河。

idioms.meaning: 向上帝发誓，绝无虚言；（口语中用于表气愤或发誓）我保证
idioms.example_en: I will tell the whole truth in court tomorrow, so help me God.
idioms.example_zh: 明天在法庭上我将陈述全部实情，向上帝发誓绝无虚言。

collocations.example_en: It is a sign of strength, not weakness, to seek professional help for mental health.
collocations.example_zh: 为心理健康寻求专业帮助是坚强的表现，而非软弱。

collocations.meaning: 主动提供协助；施以援手
collocations.example_en: Several local volunteers arrived promptly to offer help after the flash flood.
collocations.example_zh: 山洪暴发后，几名当地志愿者迅速赶来提供援助。

collocations.meaning: 请求援助；开口求人帮忙
collocations.example_en: Don't hesitate to ask for help if you run into difficulties with the assignment.
collocations.example_zh: 如果你在作业中遇到困难，请毫不犹豫地寻求帮助。

collocations.example_en: Your prompt feedback on the draft helped a great deal in refining our proposal.
collocations.example_zh: 你对草案的及时反馈对我们完善方案起到了极大的帮助。

collocations.example_en: She took a part-time job on campus to help pay for her tuition and textbooks.
collocations.example_zh: 她在校内找了一份兼职，以协助支付学费和书本费。

collocations.meaning: 大声呼救；（引申）极度迫切需要救助
collocations.example_en: The dilapidated rural clinic is crying out for help and modern equipment.
collocations.example_zh: 这家破旧的乡村诊所急需援助与现代化设备。

senses.example_en: You should try on the jacket before buying it to make sure it fits.
senses.example_zh: 买之前你最好先试穿一下这件夹克，确保合身。

senses.meaning: 试探底线，耍花招（尤指试探忍耐度或权威）
senses.example_en: Don't try that on with me—I know exactly what you're up to.
senses.example_zh: 别跟我耍这种花招，我很清楚你在打什么算盘。

senses.meaning: 试用，试验（新设备、方法或想法）
senses.example_en: The lab is trying out a new method to reduce carbon emissions.
senses.example_zh: 实验室正在试验一种减少碳排放的新方法。

senses.meaning: 参加选拔，参加选秀/试训
senses.example_en: Over fifty young players turned up to try out for the academy.
senses.example_zh: 五十多名年轻球员赶来参加青训营的选拔。

senses.meaning: 参加…的选拔，试镜（以获得角色或加入团队）
senses.example_en: She decided to try out for the lead role in the school play.
senses.example_zh: 她决定去竞选学校话剧的主角。

senses.meaning: 谋求，争取获得；试图达到（某个目标或职位）
senses.example_en: He plans to try for a scholarship to study abroad next year.
senses.example_zh: 他打算争取明年的出国留学奖学金。

senses.meaning: 故意试探底线；企图蒙骗某人
senses.example_en: The shop assistant tried it on by charging me extra, but I noticed the discrepancy.
senses.example_zh: 店员想糊弄我多收钱，但被我识破了差额。

senses.meaning: 向某人搭讪调情，企图求欢
senses.example_en: He had a few drinks and started trying it on with one of my colleagues.
senses.example_zh: 他喝了几杯酒后，就开始搭讪调戏我的一位女同事。

senses.meaning: （电话中）稍后再打，过会儿再试
senses.example_en: Dr. Evans is in surgery right now; could you try back in an hour?
senses.example_zh: 埃文斯医生正在做手术，您能过一个小时再打来吗？

senses.meaning: 在某人身上试验；向某人试探征求对某想法的意见
senses.example_en: Let me try out my new presentation on you before the big meeting.
senses.example_zh: 在大考前，让我先对着你把新演示文稿试讲一遍吧。

senses.example_en: Here are the boots in a size nine—try them on for size.
senses.example_zh: 这是9码的靴子——你试穿一下看大小合适不合适。

senses.meaning: 试着考虑，权衡体验（新建议或想法）
senses.example_en: Try this idea on for size: what if we launch the product online first?
senses.example_zh: 你琢磨琢磨这个主意：如果我们先在网上首发该产品怎么样？

idioms.meaning: 初试身手，尝试做某事
idioms.example_en: After retiring from teaching, he decided to try his hand at pottery.
idioms.example_zh: 从教师岗位退休后，他决定初试身手学做陶艺。

idioms.meaning: 考验某人的耐心，使人忍无可忍
idioms.example_en: The child's constant whining was beginning to try the mother's patience.
idioms.example_zh: 孩子持续不断的哭闹开始挑战这位母亲的耐心极限。

idioms.meaning: 碰运气，撞大运
idioms.example_en: He went to Hollywood to try his luck as an actor.
idioms.example_zh: 他前往好莱坞碰碰运气，想当一名演员。

idioms.meaning: 无论怎样努力，尽管竭尽全力
idioms.example_en: Try as he might, he simply couldn't open the jammed safe.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管他竭尽全力，却无论如何也打不开卡住的保险箱。

idioms.meaning: 尝试一下，试一试某事物
idioms.example_en: If you've never eaten sushi before, you really ought to give it a try.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你以前从没吃过寿司，真应该尝试一下。

idioms.phrase: don't try to run before you can walk
idioms.meaning: 不要未学走先学跑，做事要循序渐进
idioms.example_en: Master the basic chords first; don't try to run before you can walk.
idioms.example_zh: 先把基础和弦练扎实，别还没学会走就想跑。

idioms.phrase: try every trick in the book
idioms.meaning: 使出浑身解数，千方百计
idioms.example_en: The defense attorney tried every trick in the book to clear his client.
idioms.example_zh: 辩护律师使出了浑身解数，试图为他的委托人洗脱罪名。

collocations.example_en: We must try our utmost to reduce carbon emissions across all sectors.
collocations.example_zh: 我们必须竭尽全力削减各领域的碳排放。

collocations.example_en: The paramedics tried in vain to revive the unconscious driver.
collocations.example_zh: 急救人员徒劳地尝试唤醒那名失去知觉的司机。

collocations.example_en: The judge will try the high-profile fraud case next Monday.
collocations.example_zh: 法官将于下周一审理这起备受瞩目的诈骗案。

collocations.example_en: Since traditional advertising failed, the company tried a new approach using influencer marketing.
collocations.example_zh: 由于传统广告收效甚微，公司尝试了一种利用网红营销的新策略。

collocations.example_en: Trapped climbers tried desperately to stay warm through the blizzard.
collocations.example_zh: 被困的登山者拼命挣扎着在暴风雪中保持体温。

collocations.meaning: 惹某人发火，考验某人的脾气
collocations.example_en: Dealing with rude customers every day will certainly try anyone's temper.
collocations.example_zh: 每天跟粗鲁的顾客打交道绝对会考验任何人的脾气。

senses.meaning: 放下工具（罢工）；停工休息
senses.example_en: Factory workers decided to down tools in protest against the wage cuts.
senses.example_zh: 工厂工人决定停工罢工，以抗议降薪。

senses.example_en: His friends cheered as he downed the pint of beer in one.
senses.example_zh: 当他把整品脱啤酒一饮而尽时，朋友们欢呼起来。

senses.meaning: 就着（水或液体）吞下/服下某物
senses.example_en: She downed the two painkillers with a glass of orange juice.
senses.example_zh: 她就着一杯橙汁咽下了两片止痛药。

senses.meaning: 击倒对手；击败竞争对手
senses.example_en: The champion downed his opponent in the third round with a swift hook.
senses.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在第三回合以一记利落的勾拳击倒了对手。

senses.example_en: Air defense systems successfully downed an enemy reconnaissance drone.
senses.example_zh: 防空系统成功击落了一架敌方侦察无人机。

senses.meaning: 仰头干掉一杯酒/一口烈酒
senses.example_en: He downed a shot of tequila and slammed the glass onto the bar counter.
senses.example_zh: 他一口干了一杯龙舌兰烈酒，重重地把酒杯砸在吧台上。

senses.meaning: （美式橄榄球中）触地停球，持球触地以使死球
senses.example_en: The receiver caught the kick in the end zone and wisely chose to down the ball.
senses.example_zh: 接球员在达阵区接住开球，并明智地选择持球触地停球。

senses.meaning: 患上（疾病）；（因病）卧床不起
senses.example_en: Half the sales team is down with the flu this week.
senses.example_zh: 这周销售团队有一半人得了流感病倒了。

idioms.meaning: 倒霉，走霉运，处于窘境
idioms.example_en: The charity provides hot meals and shelter to people down on their luck.
idioms.example_zh: 该慈善机构为落魄落难的人们提供热饭和庇护所。

idioms.meaning: 心情低落，郁郁寡欢
idioms.example_en: Ever since he failed the driving test, he has been feeling down in the dumps.
idioms.example_zh: 自从驾考不及格以来，他就一直闷闷不乐。

idioms.meaning: 直到最后一刻，悬念留到最后
idioms.example_en: The presidential election was extremely close and went right down to the wire.
idioms.example_zh: 这场总统选举竞争极其激烈，悬念一直保留到了最后一刻。

idioms.meaning: 付诸东流，全盘泡汤，化为乌有
idioms.example_en: All our months of hard preparation went down the drain when the event was canceled.
idioms.example_zh: 活动取消后，我们数月以来的辛勤准备全都付诸东流了。

idioms.meaning: 脚踏实地，平易近人，实事求是
idioms.example_en: Despite her international fame, the actress remains incredibly down to earth.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管享誉国际，这位女演员依然极其平易近人、脚踏实地。

idioms.meaning: 在未来某个时刻；彻底，全盘
idioms.example_en: If we cut corners now, it will cause serious maintenance issues down the line.
idioms.example_zh: 如果我们现在偷工减料，将来一定会引发严重的维护问题。

idioms.meaning: 穷困潦倒，走投无路，无家可归
idioms.example_en: A sudden bankruptcy left the former entrepreneur completely down and out.
idioms.example_zh: 突如其来的破产让这位昔日的女企业家彻底陷入了穷困潦倒的境地。

collocations.example_en: After a grueling shift at the warehouse, he headed to the pub to down a cold pint.
collocations.example_zh: 在仓库完成了繁重的轮班后，他前往酒吧痛饮了一大杯冰啤酒。

collocations.example_en: Metro operators threatened to down tools in protest against unsafe working conditions.
collocations.example_zh: 地铁运营人员威胁将通过停工罢工来抗议不安全的工作环境。

collocations.example_en: The military confirmed that their air defense system had downed a fighter jet.
collocations.example_zh: 军方证实其防空系统击落了一架战斗机。

collocations.meaning: 因疾病/高烧而卧床不起
collocations.example_en: The star striker was downed by a severe fever and missed the championship final.
collocations.example_zh: 这名主力前锋因突发高烧卧床不起，错过了总决赛。

collocations.example_en: She downed the prescribed allergy pill with a glass of warm water.
collocations.example_zh: 她就着一杯温水吞下了医生开的抗过敏药丸。

collocations.phrase: down an opponent in the first round
collocations.example_en: The reigning champion stunned the arena by downing his opponent in the first round.
collocations.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在第一回合就击倒了对手，震惊了全场观众。

senses.meaning: 坦白，认错，爽快承认（做了错事）
senses.example_en: No one would own up to breaking the window, so the whole class was kept after school.
senses.example_zh: 没有人愿意承认打破了窗户，所以全班都被罚放学后留堂。

senses.meaning: 公开承认，供认（过错、罪行或责任）
senses.example_en: He had the courage to own up to his mistakes and apologize publicly.
senses.example_zh: 他勇于承认自己的错误并公开道歉。

senses.meaning: （正式或旧式）承认，供认（某种情感、缺点或事实）
senses.example_en: She owned to a feeling of deep disappointment when the deal fell through.
senses.example_zh: 交易告吹时，她承认自己感到非常失望。

senses.meaning: （口语/网络俚语）彻底击垮，完胜，狠狠压制（对手）
senses.example_en: Our team completely owned them in the second half of the match.
senses.example_zh: 我们在比赛下半场彻底碾压了他们。

senses.meaning: 归……所有，由……拥有（资产、公司、版权等）
senses.example_en: The media group is majority-owned by an international conglomerate.
senses.example_zh: 该媒体集团由一家跨国企业集团控股拥有。

senses.meaning: 受……完全控制，被……牵着鼻子走
senses.example_en: Critics argued that the senator was completely owned by the gun lobby.
senses.example_zh: 批评人士称，这位参议员完全受到了枪支游说集团的操纵。

senses.meaning: 全款持有，完全拥有（无抵押或分期负债）
senses.example_en: After making the final mortgage payment, they finally own the house outright.
senses.example_zh: 还清最后一笔房贷后，他们终于全款拥有了这套房子。

senses.meaning: 共同所有，合伙持有（产权、股权、财产等）
senses.example_en: The business and its underlying intellectual property are owned jointly by the two founders.
senses.example_zh: 该企业及其底层知识产权由两位创始人共同持有。

senses.meaning: 无留置权地全权拥有，无任何债务负担地持有（资产）
senses.example_en: They worked hard for decades to own their family farm free and clear.
senses.example_zh: 他们辛勤打拼了几十年，终于无债一身轻地全权拥有了自家的农场。

idioms.meaning: 充分展现才能；得到应有的地位和承认；大显身手
idioms.example_en: She really came into her own once she was promoted to head of research.
idioms.example_zh: 一旦被提升为研发主管，她便真正开始大显身手。

idioms.meaning: 坚守阵地；不落下风，表现得毫不逊色；（病人）情况未恶化
idioms.example_en: Despite her lack of experience, she held her own in the debate against seasoned politicians.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管缺乏经验，她在与老练政客的辩论中依然不落下风。

idioms.meaning: 独自一人；自食其力，独立自主地；全凭自己
idioms.example_en: She has lived on her own since she graduated from university at twenty-two.
idioms.example_zh: 她从二十二岁大学毕业起就一直一个人独立生活。

idioms.phrase: have a mind of one's own
idioms.meaning: 极有主见，不随波逐流；（机器、物体等）不听使唤，自顾自运转
idioms.example_en: You won't convince him easily; he definitely has a mind of his own.
idioms.example_zh: 你很难说服他；他是个极有主见的人。

idioms.phrase: in a league of one's own
idioms.meaning: 独步天下，独树一帜；无与伦比，无可比拟
idioms.example_en: When it comes to violin technique, the young prodigy is in a league of his own.
idioms.example_zh: 谈到小提琴演奏技法，这位年轻的神童可谓独步天下。

idioms.phrase: stand on one's own two feet
idioms.meaning: 独立自主；自立自强，不依赖他人
idioms.example_en: It is time for him to stop relying on his parents' money and stand on his own two feet.
idioms.example_zh: 他该停止依赖父母的资助、学着自立自强了。

idioms.phrase: take the law into one's own hands
idioms.meaning: 公然违法擅自解决；私设公堂，私自以暴力执法
idioms.example_en: Frustrated by police inaction, the villagers decided to take the law into their own hands.
idioms.example_zh: 由于对警方的无所作为感到愤怒，村民们决定擅自采取私刑。

collocations.example_en: The investment firm owns a significant stake in the renewable energy startup.
collocations.example_zh: 这家投资公司在这家可再生能源初创企业中持有可观的股份。

collocations.example_en: The local agency is a wholly owned subsidiary of a global corporation.
collocations.example_zh: 这家本地机构是一家跨国公司的全资子公司。

collocations.meaning: 拥有……的版权/专有经营权
collocations.example_en: The studio owns the exclusive rights to the best-selling novel.
collocations.example_zh: 该电影制片厂拥有这部畅销小说的独家改编版权。

collocations.meaning: 正视并坦然面对……的事实；大方承认
collocations.example_en: You need to own the fact that your behavior hurt the people around you.
collocations.example_zh: 你必须正视并承认你的行为伤害了身边人的事实。

collocations.meaning: 私有的 / 公有的（国有或上市公司所有的）
collocations.example_en: The country is moving toward privatizing several major state-owned enterprises.
collocations.example_zh: 该国正逐步推进对数家主要国有企业的私有化进程。

collocations.meaning: 置业；购置并拥有房产/不动产
collocations.example_en: Rising interest rates have made it harder for young adults to own property.
collocations.example_zh: 利率上升使年轻人购置房产变得更加困难。

senses.meaning: （食物、金钱、储备等）足够支撑到结束
senses.example_en: We brought just enough drinking water to last out until rescue arrived.
senses.example_zh: 我们带的饮用水刚好够撑到救援人员赶到。

senses.example_en: I was exhausted, but somehow I managed to last out the final round.
senses.example_zh: 我筋疲力尽，但不知怎的还是咬牙撑完了最后一轮。

senses.meaning: 熬过，挺过，平安度过（艰苦时期、严冬、风暴等）
senses.example_en: Many small businesses struggled just to last through the harsh winter.
senses.example_zh: 许多小企业为了熬过严冬而苦苦挣扎。

senses.meaning: （钱款、物品等）足够某人用/维持（某段时间）
senses.example_en: A single full charge will easily last you for two full days.
senses.example_zh: 充满一次电轻松足够你使用整整两天。

senses.meaning: 持续达（某段具体的时间或跨度）
senses.example_en: The heavy rain lasted for three uninterrupted days, causing localized flooding.
senses.example_zh: 大雨连续下了整整三天，导致了局部洪涝。

senses.meaning: 一直延续到，持续到（某个具体时间点）
senses.example_en: The truce is expected to last until midnight on Sunday.
senses.example_zh: 停火协议预计将持续到周日午夜。

senses.meaning: 延续进入（下一季节、世纪、时代或阶段）
senses.example_en: The heatwave is forecast to last well into next week.
senses.example_zh: 据预测，这股热浪将一直延续到下周。

senses.meaning: 延续超过（预期期限、寿命或界限）
senses.example_en: Their influence on modern architecture lasted far beyond their own lifetimes.
senses.example_zh: 他们对现代建筑的影响力远远超越了他们自身的寿命。

senses.meaning: 熬完，坚持度过（漫长枯燥或艰难的时期、会议、任期等）
senses.example_en: He was already feeling sick, but he forced himself to last the meeting out.
senses.example_zh: 他已经觉得身体不舒服了，但还是硬撑着坚持开完了会议。

idioms.meaning: 终于，最终；历经波折后终于
idioms.example_en: After months of grueling delays, the new bridge was opened to traffic at long last.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数月令人疲惫的延误后，新大桥终于通车了。

idioms.meaning: 压死骆驼的最后一根稻草；忍无可忍的最后一击
idioms.example_en: When he lied about his finances again, it proved to be the last straw for her.
idioms.example_zh: 当他再次对自己的财务状况撒谎时，彻底成了压垮她耐心的最后一根稻草。

idioms.meaning: 笑到最后；最终取得胜利（让曾经嘲笑者哑口无言）
idioms.example_en: They ridiculed his startup idea at first, but he had the last laugh when it went public.
idioms.example_zh: 起初他们嘲笑他的创业构想，但在公司上市后，他笑到了最后。

idioms.meaning: 最后但同样重要的
idioms.example_en: And last but not least, I want to thank my family for their unwavering support.
idioms.example_zh: 最后但同样重要的一点是，我要感谢家人坚定不移的支持。

idioms.meaning: 直到最后一刻；坚持到底；至死
idioms.example_en: The old soldier remained fiercely loyal to his comrades to the last.
idioms.example_zh: 这位老兵直到生命的最后一刻，依然对战友怀着无比深厚的忠诚。

idioms.phrase: be the last person / thing to do sth
idioms.meaning: 最不可能做某事的人/物；最不情愿做某事的人/物
idioms.example_en: She is the last person I would expect to gossip about a colleague.
idioms.example_zh: 她是那类我最不可能料到会说同事闲话的人。

idioms.meaning: （幽默讽刺）自满的大话；言之过早的自信断言
idioms.example_en: 'Don't worry, this project will only take an hour.' — Famous last words!
idioms.example_zh: “别担心，这个项目只要一小时搞定。”——真是典型的大话！

collocations.meaning: 经久耐用；做工扎实，结构结实
collocations.example_en: These vintage mechanical watches were truly built to last for generations.
collocations.example_zh: 这些老式机械表确实做工扎实，经久耐用，能代代相传。

collocations.example_en: The lessons learned during those formative years will last a lifetime.
collocations.example_zh: 在那些成长岁月中所汲取的教训将让人受益终生。

collocations.meaning: 跑完全程；坚持到底，经受住长久考验
collocations.example_en: Analysts wonder whether the fragile coalition can last the distance until the next election.
collocations.example_zh: 分析人士怀疑这个脆弱的执政联盟能否撑到下次大选。

collocations.meaning: 维持不了多久；短暂易逝
collocations.example_en: Given their constant bickering, the partnership probably won't last long.
collocations.example_zh: 鉴于他们频繁争执，这段合作关系恐怕维持不了多久。

collocations.meaning: 万不得已的手段；最后的救命稻草
collocations.example_en: Military intervention should always be considered only as a last resort.
collocations.example_zh: 军事干预应始终仅作为万不得已时的最后手段。

collocations.meaning: 事无巨细地；详尽无遗地，精确到每一处细节
collocations.example_en: The security team planned the president's visit down to the last detail.
collocations.example_zh: 安保团队把总统出访的行程计划精确到了每一个细节。

senses.meaning: 舍弃，放弃，出让（尤指不舍得或不情愿地）
senses.example_en: I could never part with this old guitar; it was a gift from my grandfather.
senses.example_zh: 我绝不会卖掉这把旧吉他，这是我祖父送给我的礼物。

senses.example_en: It broke her heart to part from her children even for a few days.
senses.example_zh: 哪怕只是和孩子们分开几天，她也感到心碎。

senses.example_en: After walking together to the station, they parted company and headed home.
senses.example_zh: 一起走到车站后，他们便分道扬镳，各自回家了。

senses.meaning: 终止合作关系；（因意见不合而）断绝往来
senses.example_en: The band decided to part company with their longtime manager over creative differences.
senses.example_zh: 因创作理念分歧，乐队决定与合作多年的经纪人终止合作。

senses.meaning: 拆件出售（将汽车、电脑等设备拆解后分批售卖零件）
senses.example_en: Instead of selling the damaged car whole, he decided to part it out for more money.
senses.example_zh: 他没有将受损的汽车整车出售，而是决定拆成零件卖以赚取更多收益。

senses.meaning: 隔开，划分（用隔板、屏风等隔出独立空间）
senses.example_en: They used a wooden screen to part off a quiet study area in the living room.
senses.example_zh: 他们用木质屏风在客厅里隔出了一个安静的学习区域。

senses.meaning: 因……而产生分歧；因……而各自分开
senses.example_en: The two co-founders eventually parted over how to spend the investment funds.
senses.example_zh: 两位联合创始人最终因如何使用投资资金产生分歧而分道扬镳。

senses.meaning: 分开，解散，断绝恋爱关系
senses.example_en: After three years of dating, they realized they wanted different things and parted up.
senses.example_zh: 恋爱三年后，他们发现彼此追求不同，于是和平分手了。

senses.meaning: 梳分（头发），在某处分出头缝
senses.example_en: She parted her hair down the middle before tying it into braids.
senses.example_zh: 她在把头发编成辫子之前，先在中间分出了一道发缝。

idioms.meaning: ……不可或缺的一部分，必不可少的要素
idioms.example_en: Dealing with demanding clients is part and parcel of being a public relations consultant.
idioms.example_zh: 与苛刻的客户打交道是作为公关顾问必不可少的一部分。

idioms.phrase: a fool and his money are soon parted
idioms.meaning: 傻瓜存不住钱；愚人聚财易散财
idioms.example_en: He lost thousands on that fraudulent scheme—truly, a fool and his money are soon parted.
idioms.example_zh: 他在那个诈骗项目上损失了数千元——真是傻瓜存不住钱。

idioms.meaning: 至死不渝，直到死亡将我们分开
idioms.example_en: They exchanged marriage vows, promising to love and cherish each other till death do them part.
idioms.example_zh: 他们交换了结婚誓言，承诺彼此相爱珍重，至死不渝。

idioms.meaning: 就我而言，在我看来
idioms.example_en: For my part, I have no objections whatsoever to the revised proposal.
idioms.example_zh: 就我而言，我对修改后的提案没有任何异议。

idioms.meaning: 站在某人一边，支持/偏袒某人
idioms.example_en: Whenever my brother and I argued, my grandmother would always take my part.
idioms.example_zh: 每当我和弟弟争吵时，祖母总是站在我这一边。

idioms.meaning: 在……中起作用；参与……
idioms.example_en: Diet and regular physical activity play a crucial part in preventing chronic illnesses.
idioms.example_zh: 饮食和规律运动在预防慢性疾病方面起着至关重要的作用。

collocations.meaning: 分道扬镳，各自谋生；中止合作
collocations.example_en: The band parted ways due to irreconcilable creative differences.
collocations.example_zh: 由于无法调和的创作分歧，乐队最终分道扬镳。

collocations.meaning: 和平分手，友好协商解约
collocations.example_en: Although the contract was terminated prematurely, both parties parted amicably.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管合同提前终止，但双方是和平友善解约的。

collocations.example_en: Security guards quickly parted the crowd to allow the ambassador to exit safely.
collocations.example_zh: 安保人员迅速拨开人群，确保大使安全撤离。

collocations.meaning: 微微张嘴，启齿（欲言或表惊讶）
collocations.example_en: She parted her lips in astonishment upon hearing the stunning news.
collocations.example_zh: 听到这个震惊的消息，她惊讶得微微张开了嘴。

collocations.example_en: He parted the heavy velvet curtains to let the morning sunlight illuminate the room.
collocations.example_zh: 他拉开厚重的天鹅绒窗帘，让清晨的阳光照亮整个房间。

collocations.example_en: They parted reluctantly at the gate, promising to write every single day.
collocations.example_zh: 他们在检票口依依不舍地道别，并承诺每天都要写信。

senses.meaning: 将……置于（特定状态、困境中）
senses.example_en: His unexpected resignation placed the entire team in an awkward situation.
senses.example_zh: 他的突然辞职使整个团队陷入了尴尬的境地。

senses.example_en: The agency helped place her in a prestigious law firm after graduation.
senses.example_zh: 毕业后，职介机构帮助将她安置在了一家知名律师事务所工作。

senses.example_en: The coach placed high expectations on the young striker.
senses.example_zh: 主教练对这位年轻的前锋寄予了厚望。

senses.example_en: Strict restrictions were placed on foreign imports to protect local industries.
senses.example_zh: 为了保护本土产业，外国进口商品被施加了严格的限制。

senses.meaning: 使处于……之下（逮捕、监视、管辖等）
senses.example_en: The suspect was immediately placed under arrest at the airport.
senses.example_zh: 嫌疑人在机场当场被捕。

senses.meaning: 使处于（麻醉、重压等）生理或心理状态
senses.example_en: The patient was placed under general anesthesia before the surgery began.
senses.example_zh: 手术开始前，患者接受了全身麻醉。

senses.example_en: The company decided to place out the website redesign to a digital agency.
senses.example_zh: 公司决定将网站重新设计的工作外包给一家数字化代理机构。

senses.example_en: Social services worked hard to place out the orphans with loving families.
senses.example_zh: 社会福利部门努力将这些孤儿安置到有爱心的家庭中寄养。

senses.meaning: 将（订单、投资等）交给，托付给
senses.example_en: We chose to place our annual order with a certified local supplier.
senses.example_zh: 我们选择将年度订单托付给当地一家有资质的供应商。

senses.meaning: 把（孩子、宠物等）安置给，交给……照料
senses.example_en: The shelter successfully placed the rescued puppy with a young couple.
senses.example_zh: 救助站成功把这只获救的小狗安置在了一对年轻夫妇家中。

senses.meaning: 将……呈递给，提交给（供审阅或考虑）
senses.example_en: The committee placed the final proposal before the board for approval.
senses.example_zh: 委员会将最终提案提交给董事会审批。

senses.example_en: A responsible doctor always places the patient's well-being before financial gain.
senses.example_zh: 负责任的医生总是将患者的福祉置于经济利益之前。

senses.meaning: 将……抛在脑后，告别（痛苦或不快的过往）
senses.example_en: After years of counseling, she was finally able to place her trauma behind her.
senses.example_zh: 经过多年的心理咨询，她终于能够将曾经的创伤抛在脑后。

senses.example_en: The entire faculty placed their support behind the student-led reform.
senses.example_zh: 全体教职员工全力支持这场由学生主导的改革。

senses.meaning: 将……置于……之上，把……看得重于一切
senses.example_en: He has always placed honesty and integrity above personal success.
senses.example_zh: 他始终把诚实和正直看得高于个人成就。

idioms.meaning: 将某人奉若神明，盲目崇拜，偶像化
idioms.example_en: Fans often place movie stars on a pedestal, forgetting that they are flawed human beings.
idioms.example_zh: 粉丝常把影星奉若神明，却忘了他们也只是有缺点的凡人。

idioms.meaning: 认不出某人，记不得某人在何处见过
idioms.example_en: Her face seems strikingly familiar, but for the life of me, I simply cannot place her.
idioms.example_zh: 她的面孔看着极其眼熟，但我无论如何也想不起在哪儿见过她。

idioms.meaning: 乱七八糟，毫无条理；到处都是；心神不宁
idioms.example_en: His presentation was all over the place and failed to make a convincing argument.
idioms.example_zh: 他的演讲毫无头绪、东拉西扯，完全没有说服力。

idioms.meaning: 起初，一开始；（用于列举或解释原因）首先
idioms.example_en: If you had read the instructions carefully in the first place, we wouldn't be facing this mess.
idioms.example_zh: 要是你一开始就仔细阅读说明书，我们现在就不会面临这种烂摊子了。

idioms.meaning: 格格不入的，不相称的；不合时宜的
idioms.example_en: Dressed in casual jeans at the black-tie gala, he felt distinctly out of place.
idioms.example_zh: 穿着休闲牛仔裤出席这场要求穿燕尾礼服的盛会，他感觉格外格格不入。

idioms.meaning: 有利地位，显要位置，扬名立万的机会
idioms.example_en: After decades of tireless research, the young scientist finally secured her place in the sun.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数十年的不懈研究，这位年轻的科学家终于赢得了属于自己的一席之地。

collocations.example_en: Customers can place an order online and receive delivery within twenty-four hours.
collocations.example_zh: 顾客可以在线提交订单，并在24小时之内收到送达的货物。

collocations.example_en: Voters placed their faith in the progressive candidate's pledge to tackle inequality.
collocations.example_zh: 选民们把信任寄托在激进派候选人解决不平等问题的承诺上。

collocations.example_en: Modern tech companies place a high premium on creativity and adaptability.
collocations.example_zh: 现代科技企业极其重视员工的创造力与适应能力。

collocations.example_en: The local council decided to place strict restrictions on vehicular traffic in the old town.
collocations.example_zh: 市政委员会决定对老城区的机动车通行实施严格限制。

collocations.example_en: The emergency dispatcher placed a call directly to the nearest fire station.
collocations.example_zh: 应急调度员直接向最近的消防局拨通了电话。

collocations.meaning: 将过错/责任推卸给某人
collocations.example_en: It is totally unfair to place all the blame on the junior engineer for system collapse.
collocations.example_zh: 把整个系统崩溃的责任完全推卸到初级工程师身上是极其不公的。

collocations.example_en: The educational curriculum places special emphasis on critical thinking and problem-solving.
collocations.example_zh: 该教学大纲特别注重培养批判性思维与解决问题的能力。

senses.meaning: （导弹、飞机等）对准目标飞去，导向
senses.example_en: The heat-seeking missile homed in on the aircraft's exhaust.
senses.example_zh: 热寻导弹对准飞机的尾气喷口直飞过去。

senses.meaning: 把全部注意力集中于，重点关注
senses.example_en: The investigators quickly homed in on the suspect's financial records.
senses.example_zh: 调查人员迅速把注意力集中在嫌疑人的财务记录上。

senses.meaning: 追踪导向，对准（信号源或目标）
senses.example_en: The rescue radar homed onto the faint distress signal.
senses.example_zh: 救援雷达追踪导向了微弱的求救信号。

senses.meaning: 返回到，归宿于（栖息地或大本营）
senses.example_en: The migrating birds homed to their nesting grounds after the long journey.
senses.example_zh: 经过长途迁徙后，候鸟返回到了它们的筑巢地。

senses.example_en: The carrier pigeon managed to home back despite the severe storm.
senses.example_zh: 尽管遭遇了剧烈的暴风雨，信鸽还是成功飞回了巢穴。

idioms.meaning: 把（观点、事实）讲得清清楚楚，使深刻理解；击中要害
idioms.example_en: The coach used video analysis to drive home the importance of defense.
idioms.example_zh: 教练通过视频分析深刻强调了防守的重要性。

idioms.meaning: （批评、话语等）触及痛处，击中要害；被充分理解感受
idioms.example_en: Her harsh words really hit home, and he began to reconsider his lifestyle.
idioms.example_zh: 她严厉的话击中了他的痛处，他开始重新反思自己的生活方式。

idioms.meaning: 使某人深切意识到（某事的危险性、严重性等）
idioms.example_en: The documentary brought home to viewers the devastating reality of famine.
idioms.example_zh: 这部纪录片让观众深刻体会到了饥荒的残酷现实。

idioms.meaning: 挣钱养家；取得成功
idioms.example_en: Both partners work long hours to bring home the bacon for their growing family.
idioms.example_zh: 为了养活不断壮大的家庭，夫妻双方都长时间辛勤工作。

idioms.meaning: 别客气，拘束消除，就像在自己家里一样
idioms.example_en: Sit down, grab a drink, and please make yourself at home.
idioms.example_zh: 请坐，喝杯水，别客气就像在自己家一样。

idioms.phrase: close to home / hit close to home
idioms.meaning: 触及某人的痛处，说得太准让人感到不适
idioms.example_en: The movie's plot about job loss felt a little too close to home for many workers.
idioms.example_zh: 电影中关于失业的情节让许多工人感到过于切身体会，甚至有些扎心。

idioms.meaning: （恶行或错误）产生恶果，自食其果
idioms.example_en: His reckless financial decisions have finally come home to roost.
idioms.example_zh: 他鲁莽的财务决策终于让他自食其果。

idioms.phrase: eat sb out of house and home
idioms.meaning: 吃得极多，几乎把某人吃穷
idioms.example_en: Having three teenage boys around will quickly eat you out of house and home.
idioms.example_zh: 家里有三个十几岁的男孩子，很快就会把你给吃穷。

collocations.meaning: 感到自在放松；对...得心应手
collocations.example_en: It took only a few weeks for her to feel at home in the new office.
collocations.example_zh: 只过了几周，她在新办公室就感到无拘无束了。

collocations.meaning: 找到安身之处；（物品等）找到归宿或接收方
collocations.example_en: The abandoned puppy soon found a loving home with a local family.
collocations.example_zh: 那只被遗弃的小狗很快在当地一个家庭找到了充满爱的归宿。

collocations.meaning: 离开父母独立生活；离家出走
collocations.example_en: She left home at eighteen to attend university across the country.
collocations.example_zh: 她十八岁离家，去往全国另一头的大学就读。

collocations.example_en: They decided to settle down and make a home in the countryside.
collocations.example_zh: 他们决定安定下来，在乡村安家落户。

collocations.example_en: It's getting late, so we'd better head home before the storm hits.
collocations.example_zh: 天色已晚，我们最好在暴风雨来临前动身回家。

collocations.example_en: A crowd gathered at the airport to welcome the champions home.
collocations.example_zh: 人群聚集在机场，热烈欢迎冠军们凯旋回国。

senses.example_en: We need to find out what really happened before making any assumptions.
senses.example_zh: 在做出任何假设之前，我们需要查明真相。

senses.meaning: 识破某人的欺骗行为，查出某人的劣迹
senses.example_en: He told lies about his qualifications, but the company soon found him out.
senses.example_zh: 他在学历上撒了谎，但公司很快就识破了他的底细。

senses.example_en: The jury found for the plaintiff and awarded substantial compensation.
senses.example_zh: 陪审团裁定原告胜诉，并判给其巨额赔偿。

senses.example_en: The court found against the defendant due to insufficient evidence.
senses.example_zh: 由于证据不足，法庭裁定被告败诉。

senses.meaning: 不知不觉身处（某种境地）
senses.example_en: After wandering for an hour, she found herself in an unfamiliar part of town.
senses.example_zh: 闲逛了一个小时后，她发现自己不知不觉来到了一处陌生街区。

senses.meaning: 认识自我，明确人生目标
senses.example_en: He took a gap year traveling abroad to find himself.
senses.example_zh: 他休学一年出国旅行，以明确自己真正的人生追求。

phrasal_verbs.phrase: find in oneself to do sth

senses.meaning: （常用于否定或疑问句）鼓起勇气/下定决心做某事
senses.example_en: She could not find it in herself to forgive his repeated lies.
senses.example_zh: 她下定不了决心去原谅他一次又一次的谎言。

senses.meaning: 打听，深入了解（某事或某人）
senses.example_en: I'm trying to find out about local schools before we move there.
senses.example_zh: 我正打算在我们搬过去之前多了解一下当地的学校情况。

senses.example_en: The tribunal found the officer not guilty of misconduct.
senses.example_zh: 审判庭裁定该名警官渎职罪名不成立。

idioms.meaning: 适应新环境，逐渐自信熟练
idioms.example_en: It took him a couple of months to find his feet in the new role.
idioms.example_zh: 他在新岗位上花了几个月才慢慢适应并进入状态。

idioms.meaning: 敢于公开发表意见；找到独特的表达风格
idioms.example_en: She was timid at first, but she soon found her voice during debates.
idioms.example_zh: 起初她很胆小，但在辩论中很快就敢于自信表达观点了。

idioms.meaning: 找到去...的路线；辗转流入/进入
idioms.example_en: A significant amount of plastic waste finds its way into the oceans each year.
idioms.example_zh: 每年有大量的塑料废弃物流入海洋。

idioms.meaning: 吹毛求疵，挑剔，抱怨
idioms.example_en: No matter what we do, our manager always manages to find fault with our work.
idioms.example_zh: 不管我们怎么做，经理总能挑出我们工作中的毛病。

idioms.phrase: find a needle in a haystack
idioms.meaning: 大海捞针，极难找到
idioms.example_en: Searching for one lost earring on the crowded beach was like finding a needle in a haystack.
idioms.example_zh: 在拥挤的海滩上寻找一只遗失的耳环犹如大海捞针。

idioms.meaning: 寻求共同点，达成一致意见
idioms.example_en: Despite ideological differences, the two leaders managed to find common ground on trade.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管存在意识形态差异，两位领导人仍在贸易问题上找到了共同语言。

idioms.meaning: 得到...的青睐，受到赏识或支持
idioms.example_en: The proposed tax reforms did not find favour with the business community.
idioms.example_zh: 拟议中的税收改革方案并未受到商界的青睐。

collocations.phrase: find it hard / easy to do sth
collocations.meaning: 发觉做某事很困难/容易
collocations.example_en: Many foreigners find it hard to adapt to the local climate.
collocations.example_zh: 很多外国人发觉很难适应当地的气候。

collocations.example_en: Engineers are working around the clock to find a solution to the software bug.
collocations.example_zh: 工程师们正在夜以继日地工作，以找出修复该软件漏洞的解决方案。

collocations.example_en: Despite a packed schedule, she always finds time to exercise daily.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管日程排得满满当当，她每天总能挤出时间锻炼身体。

collocations.meaning: 在...中体现出来，通过...表达出来
collocations.example_en: His deep dissatisfaction found expression in a series of protest songs.
collocations.example_zh: 他的深重不满在一系列抗议歌曲中得到了充分体现。

collocations.example_en: Working parents constantly strive to find a balance between career and family life.
collocations.example_zh: 在职父母一直在努力寻求事业与家庭生活之间的平衡点。

collocations.meaning: 吃亏/付出代价后才明白
collocations.example_en: He found out to his cost that cheap tools often break on the first use.
collocations.example_zh: 他付出了代价才懂得廉价工具往往第一次用就会坏。

senses.example_en: I've been looking for my glasses everywhere, but I still can't find them.
senses.example_zh: 我到处找我的眼镜，但还是没找到。

senses.example_en: You're looking for trouble if you walk down that dark alley alone at night.
senses.example_zh: 要是你大半夜独自走那条漆黑的小巷，纯粹是自找麻烦。

senses.example_en: Look at that colorful bird sitting on the branch.
senses.example_zh: 看那只停在树枝上的色彩斑斓的鸟。

senses.example_en: The management team is looking at several ways to cut operating costs.
senses.example_zh: 管理层正在研究几种降低运营成本的方案。

senses.example_en: Could you look after my dog while I'm away on a business trip?
senses.example_zh: 我出差期间你能帮我照看一下我的狗吗？

senses.example_en: Don't worry about the conference logistics; my assistant will look after that.
senses.example_zh: 别担心会议后勤的事，我的助理会负责处理。

senses.example_en: We are all looking forward to our annual summer vacation.
senses.example_zh: 我们大家都十分期盼一年一度的暑假。

senses.example_en: If you don't recognize the word, look it up in the online dictionary.
senses.example_zh: 如果你不认识这个词，就在线查一下字典。

senses.example_en: Sales were slow last winter, but business is finally looking up.
senses.example_zh: 去年冬天销售低迷，但生意终于开始好转了。

senses.example_en: Be sure to look me up next time you are in New York.
senses.example_zh: 下次你来纽约，一定要来找我坐坐。

senses.example_en: Young athletes around the world look up to her as an inspirational leader.
senses.example_zh: 全世界的年轻运动员都视她为鼓舞人心的榜样并敬佩她。

senses.example_en: She never looks down on anyone just because they come from a humble background.
senses.example_zh: 她绝不会仅仅因为别人出身平凡而看不起对方。

senses.example_en: The police are looking into the circumstances surrounding the sudden accident.
senses.example_zh: 警方正在调查围绕该突发事故的具体情况。

senses.example_en: Looking back on his long career, he had very few regrets.
senses.example_zh: 回顾自己漫长的职业生涯，他几乎没有什么遗憾。

senses.example_en: She closed the gate behind her and walked away without looking back.
senses.example_zh: 她关上身后的大门，头也不回地走了。

senses.example_en: Look out! That ladder is about to fall over.
senses.example_zh: 小心！那个梯子快要倒了。

senses.example_en: The French windows look out over a quiet garden.
senses.example_zh: 落地窗朝外正对着一座宁静的花园。

senses.example_en: Drivers need to look out for pedestrians when turning at intersections.
senses.example_zh: 司机在路口转弯时需要留心行人。

senses.example_en: Good colleagues always look out for each other during stressful projects.
senses.example_zh: 好同事在面对高压项目时总会互相照应。

senses.example_en: I quickly looked through the headlines while drinking my morning coffee.
senses.example_zh: 我喝早咖啡时快速浏览了一下新闻头条。

senses.example_en: She looked through every drawer trying to find the missing passport.
senses.example_zh: 她翻遍了每一个抽屉，试图找到丢失的护照。

senses.example_en: He looked straight through me in the corridor, pretending we had never met.
senses.example_zh: 他在走廊里对我视而不见，装作我们从未认识一样。

senses.example_en: Could you look over my presentation slides and give me some suggestions?
senses.example_zh: 你能帮我过目一下演讲幻灯片并提些建议吗？

senses.example_en: The mechanic carefully looked over the engine before giving us an estimate.
senses.example_zh: 机械师在给我们报价前仔细查看了发动机。

senses.example_en: He stood in the middle of the room and looked around suspiciously.
senses.example_zh: 他站在房间中央，狐疑地四处打量。

senses.example_en: We spent the whole afternoon looking around the old cathedral.
senses.example_zh: 我们花了整个下午参观那座古老的大教堂。

senses.example_en: I have always looked upon him as an older brother rather than just a mentor.
senses.example_zh: 我一直把他当作兄长看待，而不仅仅是一位导师。

senses.example_en: A crowd of onlookers merely looked on while the two drivers argued.
senses.example_zh: 当两名司机争吵时，一群围观者只是在旁边冷眼旁观。

senses.meaning: 顺道探望，顺便拜访（确认是否安好）
senses.example_en: I promised to look in on my elderly neighbor on my way back from the store.
senses.example_zh: 我答应从商店回来的路上去顺道探望一下上了年纪的邻居。

senses.example_en: The surgical procedure looked so intense that she had to look away.
senses.example_zh: 那个手术过程看起来太吓人了，她不得不转过脸去。

senses.example_en: A visionary leader must look ahead and anticipate upcoming market shifts.
senses.example_zh: 有远见的领导者必须展望未来，预判即将到来的市场变革。

idioms.meaning: 容光焕发；极有魅力
idioms.example_en: Dressed in that tailored tuxedo, he looked like a million dollars.
idioms.example_zh: 穿上那套定制礼服，他看起来容光焕发、魅力非凡。

idioms.meaning: 一路走向成功；势如破竹
idioms.example_en: Since launching her startup last year, she has never looked back.
idioms.example_zh: 自从去年创立公司以来，她一路走高、蒸蒸日上。

idioms.meaning: 假装没看见；熟视无睹；姑息纵容
idioms.example_en: Officials were accused of looking the other way while illegal dumping occurred.
idioms.example_zh: 官员们被指控对非法倾倒垃圾的行为熟视无睹。

idioms.meaning: 乐观面对；看到事物积极的一面
idioms.example_en: Even when the flight was delayed, she looked on the bright side and read a good book.
idioms.example_zh: 即便航班延误，她也往好的一面看，读了一本好书。

idioms.meaning: 对某人怒目而视
idioms.example_en: His colleague looked daggers at him for revealing the surprise during the meeting.
idioms.example_zh: 同事因他在会议上泄露了惊喜而对他怒目而视。

idioms.meaning: 三思而后行
idioms.example_en: It is crucial to look before you leap when making major investment decisions.
idioms.example_zh: 在做出重大投资决策时，三思而后行至关重要。

collocations.example_en: Let's take a closer look at the financial data before reaching a conclusion.
collocations.example_zh: 在得出结论之前，让我们仔细审视一下这组财务数据。

collocations.meaning: 直视某人的眼睛（以示坦荡或诚实）
collocations.example_en: He couldn't look me in the eye when he gave his weak explanation.
collocations.example_zh: 他给出牵强的解释时，甚至不敢正眼看我。

collocations.meaning: 穿戴整洁利落；动作快点
collocations.example_en: Make sure you look sharp for your job interview tomorrow morning.
collocations.example_zh: 务必穿戴利落整洁去参加明早的求职面试。

collocations.meaning: 给某人一个眼神；瞪某人一眼
collocations.example_en: My mother gave me a stern look across the dinner table to quiet me down.
collocations.example_zh: 母亲在餐桌另一端严厉地瞪了我一眼，示意我安静。

collocations.meaning: 理论上看似可行；表面上看起来不错
collocations.example_en: The strategic plan looked good on paper, but practical execution failed.
collocations.example_zh: 这项战略计划在纸面上看起来很棒，但实际执行却失败了。

collocations.example_en: Let me have a look at your engine to see what is causing that strange noise.
collocations.example_zh: 让我看一下你的发动机，找出异响的成因。

senses.meaning: 需要某人返回，需要某人重新效力
senses.example_en: The company has hit a crisis and desperately needs its former CEO back.
senses.example_zh: 公司陷入了危机，迫切需要前任CEO重返岗位。

senses.meaning: 需要要回某物，需要某物归还
senses.example_en: You can borrow my laptop for the weekend, but I need it back by Monday morning.
senses.example_zh: 周末你可以借用我的笔记本电脑，但我周一早上必须用，得还给我。

senses.example_en: The puppy is scratching at the back door because it needs in.
senses.example_zh: 小狗正在抓后门，因为它想要进屋来。

senses.meaning: 渴望参与，想要分一杯羹
senses.example_en: This new venture looks extremely profitable, and several investors need in.
senses.example_zh: 这个新项目看起来利润极其丰厚，好几个投资人都渴望参与分一杯羹。

senses.example_en: The cat is sitting by the patio door meowing loudly because she needs out.
senses.example_zh: 猫咪坐在露台门边喵喵大叫，因为它想要出去。

senses.meaning: 迫切想要退出，想要摆脱/脱身
senses.example_en: He realized the partnership was going nowhere and knew he needed out immediately.
senses.example_zh: 他意识到这种合伙关系毫无前途，深知自己必须立即抽身离开。

senses.meaning: 需要某人在身边照料或陪伴
senses.example_en: While recovering from the major surgery, she really needs someone around at all times.
senses.example_zh: 从大手术中恢复期间，她身边的确随时都需要有人照料陪伴。

senses.example_en: Rapid urban development has created an urgent need for better public transit.
senses.example_zh: 快速的城市发展催生了对更好公共交通系统的迫切需求。

senses.meaning: （口语中）需要起床；需要被抱起/扶起
senses.example_en: The baby just woke up from her nap and is crying because she needs up.
senses.example_zh: 小宝宝刚午睡醒来，哭着要人抱起来。

senses.meaning: （口语中）需要下来；需要被放下来
senses.example_en: The toddler climbed onto the high chair on his own, but now he needs down.
senses.example_zh: 蹒跚学步的孩子自己爬上了高脚椅，但现在需要大人把他抱下来。

idioms.phrase: need sth like a hole in the head
idioms.meaning: 根本不需要某物；极不想要某物
idioms.example_en: With all my current deadlines, I need another project like a hole in the head.
idioms.example_zh: 眼下各种截稿期催得紧，我再接一个项目简直就是自找倒霉。

idioms.meaning: 必要的话；如果有需要
idioms.example_en: We can reschedule the team meeting for next Monday if need be.
idioms.example_zh: 如果有需要，我们可以把团队会议推迟到下周一。

idioms.phrase: a friend in need is a friend indeed
idioms.meaning: 患难之交才是真朋友
idioms.example_en: He stood by me during my bankruptcy, proving that a friend in need is a friend indeed.
idioms.example_zh: 在我破产时他对我施以援手，证明了患难见真情。

idioms.meaning: 妇孺皆知；无需赘言介绍
idioms.example_en: Our guest speaker tonight is a legend who needs no introduction.
idioms.example_zh: 今晚的演讲嘉宾是一位家喻户晓的传奇人物，无需赘述介绍。

idioms.meaning: 还用我多说吗？；不言而喻
idioms.example_en: The revenue dropped by eighty percent in one quarter; need I say more?
idioms.example_zh: 单季度营收暴跌了百分之八十，还用我多说什么吗？

idioms.meaning: 谁稀罕呢？；何必自讨苦吃
idioms.example_en: Dealing with all that political infighting every day—who needs it?
idioms.example_zh: 每天都要应对那种勾心斗角的内耗——谁稀罕受那份罪呢？

collocations.example_en: The local clinic is in dire need of fresh medical supplies and staff.
collocations.example_zh: 当地诊所急需补充医疗物资和医护人员。

collocations.example_en: The software update was customized to meet the specific needs of enterprise clients.
collocations.example_zh: 该软件更新进行了定制，以满足企业客户的特定需求。

collocations.example_en: The new resort caters to the needs of families traveling with young children.
collocations.example_zh: 这家新度假村专门迎合带着幼儿出行的家庭需求。

collocations.phrase: feel the need to do sth
collocations.example_en: I did not feel the need to defend myself against groundless accusations.
collocations.example_zh: 我觉得没有必要针对莫须有的指责去为自己辩解。

collocations.phrase: have no need to do sth
collocations.meaning: 无需做某事；没必要做某事
collocations.example_en: You have no need to apologize for an honest mistake made in good faith.
collocations.example_zh: 对于出于善意而犯的无心之失，你完全没必要道歉。

collocations.example_en: The drought-stricken farmlands desperately need rain to save this year's harvest.
collocations.example_zh: 遭受旱灾的农田急需降雨来挽救今年的收成。

senses.meaning: 发生，展现，展开（事件或情节）
senses.example_en: We'll just have to wait and see how the situation plays out.
senses.example_zh: 我们只能静观事态如何发展。

senses.example_en: The drama played out against the backdrop of the Cold War.
senses.example_zh: 这出戏剧在冷战时期的背景下缓缓落下帷幕。

senses.meaning: 使筋疲力尽，耗尽（常作 be played out）
senses.example_en: By the end of the marathon, all the runners were completely played out.
senses.example_zh: 马拉松结束时，所有选手都已精疲力竭。

senses.example_en: The government tried to play down the seriousness of the economic crisis.
senses.example_zh: 政府试图淡化这场经济危机的严重性。

senses.example_en: The media played up the minor scandal to boost their ratings.
senses.example_zh: 媒体大肆渲染这起小丑闻以提高收视率。

senses.example_en: The children always play up when they have a substitute teacher.
senses.example_zh: 一遇到代课老师，孩子们总是调皮捣蛋。

senses.meaning: （机器或身体部位）出毛病，疼痛
senses.example_en: My old knee injury has been playing up again in this damp weather.
senses.example_zh: 在这种潮湿天气里，我膝盖的老毛病又犯了。

senses.meaning: 假装配合，顺水推舟，暂时顺从
senses.example_en: I decided to play along with his plan until I figured out what he was really up to.
senses.example_zh: 我决定先顺着他的计划配合，直到弄清他的真实意图。

senses.example_en: He put on a jazz record and played along on his saxophone.
senses.example_zh: 他放了一张爵士唱片，跟着用萨克斯合奏起来。

senses.meaning: 利用（他人的弱点、恐惧、情感等）
senses.example_en: The advertisement plays on parents' fears about their children's safety.
senses.example_zh: 该广告利用了父母对孩子安全的担忧心理。

senses.meaning: 挑拨离间，使两方相争（play sb off against sb）
senses.example_en: She skillfully played the two rival companies off against each other to get a higher salary.
senses.example_zh: 她巧妙地让两家竞争公司互相竞价，从而获得了更高的薪水。

senses.example_en: Because of the tie, the two teams will have to play off next week.
senses.example_zh: 由于比分打平，两队下周必须进行加赛决出胜负。

senses.example_en: Stop playing around and finish your homework before dinner.
senses.example_zh: 别闹了，晚饭前把作业写完。

senses.example_en: Don't play around with that power drill—you might hurt yourself.
senses.example_zh: 别乱动那个电钻，小心伤到自己。

senses.meaning: 出轨，搞婚外情，寻欢作乐
senses.example_en: She divorced him after discovering he had been playing around behind her back.
senses.example_zh: 在发现他背着自己寻欢出轨后，她与他离了婚。

senses.example_en: He nervously played with his wedding ring during the interview.
senses.example_zh: 面试期间，他紧张地把玩着手上的婚戒。

senses.example_en: She realized that he was just playing with her feelings all along.
senses.example_zh: 她意识到他从始至终都只是在玩弄她的感情。

senses.meaning: 姑且考虑，不严肃地琢磨（想法、计划）
senses.example_en: We've been playing with the idea of moving to the countryside.
senses.example_zh: 我们最近一直在琢磨搬去乡下住的想法。

senses.example_en: The detective played back the surveillance video to catch any missed details.
senses.example_zh: 侦探回放了监控录像，以捕捉任何遗漏的细节。

senses.meaning: 正中……下怀，落入……圈套（常用 play into sb's hands）
senses.example_en: Losing your temper will only play into their hands.
senses.example_zh: 你要是发脾气，就正好中他们的下怀了。

senses.meaning: 心不在焉地做，漫不经心地搞（玩票）
senses.example_en: He's not a real painter; he's just playing at art.
senses.example_zh: 他并不是真正的画家，只不过是在艺术圈里玩票罢了。

senses.example_en: The children were playing at being astronauts in the backyard.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们在后院里假扮宇航员玩耍。

senses.meaning: 从头到尾演完或弹奏完
senses.example_en: The pianist played through the sonata once more before the concert.
senses.example_zh: 钢琴家在音乐会前又将那首奏鸣曲从头到尾弹了一遍。

senses.meaning: （高尔夫）让后一组先行穿过打球
senses.example_en: The group ahead of us was moving slowly, so they let us play through.
senses.example_zh: 前面的那一组打得比较慢，所以他们让我们先打过去。

senses.example_en: It took him nearly forty hours to play through the entire campaign.
senses.example_zh: 他花了将近四十个小时才把整个游戏战役通关。

senses.example_en: He was always playing up to the boss in hopes of getting a promotion.
senses.example_zh: 他总是巴结老板，希望能获得升职。

senses.example_en: She kept playing the awkward conversation over in her mind.
senses.example_zh: 她在脑海中一遍又一遍地回想着那段尴尬的对话。

senses.example_en: Let me play that tape over again so you can hear what she said.
senses.example_zh: 让我把那段录音再放一遍，好让你听听她说了什么。

senses.meaning: （体育运动中）从（困境、沙坑等恶劣位置）击出或化解
senses.example_en: The golfer managed to play out of the deep bunker with incredible precision.
senses.example_zh: 那位高尔夫球手以惊人的精准度成功将球从深沙坑中打了出来。

senses.meaning: 出任不熟悉的位置（体育竞赛）
senses.example_en: He was forced to play out of position due to several injuries in the squad.
senses.example_zh: 由于队内多人受伤，他不得不改打不熟悉的位置。

idioms.meaning: 见机行事；随机应变
