idioms.example_en: We don't have a strict itinerary for tomorrow, so let's just play it by ear.
idioms.example_zh: 我们明天没有固定的行程，所以到时候看情况见机行事吧。

idioms.meaning: 玩火；冒极大风险惹火烧身
idioms.example_en: Investing your life savings in high-risk stocks is really playing with fire.
idioms.example_zh: 把一生的积蓄投资在高风险股票上无异于玩火。

idioms.meaning: 采取强硬手段；态度坚决不妥协
idioms.example_en: If the union refuses our reasonable offer, management will have to play hardball.
idioms.example_zh: 如果工会拒绝我们合理的报价，管理层就不得不采取强硬手段了。

idioms.meaning: 故意唱反调；充当反对者以激发深入讨论
idioms.example_en: I agree with your proposal, but let me play devil's advocate to test its robustness.
idioms.example_zh: 我赞同你的提议，但我先故意唱个反调，来检验它是否足够严密。

idioms.meaning: 欲擒故纵；摆架子故作难以接近
idioms.example_en: Don't respond to his text immediately; play hard to get for a bit.
idioms.example_zh: 别马上回复他的短信，稍微欲擒故纵一下。

idioms.meaning: 屈居次席；充当副手；居于次要地位
idioms.example_en: After years of playing second fiddle, she finally took over as the head chef.
idioms.example_zh: 在当了多年副手后，她终于接任成为主厨。

idioms.meaning: 出牌得当；行事明智；处理得体
idioms.example_en: If you play your cards right, this internship could lead to a permanent job.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你处理得当，这次实习可能会转为正式职位。

collocations.example_en: Diet and exercise play a crucial role in maintaining heart health.
collocations.example_zh: 饮食和锻炼在维持心脏健康方面起着至关重要的作用。

collocations.meaning: 谨慎行事；稳扎稳打；不冒风险
collocations.example_en: Instead of launching a radical redesign, the company decided to play safe.
collocations.example_zh: 公司决定谨慎行事，不进行彻底的重新设计。

collocations.example_en: In any healthy competition, all participants are expected to play fair.
collocations.example_zh: 在任何良性竞争中，所有参与者都应当公平竞争。

collocations.meaning: 耍花招；虚伪不诚实；玩弄心机
collocations.example_en: Stop playing games and tell me directly what your bottom line is.
collocations.example_zh: 别耍心机了，直接告诉我你的底线是什么。

collocations.meaning: 捉弄；开……玩笑；（幻觉等）使产生错觉
collocations.example_en: The dim lighting was playing tricks on my eyes, making shadows look like figures.
collocations.example_zh: 昏暗的灯光让我产生了错觉，把影子看成了人影。

collocations.example_en: He always plays the fool to defuse tension during awkward social moments.
collocations.example_zh: 在尴尬的社交场合，他总是装疯卖傻来缓和紧张气氛。

senses.example_en: Don't give up now; you're so close to reaching your goal.
senses.example_zh: 别在这个时候放弃，你离目标就差一步了。

senses.example_en: His doctor advised him to give up smoking immediately.
senses.example_zh: 医生建议他立刻把烟戒掉。

senses.example_en: Surrounded by the police, the suspect finally gave up without a fight.
senses.example_zh: 在被警方包围后，嫌疑人最终束手就擒。

senses.meaning: 让出，把（时间、座位等）交出
senses.example_en: A young man gave up his seat to the elderly woman on the crowded bus.
senses.example_zh: 在拥挤的公交车上，一位年轻小伙把座位让给了一位老妇人。

senses.meaning: 对……绝望，死心，放弃对……的希望
senses.example_en: Despite his repeated failures, his parents never gave up on him.
senses.example_zh: 尽管他屡遭失败，父母却从未对他失去信心。

senses.example_en: After hours of negotiation, the management finally gave in to the union's demands.
senses.example_zh: 经过数小时的谈判，管理层最终向工会的要求做出了让步。

senses.example_en: Students must give in their essays by five o'clock on Friday.
senses.example_zh: 学生必须在周五下午五点前交上论文。

senses.example_en: The bakery gives away unsold bread to the local shelter at the end of each day.
senses.example_zh: 面包店每天打烊时都会把没卖完的面包免费送给当地庇护所。

senses.example_en: His trembling voice gave away how terrified he actually was.
senses.example_zh: 他颤抖的声音暴露了他内心其实有多么恐惧。

senses.meaning: （婚礼上父亲等）将新娘交给新郎
senses.example_en: Her father proudly walked her down the aisle to give her away.
senses.example_zh: 父亲自豪地挽着她走过红毯，将她交到了新郎手中。

senses.example_en: Volunteers were giving out free bottles of water along the marathon route.
senses.example_zh: 志愿者们在马拉松沿途分发免费瓶装水。

senses.meaning: 用尽，耗竭；（机器或体力）出故障，支撑不住
senses.example_en: After climbing for six hours, his legs finally gave out.
senses.example_zh: 连续攀爬六个小时后，他的双腿终于支撑不住了。

senses.example_en: The results of the examination will be given out tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 考试成绩将于明天上午公布。

senses.meaning: 散发出（气味、光、热、气体等）
senses.example_en: The rotting vegetation gave off a foul chemical odor.
senses.example_zh: 腐烂的植被散发出一股难闻的化学异味。

senses.example_en: Make sure you give back the library books before the due date.
senses.example_zh: 务必在到期日之前将图书馆的书归还。

senses.example_en: Now that he is successful, he wants to give back to his hometown.
senses.example_zh: 如今功成名就，他希望能回馈自己的家乡。

senses.example_en: The physical therapy gave her back the use of her legs.
senses.example_zh: 理疗帮助她重新恢复了双腿的行走能力。

senses.example_en: The old wooden bridge gave way under the weight of the heavy truck.
senses.example_zh: 那座老木桥在重型卡车的重压下轰然坍塌。

senses.example_en: Neither side was willing to give way during the bitter dispute.
senses.example_zh: 在激烈的争论中，双方谁也不肯退让。

senses.example_en: Drivers entering the roundabout must give way to traffic already on it.
senses.example_zh: 进入环岛的车辆必须给已在环岛内的车辆让行。

senses.meaning: 被……取代，让位于（give way to）
senses.example_en: Her initial shock soon gave way to profound relief.
senses.example_zh: 她最初的震惊很快转变为深深的释然。

senses.example_en: He gave over the management of the firm to his daughter.
senses.example_zh: 他将公司的经营管理权移交给了女儿。

senses.meaning: 停止（常用于祈使句，指讨厌的行为）
senses.example_en: Oh, give over complaining and help me with the dishes!
senses.example_zh: 哎呀，别再抱怨了，快来帮我洗碗！

senses.meaning: 专用于，拨作……之用（常用于被动语态）
senses.example_en: Most of the ground floor was given over to an open-plan kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 一楼的大部分空间都被改造成了开放式厨房。

senses.meaning: 沉溺于，全身心投入（常接 oneself to）
senses.example_en: He gave himself over to grief after his wife passed away.
senses.example_zh: 妻子去世后，他整个人沉浸在巨大的悲痛之中。

senses.example_en: The French doors in the living room give onto a sunlit balcony.
senses.example_zh: 客厅里的法式落地门通向一个洒满阳光的阳台。

senses.meaning: 慷慨付出，全心奉献（常与 oneself 连用）
senses.example_en: She generously gave of her free time to mentor underprivileged students.
senses.example_zh: 她毫不吝啬地奉献出自己的业余时间来辅导贫困学生。

senses.meaning: 发出，散发出（声音、气味、光等）
senses.example_en: The night-blooming flowers gave forth a sweet, intoxicating scent.
senses.example_zh: 夜间盛开的花朵散发出一股甜美而令人陶醉的芬芳。

senses.example_en: The spokesperson gave forth a statement denying all allegations.
senses.example_zh: 发言人发表声明，否认了所有指控。

senses.meaning: 屈服于，纵容（诱惑、压力、欲望等）
senses.example_en: Try not to give in to the temptation of snacking between meals.
senses.example_zh: 尽量克制，不要向两餐之间吃零食的诱惑妥协。

senses.example_en: The fugitive decided to give himself up to the police after months on the run.
senses.example_zh: 潜逃数月后，这名逃犯决定向警方自首。

senses.meaning: 沉溺于，沉浸在（某种情感中）
senses.example_en: She gave herself up to despair when she heard the tragic news.
senses.example_zh: 听到那个不幸的消息时，她陷入了绝望之中。

idioms.meaning: 互谅互让；相互妥协；交流互动
idioms.example_en: Any enduring marriage requires a fair amount of give and take.
idioms.example_zh: 任何持久的婚姻都需要相当程度的互谅互让。

idioms.meaning: 饶了某人；别苛求某人；给某人一次机会
idioms.example_en: Give him a break; it's only his first day on the job.
idioms.example_zh: 饶了他吧，今天只是他入职的第一天。

idioms.phrase: give sb the benefit of the doubt
idioms.meaning: 先相信某人是无辜的/善意的；姑且信之
idioms.example_en: I wasn't sure if his apology was sincere, but I decided to give him the benefit of the doubt.
idioms.example_zh: 我拿不准他的道歉是否真诚，但我还是决定先相信他一次。

idioms.meaning: 故意冷落/怠慢某人
idioms.example_en: Ever since their argument, she has been giving him the cold shoulder.
idioms.example_zh: 自从两人争吵之后，她就一直对他爱理不理。

idioms.phrase: give sb a run for their money
idioms.meaning: 成为强劲对手；让某人全力以赴才获胜
idioms.example_en: The underdog team gave the defending champions a real run for their money.
idioms.example_zh: 这支不被看好的队伍给卫冕冠军制造了极其激烈的竞争。

idioms.meaning: 引起；导致；造成
idioms.example_en: The ambiguous clause in the contract gave rise to numerous disputes.
idioms.example_zh: 合同中那条含糊不清的条款引发了诸多争议。

idioms.phrase: give it a shot / give it a whirl
idioms.meaning: 试一试；碰碰运气
idioms.example_en: I've never tried rock climbing before, but I'm eager to give it a shot.
idioms.example_zh: 我以前从未攀过岩，但我很想尝试一下。

collocations.example_en: Have you given any serious thought to what you want to study at university?
collocations.example_zh: 你有没有认真考虑过大学想学什么专业？

collocations.meaning: 优先考虑；置于首要地位
collocations.example_en: The council decided to give priority to green energy projects this fiscal year.
collocations.example_zh: 理事会决定在本财政年度优先考虑绿色能源项目。

collocations.example_en: Could you give me a hand moving this heavy bookcase into the study?
collocations.example_zh: 你能帮我一把，把这个沉重的书柜搬进书房吗？

collocations.example_en: We must give credit to the research team for their tireless dedication.
collocations.example_zh: 我们必须对研发团队不知疲倦的奉献予以肯定和赞赏。

collocations.example_en: The doctor cannot perform the operation until the patient gives consent.
collocations.example_zh: 在病人同意之前，医生不能进行手术。

collocations.example_en: The witness was asked to give a detailed account of the accident.
collocations.example_zh: 目击者被要求详细叙述事故的经过。

senses.example_en: Her claims were backed up by solid documentary evidence.
senses.example_zh: 她的说法得到了确凿的文献证据支持。

senses.example_en: Remember to back up all your critical files before upgrading the system.
senses.example_zh: 在升级系统之前，记得备份所有重要文件。

senses.example_en: He backed up the truck slowly into the tight garage space.
senses.example_zh: 他慢慢把卡车倒进了狭小的车库车位里。

senses.example_en: Traffic backed up for miles along the motorway after the accident.
senses.example_zh: 事故发生后，高速公路上的车流堵塞了数英里。

senses.meaning: 让步，认输，放弃先前的要求或立场
senses.example_en: Neither side was willing to back down, leading to a prolonged strike.
senses.example_zh: 双方都不肯退让，导致了旷日持久的罢工。

senses.example_en: He promised to invest in the startup, but backed out at the last minute.
senses.example_zh: 他答应过要投资这家初创公司，却在最后一刻反悔退出了。

senses.example_en: She carefully backed out of the narrow driveway into the road.
senses.example_zh: 她小心翼翼地把车从狭窄的车道倒出来驶上公路。

senses.example_en: The stray dog growled, warning the stranger to back off.
senses.example_zh: 流浪狗发出低吼，警告陌生人往后退。

senses.meaning: 别管闲事，停止纠缠或施压
senses.example_en: Back off and let me handle my own personal life.
senses.example_zh: 少管闲事，让我自己处理个人私生活。

senses.meaning: 放慢（攻击、批评）节奏，缓和态度
senses.example_en: The media backed off after the company issued a clarifying statement.
senses.example_zh: 在公司发表澄清声明后，媒体缓和了攻势。

senses.example_en: She slowly backed away from the edge of the steep cliff.
senses.example_zh: 她小心翼翼地从陡峭的悬崖边缘往后退。

senses.meaning: 回避，逐渐放弃（原计划或观点）
senses.example_en: The board began to back away from the controversial proposal.
senses.example_zh: 董事会开始逐渐放弃这项备受争议的提案。

senses.meaning: 违约，单方面撤出（合同、协议或承诺）
senses.example_en: It is too late now to back out of the sales contract without paying a penalty.
senses.example_zh: 现在想单方面退出买卖合同而不支付违约金已经太晚了。

senses.example_en: I accidentally backed into a lamppost while trying to park.
senses.example_zh: 我停车时不小心倒车撞上了一根路灯柱。

senses.example_en: She expertly backed into the empty parking spot on the street.
senses.example_zh: 她熟练地将车倒进了街边的空车位里。

senses.example_en: He almost backed into a career in publishing by taking a temporary editing job.
senses.example_zh: 他接了一份临时编辑工作，结果无意中踏入了出版行业。

senses.meaning: （房屋、建筑物等）后方紧邻，背靠
senses.example_en: Their house backs onto a quiet pine forest.
senses.example_zh: 他们的房子后面紧邻着一片静谧的松树林。

senses.meaning: 从（对峙、承诺或既定立场）退缩，放弃进行
senses.example_en: The government backed off from its initial plan to raise the fuel tax.
senses.example_zh: 政府放弃了最初提高燃油税的计划。

senses.example_en: He didn't see the bicycle lying on the driveway and backed over it.
senses.example_zh: 他没看到车道上的自行车，倒车时直接轧了过去。

idioms.meaning: 押错宝，看错人，支持注定失败的一方
idioms.example_en: By investing heavily in that outdated technology, they backed the wrong horse.
idioms.example_zh: 他们在那项过时的技术上投入重金，显然是押错了宝。

idioms.meaning: 全力以赴支持某人，毫无保留地支持到底
idioms.example_en: The board assured the CEO that they would back his restructuring plan to the hilt.
idioms.example_zh: 董事会向首席执行官保证，他们将全力以赴支持他的重组计划。

idioms.meaning: 将某人逼入绝境，使某人走投无路而不得不反击
idioms.example_en: The aggressive cross-examination backed the suspect into a corner.
idioms.example_zh: 咄咄逼人的交叉盘问将嫌疑人逼入了无路可退的死角。

idioms.meaning: 优柔寡断，反复变卦，立场动摇不定
idioms.example_en: The committee has spent months backing and filling instead of taking decisive action.
idioms.example_zh: 委员会数月来优柔寡断、反复变卦，而不是采取果断行动。

idioms.meaning: 两头下注，同时支持对立双方以确保自己不输
idioms.example_en: The pragmatic businessman decided to back both horses by funding both political parties.
idioms.example_zh: 这位务实的商人决定两头下注，同时资助两个对立政党。

collocations.example_en: Local residents solidly backed the campaign to protect the historic park.
collocations.example_zh: 当地居民坚定支持保护这座历史公园的行动。

collocations.meaning: 支持一项提案/法案/计划
collocations.example_en: Most senators agreed to back the healthcare reform bill.
collocations.example_zh: 大多数参议员同意支持这项医疗改革法案。

collocations.meaning: 在经济上资助某事，为……提供资金后盾
collocations.example_en: Several venture capital firms stepped in to back the clean energy project financially.
collocations.example_zh: 几家风投机构介入，为该清洁能源项目提供资金支持。

collocations.meaning: 用证据支持/证实某种说法
collocations.example_en: You must back your academic claims with rigorous empirical evidence.
collocations.example_zh: 你必须用严密的实证证据来支撑你的学术主张。

collocations.example_en: The union voted overwhelmingly to back the incumbent candidate in the upcoming election.
collocations.example_zh: 工会以压倒性多数投票支持现任候选人连任。

senses.meaning: 郑重声明，正式记录在案（作为法定或正式用语）
senses.example_en: I wish to state for the record that I strongly object to this decision.
senses.example_zh: 我想郑重声明并记录在案：我强烈反对这项决定。

senses.meaning: 宣誓陈述，在宣誓后作证
senses.example_en: The witness stated under oath that she saw the defendant at the scene.
senses.example_zh: 证人宣誓陈述称，她确实在案发现场见到了被告。

senses.example_en: Any amendment to the agreement must be stated in writing and signed by both parties.
senses.example_zh: 协议的任何修改均须以书面形式列明，并由双方签字。

senses.meaning: 详细陈述，逐一具体说明
senses.example_en: The applicant was asked to state in detail their relevant work experience.
senses.example_zh: 申请人被要求详细说明其相关的工作经历。

senses.meaning: 陈述如下，具体内容列明如下
senses.example_en: The official policy regarding refunds states as follows.
senses.example_zh: 关于退款的官方政策内容陈述如下。

senses.meaning: 作出相反陈述/声明，提出反对意见
senses.example_en: Unless the contract states to the contrary, the delivery fee is paid by the buyer.
senses.example_zh: 除非合同中另有相反声明，否则运费由买方承担。

senses.example_en: Please state in full your name, date of birth, and current address.
senses.example_zh: 请完整填写您的全名、出生日期以及现居住址。

senses.meaning: 把……当作事实陈述，指称某事为定论
senses.example_en: You cannot state as a fact something that has not been scientifically verified.
senses.example_zh: 你不能把尚未经过科学验证的事情当作既定事实来陈述。

idioms.meaning: 阐明自己的论点/理由，为自己的立场辩护
idioms.example_en: The union representatives were given thirty minutes to state their case before management.
idioms.example_zh: 工会代表获得了三十分钟时间在管理层面前陈述他们的诉求与理由。

idioms.meaning: 说人尽皆知的大实话，讲显而易见的废话
idioms.example_en: At the risk of stating the obvious, running out of cash will bankrupt the firm.
idioms.example_zh: 虽然说这可能是句显而易见的废话，但资金链断裂确实会让公司破产。

idioms.meaning: 开出条件，明确提出要求或底线
idioms.example_en: The kidnappers stated their terms in a short recorded message delivered to the police.
idioms.example_zh: 绑匪在递交给警方的一段简短录音中开出了他们的条件。

idioms.meaning: 表明态度，正式表态立场
idioms.example_en: The prime minister clearly stated her position regarding national sovereignty.
idioms.example_zh: 首相在国家主权问题上明确表明了她的坚定立场。

idioms.meaning: 正式表达偏好，明确声明意向
idioms.example_en: When asked about the relocation, none of the employees stated a clear preference.
idioms.example_zh: 当被问及岗位调动时，没有一位员工明确表达过自己的偏好。

collocations.meaning: 清楚/明确地陈述，毫无含糊地说明
collocations.example_en: The policy states clearly that refunds are not permitted after thirty days.
collocations.example_zh: 该政策明确规定三十天后概不退款。

collocations.meaning: 毫不含糊地声明，斩钉截铁地表示
collocations.example_en: The spokesperson stated unequivocally that no troops would be deployed.
collocations.example_zh: 发言人斩钉截铁地声明绝不会派驻军队。

collocations.example_en: The senator has publicly stated that he will not seek another term.
collocations.example_zh: 这位参议员已公开声明他将不再寻求连任。

collocations.example_en: As stated above, all expenditures must be approved by the chief financial officer.
collocations.example_zh: 如上所述，所有支出均须经首席财务官批准。

collocations.example_en: The employee resigned without stating a reason for his sudden departure.
collocations.example_zh: 该员工离职时并未陈述他突然离开的原因。

senses.example_en: Tears welled up in her eyes when she heard the touching story.
senses.example_zh: 听到那个感人的故事时，泪水涌上了她的眼眶。

senses.meaning: （强烈情感）涌上心头，油然而生
senses.example_en: A deep sense of pride welled up inside him as his daughter received the award.
senses.example_zh: 当女儿领奖时，一股强烈的自豪感在他心头油然而生。

senses.example_en: The boiling soup began to well over the rim of the pot.
senses.example_zh: 沸腾的热汤开始从锅边漫溢出来。

senses.example_en: His suppressed anger finally welled over during the heated argument.
senses.example_zh: 在激烈的争吵中，他压抑已久的愤怒终于爆发外露。

senses.meaning: （液体或气体）喷涌而出，汩汩流出
senses.example_en: Blood welled out of the deep cut on his arm.
senses.example_zh: 鲜血从他手臂上深深的伤口中汩汩流出。

senses.meaning: （大量泉水等）奔涌而出，倾泻而出
senses.example_en: Fresh mountain water welled forth from the rocky crevice.
senses.example_zh: 清冽的山泉从岩石缝隙中奔涌而出。

senses.meaning: （声音、灵感等）倾泻而出，洋溢而出
senses.example_en: Magnificent music welled forth from the grand organ.
senses.example_zh: 宏伟的音乐从管风琴中倾泻而出。

senses.example_en: Clear spring water welled from beneath the limestone rocks.
senses.example_zh: 清澈的泉水从石灰岩石下方源源不断地流出。

senses.example_en: Her deep compassion welled from personal experiences of hardship.
senses.example_zh: 她深切的同情心源自她自身历经艰难的经历。

senses.example_en: Muddy rainwater welled into the basement through the broken window.
senses.example_zh: 浑浊的雨水顺着破损的窗户涌入了地下室。

senses.example_en: Groundwater began to well through the hairline cracks in the concrete.
senses.example_zh: 地下水开始顺着混凝土上的细小裂缝渗透冒出。

senses.example_en: The excess rainwater welled away through the newly dug drainage ditches.
senses.example_zh: 多余的雨水顺着新挖的排水沟流淌散开。

idioms.meaning: 也，还；同样
idioms.example_en: She speaks fluent French and German, and understands a bit of Italian as well.
idioms.example_zh: 她法语和德语说得很流利，而且也懂一点意大利语。

idioms.meaning: 除……之外还；不仅……而且
idioms.example_en: The training program covers technical skills as well as leadership development.
idioms.example_zh: 该培训计划不仅包含专业技能，还涵盖领导力的培养。

idioms.phrase: might as well / may as well
idioms.meaning: 不妨，倒不如，还不如做某事
idioms.example_en: Since the meeting was canceled, we might as well grab an early lunch together.
idioms.example_zh: 既然会议取消了，我们倒不如一起提早去吃午饭。

idioms.meaning: 诚然不错，很好（但后面常接转折）
idioms.example_en: High profits are all well and good, but employee safety should always come first.
idioms.example_zh: 高利润诚然很好，但员工的安全必须始终放在第一位。

idioms.meaning: 完全地，彻底地，不折不扣地
idioms.example_en: By midnight, the tired travelers were well and truly lost in the foggy mountains.
idioms.example_zh: 到了半夜，疲惫的旅行者们在大雾弥漫的群山中彻底迷失了方向。

idioms.meaning: 维持现状，切勿画蛇添足，知足常乐
idioms.example_en: The engine is running fine now, so let's just leave well enough alone instead of tinkering further.
idioms.example_zh: 发动机现在运转良好，我们还是维持现状吧，别再去瞎折腾了。

idioms.meaning: 幸好，幸亏如此，万幸
idioms.example_en: It's just as well you brought an umbrella, as the sky has suddenly turned completely dark.
idioms.example_zh: 幸亏你带了伞，天色突然全暗下来了。

idioms.meaning: 健在；依然盛行，充满生机
idioms.example_en: Despite rumors of its decline, the traditional craft is alive and well in the rural villages.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管有衰落的传闻，这种传统手工艺在乡村地区依然充满生机。

collocations.example_en: The steady growth in consumer spending bodes well for the upcoming holiday retail season.
collocations.example_zh: 消费者支出的稳步增长预示着即将到来的假日零售季有好兆头。

collocations.meaning: 表现出色；取得成功；繁荣昌盛；康复良好
collocations.example_en: She did exceptionally well in the interview and was offered the position immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 她在面试中表现极为出色，并立刻获得了录用通知。

collocations.example_en: Don't be offended by his direct advice; he really means well.
collocations.example_zh: 别为他直率的建议感到不快，他确实是出于好意。

collocations.example_en: Management is well aware of the current staffing shortages and is actively recruiting.
collocations.example_zh: 管理层充分意识到了当前人员短缺的问题，正在积极开展招聘。

collocations.example_en: Every client she has ever worked with speaks very well of her professionalism.
collocations.example_zh: 每一位与她合作过的客户都对她的敬业精神赞不绝口。

collocations.meaning: 非常值得（投入时间、精力或金钱）
collocations.example_en: The breathtaking view from the summit was well worth the grueling four-hour hike.
collocations.example_zh: 从山顶俯瞰的壮丽景色，绝对配得上那段长达四个小时的艰难跋涉。

collocations.meaning: 祝福某人，祝某人一切顺利
collocations.example_en: All his colleagues gathered to wish him well on his new career venture.
collocations.example_zh: 所有的同事都聚在一起，祝愿他在新的职业生涯中一切顺利。

senses.example_en: He slipped on the icy patch but quickly managed to right himself.
senses.example_zh: 他在结冰的路面上滑了一下，但很快稳住了身形。

senses.example_en: After years of reckless living, he finally made an effort to right himself.
senses.example_zh: 经过多年的放荡生活后，他终于努力改过自新。

senses.example_en: The lifeboat was designed to right itself even in severe waves.
senses.example_zh: 这艘救生艇设计成即使在巨浪中也能自行扶正。

senses.meaning: （局势、经济等）自发好转，重回正轨
senses.example_en: Given enough time, the market will naturally right itself.
senses.example_zh: 只要给足够的时间，市场自然会重回正轨。

senses.meaning: 把（翻倒的物体）扶正，摆正
senses.example_en: The workers rushed over to right up the fallen scaffolding.
senses.example_zh: 工人们赶过去把倒塌的脚手架扶正摆好。

senses.example_en: She righted up in her seat as the interviewers entered the room.
senses.example_zh: 当面试官走进房间时，她在座位上挺直了身子。

senses.meaning: 彻底整顿纠正；平息平定下来
senses.example_en: The new manager worked hard to right down the administrative confusion in the office.
senses.example_zh: 新经理努力彻底整顿办公室内部的行政混乱局面。

senses.example_en: The mechanic used a hydraulic clamp to right out the bent frame.
senses.example_zh: 修理工使用液压钳将弯曲的车架彻底拉直复位。

senses.example_en: We need a transparent discussion to right out these misunderstandings.
senses.example_zh: 我们需要进行一次坦诚的讨论，以彻底消除这些误解。

senses.meaning: 掉转方向并纠偏；使彻底改观
senses.example_en: The captain ordered the crew to right about the vessel before reaching the shallow water.
senses.example_zh: 船长命令船员在到达浅水区之前将船只掉转方向以纠正航向。

senses.meaning: 把（倾斜或翻转的物体）彻底翻正过来
senses.example_en: They used a crane to right over the overturned truck on the highway.
senses.example_zh: 他们用起重机把高速公路上翻倒的卡车彻底翻正过来。

senses.meaning: 全面贯穿调整；彻底修正到位
senses.example_en: The engineering team reviewed the system to right through all critical safety issues.
senses.example_zh: 工程团队对系统进行了全面审查，彻底修正了所有关键的安全隐患。

idioms.meaning: 立刻，马上，毫不迟疑地
idioms.example_en: Please send the finalized contract to legal right away for their signature.
idioms.example_zh: 请立即把定稿的合同发给法务部门签字。

idioms.meaning: 从一开始，立即，开门见山
idioms.example_en: Right off the bat, she made it clear that budget cuts would be inevitable.
idioms.example_zh: 她一开场就明确表示削减预算是不可避免的。

idioms.meaning: 按理说，照理应该，按理应当
idioms.example_en: By rights, the championship trophy belongs to our team based on overall performance.
idioms.example_zh: 按理说，根据整体表现，冠军奖杯本应属于我们队。

idioms.meaning: 神志正常，头脑清醒
idioms.example_en: No one in their right mind would attempt to cross the desert on foot in midsummer.
idioms.example_zh: 任何神志正常的人都不会尝试在仲夏徒步穿过沙漠。

idioms.meaning: 走在正确的轨道上，思路正确，方向对头
idioms.example_en: Your preliminary test results show that you are definitely on the right track with this research.
idioms.example_zh: 你的初步测试结果表明，这项研究的方向绝对是正确的。

idioms.meaning: 切中要害；拿捏得恰到好处；引起广泛共鸣
idioms.example_en: Her keynote speech hit the right note with both younger staff and senior executives.
idioms.example_zh: 她的主旨演讲拿捏得恰到好处，引起了年轻员工和高层主管的共鸣。

idioms.meaning: 就在某人眼皮底下（却未被察觉）
idioms.example_en: The missing documents had been sitting on the conference table right under his nose.
idioms.example_zh: 遗失的文件一直就放在会议桌上，就在他的眼皮底下。

idioms.phrase: have two left feet / put a foot wrong
idioms.meaning: 犯错，失足（反义表达：never put a foot right / never put a foot wrong）
idioms.example_en: Throughout the rigorous press conference, the seasoned diplomat didn't put a foot wrong.
idioms.example_zh: 在整场严苛的记者会上，这位经验丰富的外交官没有出任何差错。

collocations.meaning: 平反冤屈；纠正错误；拨乱反正
collocations.example_en: The newly discovered forensic evidence helped right a devastating judicial wrong.
collocations.example_zh: 新发现的法医物证帮助平反了一起毁灭性的司法冤案。

collocations.meaning: 收拾局面；纠正错误；恢复正常秩序
collocations.example_en: He promised to do whatever it takes to set things right with his estranged family.
collocations.example_zh: 他承诺将不惜一切代价来修复与疏远家人的关系，让一切重归于好。

collocations.example_en: It serves him right that he got a speeding ticket after driving so recklessly.
collocations.example_zh: 他开车那么鲁莽，被开超速罚单真是活该。

collocations.meaning: 把……做对；准确理解；恰当处理
collocations.example_en: It took several attempts to get the delicate recipe exactly right.
collocations.example_zh: 经过多次尝试，才把这份讲究的食谱拿捏得完全到位。

collocations.phrase: have the right to do sth
collocations.example_en: Every citizen has the fundamental right to express their opinions peacefully.
collocations.example_zh: 每一位公民都拥有和平表达个人意见的基本权利。

collocations.meaning: 捍卫自己的权益；挺身维护权利
collocations.example_en: The union encouraged all employees to stand up for their rights to fair wages.
collocations.example_zh: 工会鼓励所有员工挺身而出，捍卫自己获得合理薪酬的权利。

collocations.example_en: Entering the emerging electric vehicle market at the right time proved crucial to their success.
collocations.example_zh: 在恰当的时机切入新兴的电动汽车市场，对他们的成功起到了至关重要的作用。

senses.meaning: 坚强起来，振作起来，拿出男子汉气概
senses.example_en: You need to man up and tell your boss that you made a mistake.
senses.example_zh: 你得坚强起来，勇敢去向老板承认你犯了错。

senses.example_en: Instead of blaming others, it's time for him to man up and deal with the consequences.
senses.example_zh: 他与其推卸责任，不如现在就勇敢担起后果。

senses.meaning: 有人倒下，有人受伤（常用于军事、应急或网络游戏中发出警告）
senses.example_en: The medic shouted 'Man down!' as soon as the gunshot echoed across the courtyard.
senses.example_zh: 枪声在院子里回荡，卫生兵立刻高喊：“有人倒下了！”

senses.example_en: Don't man down now; we're only five miles away from the summit.
senses.example_zh: 别在这个时候退缩，我们距离山顶只剩五英里了。

senses.meaning: 为……配备人员，安排人手驻守
senses.example_en: The rescue team manned the command post with their most experienced specialists.
senses.example_zh: 救援队派出了经验最丰富的专家来坐镇指挥部。

senses.meaning: 组织人员防守以抵御（攻击、灾害或危险）
senses.example_en: Volunteers manned the barriers against the rising floodwaters all night.
senses.example_zh: 志愿者们整夜驻守在防洪堤前以抵御不断上涨的洪水。

idioms.meaning: 说话算话的人，守信用的男子
idioms.example_en: You can trust him completely; he is always a man of his word.
idioms.example_zh: 你可以完全信任他，他一向言出必行。

idioms.meaning: 人人自保，各自为战
idioms.example_en: When the ship started sinking, it was every man for himself.
idioms.example_zh: 轮船开始下沉时，大家只能各自逃命。

idioms.meaning: 无一例外地，全体一致地
idioms.example_en: The committee rejected the proposal to a man.
idioms.example_zh: 委员会全体一致拒绝了这项提案。

idioms.meaning: 风云人物，当红人物，焦点人物
idioms.example_en: After scoring the winning goal, he was the man of the hour.
idioms.example_zh: 踢进绝杀球后，他成了全场瞩目的风云人物。

idioms.phrase: separate the men from the boys
idioms.meaning: 见真章，考验谁是真正强者/成熟老练者
idioms.example_en: This brutal marathon will really separate the men from the boys.
idioms.example_zh: 这场极其艰难的马拉松将真正考验谁是真正的强者。

idioms.meaning: 独立自主，不受他人摆布
idioms.example_en: He left the family business because he wanted to be his own man.
idioms.example_zh: 他离开了家族企业，因为他想独立自主地打拼。

idioms.meaning: 与众不同的人，被排斥的人，多余者
idioms.example_en: Being the only non-smoker in the group made him feel like the odd man out.
idioms.example_zh: 作为聚会中唯一不抽烟的人，他觉得自己像个局外人。

collocations.meaning: 守在电话旁，负责接听电话
collocations.example_en: Volunteers manned the phones throughout the 24-hour charity event.
collocations.example_zh: 志愿者在24小时慈善活动期间一直坚守在电话机旁。

collocations.meaning: 坚守前台/接待处，值守服务台
collocations.example_en: Who will be manning the reception desk while Sarah is on leave?
collocations.example_zh: 萨拉休假期间谁来值守前台？

collocations.meaning: 把守街垒；投身抗争/捍卫阵地
collocations.example_en: Workers manned the barricades to protest against the plant closure.
collocations.example_zh: 工人们把守街垒，抗议工厂倒闭。

collocations.meaning: 竭力抢救危局，全力应付紧急危机
collocations.example_en: The executive team had to man the pumps to prevent bankruptcy.
collocations.example_zh: 高管团队不得不全力以赴抢救危局以防破产。

collocations.example_en: With a seasoned CEO manning the helm, the company navigated the crisis.
collocations.example_zh: 在一任经验丰富的首席执行官掌舵下，公司渡过了危机。

collocations.example_en: The new emergency ward is modern and fully manned.
collocations.example_zh: 新的急诊病房设施现代且人员配备齐全。

senses.example_en: He used a heavy roller to even out the bumps on the lawn.
senses.example_zh: 他用重型压路机把草坪上的坑洼压平。

senses.example_en: The new tax policy aims to even out wealth disparities across regions.
senses.example_zh: 新税收政策旨在拉平各地区之间的贫富差距。

senses.example_en: House prices fluctuated wildly last year but have started to even out.
senses.example_zh: 去年房价剧烈波动，但现在已经开始趋于稳定。

senses.example_en: A late goal by the substitute evened up the score just before full-time.
senses.example_zh: 替补队员在终场哨响前进球，将比分扳平。

senses.example_en: I'll transfer you fifty dollars tonight so we can even up the dinner bill.
senses.example_zh: 我今晚转你五十美元，这样晚餐账单咱们就结清了。

senses.example_en: Use the shears to even off the ragged edges of the hedge.
senses.example_zh: 用大剪刀把树篱参差不齐的边缘修整平齐。

senses.example_en: Inflation rates are expected to even off in the second half of the year.
senses.example_zh: 预计通胀率将在今年下半年持平企稳。

idioms.meaning: 向某人报复，与某人扯平恩怨
idioms.example_en: He promised himself that he would get even with the rival who betrayed him.
idioms.example_zh: 他暗自发誓一定要报复背叛他的竞争对手。

idioms.meaning: 盈亏平衡，不赚不赔，保本
idioms.example_en: The startup managed to break even in its second year of operations.
idioms.example_zh: 这家初创公司在运营的第二年实现了收支平衡。

idioms.meaning: 即便如此，尽管那样
idioms.example_en: The weather was terrible; even so, they decided to go hiking.
idioms.example_zh: 天气非常糟糕；即便如此，他们还是决定去徒步。

idioms.meaning: 平稳地，稳定地运行
idioms.example_en: It took several months to get the business back on an even keel.
idioms.example_zh: 花了几个月的时间才让业务重新恢复平稳运转。

idioms.meaning: 扳平比分；报仇，扯平宿怨
idioms.example_en: She scored in the final minute to even the score at 2-2.
idioms.example_zh: 她在最后一分钟进球，将比分扳平为2比2。

idioms.meaning: 公平竞争的机会，平等的机会
idioms.example_en: All he ever asked for was an even break in the market.
idioms.example_zh: 他一直以来所要求的只是市场上一个公平竞争的机会。

collocations.meaning: 消除差距/分歧，抹平差异
collocations.example_en: Tax reforms are aimed at evening out the economic disparities across regions.
collocations.example_zh: 税制改革旨在缩小不同地区之间的经济差距。

collocations.meaning: 扯平胜算，增加对等的机会
collocations.example_en: New technology has helped even the odds for smaller independent firms.
collocations.example_zh: 新技术帮助规模较小的独立公司拉平了竞争胜算。

collocations.example_en: The irrigation system ensures an even distribution of water across the field.
collocations.example_zh: 该灌溉系统确保了水在整片农田中的均匀分布。

collocations.meaning: 对半的几率，五五开的机会
collocations.example_en: Doctors said that the patient has an even chance of full recovery.
collocations.example_zh: 医生说病人有五成的希望完全康复。

collocations.example_en: Despite her internal anger, she replied in a perfectly even tone.
collocations.example_zh: 尽管内心愤怒，她还是用非常平静的语气作答。

collocations.example_en: The houses on this side of the street all have even numbers.
collocations.example_zh: 街道这侧的房屋都是双数门牌号。

senses.meaning: 认真钻研，突击温习（某一主题）
senses.example_en: I need to study up on tax laws before the client meeting tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 在明天见客户之前，我得突击学习一下税法。

senses.example_en: She had the privilege of studying under one of the world's finest pianists.
senses.example_zh: 她有幸师从于世界上最杰出的钢琴大师之一。

senses.meaning: 为（考试、学位、资格证等）备考学习
senses.example_en: He spends nearly six hours a day studying for the bar exam.
senses.example_zh: 他每天花将近六个小时备考律师资格考试。

senses.example_en: The committee was formed to study into the long-term effects of the policy.
senses.example_zh: 该委员会的成立旨在深入调查这项政策的长期影响。

senses.example_en: I walked into the library and saw her studying away in the quiet corner.
senses.example_zh: 我走进图书馆，看到她正在安静的角落里埋头苦读。

senses.meaning: 彻底想通，琢磨透彻；拟定出（方案）
senses.example_en: It took the engineers several weeks to study out a workable solution to the glitch.
senses.example_zh: 工程师们花了数周时间才琢磨出解决该故障的可行方案。

senses.meaning: 从头到尾研读，通读详查
senses.example_en: You should study through the contract thoroughly before putting your signature on it.
senses.example_zh: 在签字之前，你应该把这份合同从头到尾仔细研读一遍。

senses.example_en: Take some time to study over the job offer before making your final decision.
senses.example_zh: 在做最终决定之前，抽点时间把这份录用条件仔细斟酌一下。

idioms.meaning: 领悟力强的人，学得快的人
idioms.example_en: She had no background in programming, but she proved to be a remarkably quick study.
idioms.example_zh: 她虽然没有编程背景，但事实证明她是个领悟力极强的人。

idioms.meaning: 鲜明的对比，截然相反的对照物
idioms.example_en: The twin brothers are a study in contrasts: one is introverted and analytical, while the other is boisterous and impulsive.
idioms.example_zh: 这对双胞胎兄弟形成了鲜明的对比：一个内向理性，另一个却喧闹冲动。

idioms.meaning: 陷入沉思，出神发呆
idioms.example_en: He sat staring blankly into the distance, lost in a deep brown study until the doorbell rang.
idioms.example_zh: 他呆呆地注视着远方陷入了深思，直到门铃响起才回过神来。

idioms.meaning: 审时度势；研判赛马/竞争对手的以往表现
idioms.example_en: Savvy investors always study the market form thoroughly before committing any venture capital.
idioms.example_zh: 精明的投资者在投入风险资金前总会透彻研判市场走势。

idioms.meaning: 专门研究某事物，对某事下苦功观察
idioms.example_en: Over the past decade, she has made a detailed study of traditional herbal medicine in rural areas.
idioms.example_zh: 在过去的十年里，她对乡村地区的传统草药学进行了系统而深入的研究。

collocations.example_en: Gaining cross-cultural perspective is one of the main reasons students choose to study abroad.
collocations.example_zh: 获得跨文化视野是学生们选择出国留学的主要原因之一。

collocations.example_en: The detective studied the surveillance footage closely to catch any overlooked details.
collocations.example_zh: 侦探密切查看了监控录像，以捕捉任何被忽略的细节。

collocations.meaning: 开展/实施一项调查研究
collocations.example_en: Independent researchers were commissioned to conduct a comprehensive study on the ecological impact.
collocations.example_zh: 独立研究人员受托就生态影响开展一项综合性研究。

collocations.meaning: 论证/研究某事的可行性
collocations.example_en: The urban planning board met yesterday to study the feasibility of building a light rail network.
collocations.example_zh: 城市规划委员会昨天开会论证了修建轻轨网络的可行性。

collocations.meaning: 实证研究 / 纵向追踪研究
collocations.example_en: This thirty-year longitudinal study provides compelling evidence on the cognitive benefits of bilingualism.
collocations.example_zh: 这项长达三十年的追踪研究为双语对认知能力的有益影响提供了令人信服的证据。

collocations.example_en: Linguistic variation among online subcultures has become a popular object of academic study.
collocations.example_zh: 网络亚文化中的语言变体已成为一个热门的学术研究对象。

senses.example_en: I promised to be there for him, and I really don't want to let him down.
senses.example_zh: 我答应过要支持他，真的不想让他失望。

senses.example_en: She let her hair down after a long day at the office.
senses.example_zh: 在办公室忙碌了一整天后，她把头发披散了下来。

senses.example_en: Some pranksters let down the tires on my bicycle overnight.
senses.example_zh: 有些恶作剧的人昨夜把我的自行车车胎给放了气。

senses.example_en: Could you please open the front door and let the cat in?
senses.example_zh: 你能开一下前门把猫放进来吗？

senses.example_en: These worn boots are starting to let in water.
senses.example_zh: 这双穿旧的靴子开始渗水了。

senses.example_en: He opened the gate and let the sheep out into the pasture.
senses.example_zh: 他打开栅栏门，把羊群放到牧场上去。

senses.example_en: She let out a deep sigh of relief when the exam results were announced.
senses.example_zh: 考试成绩公布时，她长长地舒了一口气。

senses.example_en: I've gained some weight, so I need to have this skirt let out.
senses.example_zh: 我长胖了些，得把这条裙子放宽一点。

senses.example_en: School lets out early on the Friday before Thanksgiving break.
senses.example_zh: 感恩节假期前的那个周五，学校提前放学。

senses.example_en: The police officer decided to let him off with just a warning.
senses.example_zh: 交警决定从轻处理，只对他进行了口头警告。

senses.example_en: The kids gathered in the backyard to let off firecrackers on New Year's Eve.
senses.example_zh: 除夕夜孩子们聚在后院放鞭炮。

senses.example_en: The driver let the passengers off right outside the subway station.
senses.example_zh: 司机在地铁站正门口让乘客下了车。

senses.example_en: We're planning a surprise party for Sarah, so don't let on.
senses.example_zh: 我们正在给莎拉筹备惊喜派对，你可千万别说漏嘴。

senses.example_en: He let on that he was an expert, but he clearly had no idea what he was doing.
senses.example_zh: 他装得像个专家，但显然根本不懂自己在做什么。

senses.example_en: We waited under the awning until the heavy downpour let up.
senses.example_zh: 我们在雨棚下等候，直到倾盆大雨渐渐减弱。

senses.example_en: With finals just around the corner, this is no time to let up.
senses.example_zh: 期末考在即，现在可不是松懈的时候。

senses.example_en: Hold on tight to the railing and don't let go.
senses.example_zh: 抓紧扶手，千万别松手。

senses.example_en: Due to budget cuts, the firm had to let go of twenty employees.
senses.example_zh: 由于预算削减，公司不得不解雇二十名员工。

senses.meaning: 摒弃，释怀（执念、过去或情绪）
senses.example_en: It is hard to move forward until you learn to let go of the past.
senses.example_zh: 只有学会放下过去，你才能真正向前看。

senses.example_en: The security guard refused to let anyone into the building without a badge.
senses.example_zh: 保安拒绝让任何没有佩戴证件的人进入大楼。

senses.example_en: She was finally let into the family secret after turning eighteen.
senses.example_zh: 满十八岁后，她终于被告知了那个家族秘密。

senses.meaning: 放行，准许通过（关卡、筛查等）
senses.example_en: Customs officials checked our passports and let us through.
senses.example_zh: 海关官员核对了我们的护照后予以放行。

senses.meaning: 不打扰，由他去，听其自然
senses.example_en: He's very upset right now; it's best to just let him be.
senses.example_zh: 他现在情绪很糟，最好先别去打扰他，随他去吧。

senses.meaning: 放过，听之任之，不予追究
senses.example_en: His comment was quite rude, but I decided to let it pass.
senses.example_zh: 他的话相当无礼，但我决定不予计较，就这么算了。

senses.meaning: 听任其发展，暂且搁置不管
senses.example_en: There's no point arguing about the schedule now—let's just let it ride.
senses.example_zh: 现在争论时间表毫无意义——先随它去，暂且不管吧。

senses.meaning: 猛掷出，发射（武器、投掷物等）
senses.example_en: The archer drew his bow and let fly an arrow into the target.
senses.example_zh: 弓箭手拉满弓，向靶心射出了一支箭。

senses.example_en: Lost in anger, he let fly with a barrage of insults at his opponent.
senses.example_zh: 盛怒之下，他对着对手破口大骂了一通。

senses.example_en: Once he hit the empty highway, he stepped on the gas and let rip.
senses.example_zh: 一驶上空旷的高速公路，他就踩下油门全速狂飙。

senses.meaning: 尽情发泄，毫无顾忌地行动
senses.example_en: When asked for feedback, she didn't hold back and just let rip.
senses.example_zh: 当被征求意见时，她毫不保留，竹筒倒豆子般尽情吐露。

senses.meaning: 无意间说漏嘴，不经意透露
senses.example_en: During dinner, he let slip that the company was about to be sold.
senses.example_zh: 在晚宴期间，他不经意间说漏了公司即将被收购的事。

senses.meaning: 告诉（某人内情），让……参与/知悉秘密
senses.example_en: Are you going to let me in on what you two are laughing about?
senses.example_zh: 你们俩到底在笑什么，能不能也让我知道一下？

idioms.meaning: 更不用说，遑论，何谈
idioms.example_en: He can barely afford to feed his own family, let alone buy a luxury sports car.
idioms.example_zh: 他连养活自己的家人都捉襟见肘，更不用说买一辆豪华跑车了。

idioms.phrase: let the cat out of the bag
idioms.meaning: 走漏风声，泄露天机，露出马脚
idioms.example_en: We wanted the merger to stay under wraps, but an anonymous tip let the cat out of the bag.
idioms.example_zh: 我们本想对并购案保密，但一条匿名爆料让消息彻底走漏了风声。

idioms.meaning: 莫招惹是非，勿重提旧怨，过去的就让它过去
idioms.example_en: Reopening that settled grievance will only cause bitter friction; it is better to let sleeping dogs lie.
idioms.example_zh: 重新翻开那桩已了结的恩怨只会引起惨痛的冲突，最好还是莫惹是非，息事宁人。

idioms.meaning: 既往不咎，一笑泯恩仇
idioms.example_en: After years of estrangement, the brothers shook hands and agreed to let bygones be bygones.
idioms.example_zh: 在疏远多年后，兄弟二人握手言和，同意对往事既往不咎。

idioms.meaning: 卸下防备，尽情放松欢闹
idioms.example_en: The corporate gala was a rare occasion for the executives to let their hair down and enjoy themselves.
idioms.example_zh: 这场公司盛典是高管们难得卸下包袱、尽情欢聚放松的时刻。

idioms.meaning: 待人宽容，各行其是；宽以待人，互不干涉
idioms.example_en: I may not agree with his lifestyle choices, but my personal motto has always been to live and let live.
idioms.example_zh: 我可能不赞同他的生活方式，但我个人的座右铭历来是待人宽容、互不干涉。

idioms.meaning: 静观其变，等待事态平息/尘埃落定
idioms.example_en: Rather than making a hasty decision amidst the crisis, let's wait a week and let the dust settle.
idioms.example_zh: 与其在危机中仓促做决定，倒不如等上一周，静待事态平息。

collocations.example_en: Please let me know as soon as you have confirmed your travel itinerary.
collocations.example_zh: 一旦确认了您的出行行程，请尽早告知我。

collocations.meaning: 释放，放任；大发雷霆，纵情发泄
collocations.example_en: When the final whistle blew, the jubilant fans let loose a deafening roar across the arena.
collocations.example_zh: 终场哨声响起时，狂喜的球迷们在整个赛场上爆发出震耳欲聋的欢呼声。

collocations.meaning: 痛斥某人，狠狠训诫；痛击某人
collocations.example_en: The sergeant let the recruits have it after catching them sneaking out after curfew.
collocations.example_zh: 在抓到新兵们宵禁后偷溜出去之后，士官狠狠把他们痛斥了一顿。

collocations.example_en: Doctors advised against unnecessary invasive interventions, preferring to let nature take its course.
collocations.example_zh: 医生建议不要进行不必要的侵入性干预，主张顺其自然。

collocations.example_en: He hesitated for too long and let a once-in-a-lifetime career opportunity slip by.
collocations.example_zh: 他犹豫了太久，以致白白错失了一生难逢的职业发展良机。

collocations.meaning: 放下顾虑，抛开束缚，敞开心扉
collocations.example_en: Dancing around the campfire helped the introverted teenager finally let go of his inhibitions.
collocations.example_zh: 围着篝火起舞帮助这个内向的少年终于抛开了束缚与顾虑。

senses.meaning: 以……的名字命名，为纪念……而取名
senses.example_en: She was named after her grandmother, who had passed away the year before.
senses.example_zh: 她是用她祖母的名字命名的，祖母在前一年去世了。

senses.meaning: 以……命名（主要用于美式英语，同 name after）
senses.example_en: The national park was named for the legendary explorer who first mapped the region.
senses.example_zh: 这座国家公园是以首次绘制该地区地图的传奇探险家命名的。

senses.meaning: 因（某特征、功绩或原因）而得名
senses.example_en: The island was named for its abundant population of wild seals.
senses.example_zh: 该岛因栖息着大量野生海豹而得名。

senses.example_en: She was named as the company's new Chief Financial Officer yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 她昨天被任命为公司的新任首席财务官。

senses.example_en: Several local officials were named as key suspects in the bribery investigation.
senses.example_zh: 数名当地官员在受贿调查中被列为主要嫌疑人。

senses.meaning: 任命……加入（委员会、内阁、代表队等）
senses.example_en: The young forward was unexpectedly named to the national Olympic squad.
senses.example_zh: 这名年轻前锋出人意料地入选了国家奥运代表队。

senses.meaning: 在（遗嘱、诉讼、报告等文件）中指名或提及
senses.example_en: He was surprised to discover that he had been named in his uncle's will.
senses.example_zh: 他惊讶地发现自己被列入了叔叔的遗嘱中。

senses.meaning: 逐一点出名字，大声念出姓名
senses.example_en: The teacher named out the prize winners one by one during the assembly.
senses.example_zh: 晨会上，老师逐一念出了获奖者的名字。

senses.example_en: Please name down all the volunteers who signed up for tomorrow's charity drive.
senses.example_zh: 请把所有报名参加明天慈善活动的志愿者名字登记下来。

senses.meaning: 从……衍生命名，源自……的名字
senses.example_en: The disease is named from the Greek word meaning 'stiffness'.
senses.example_zh: 该疾病的名字源自一个意为“僵硬”的希腊词汇。

idioms.meaning: 凡是你能说得出的；应有尽有
idioms.example_en: They had everything at the party: burgers, sushi, cocktails, you name it.
idioms.example_zh: 聚会上应有尽有：汉堡、寿司、鸡尾酒，凡是你能想到的都有。

idioms.meaning: 指名道姓；揭发涉案牵连人员的姓名
idioms.example_en: The whistleblower refused to name names during the initial investigation.
idioms.example_zh: 告密者在初步调查中拒绝指名道姓指认涉事者。

idioms.meaning: 成名；崭露头角；赢得声誉
idioms.example_en: She worked relentlessly to make a name for herself in the competitive fashion industry.
idioms.example_zh: 她在竞争激烈的时尚界拼搏努力，最终闯出了自己的名堂。

idioms.meaning: 拉大旗作虎皮；随口提及名人显赫朋友以抬高自己
idioms.example_en: He kept dropping names to impress the interview panel.
idioms.example_zh: 他不断提及名人显贵，试图给面试官留下深刻印象。

idioms.meaning: 洗刷冤屈；恢复名誉
idioms.example_en: It took him nearly five years to finally clear his name in court.
idioms.example_zh: 他花了近五年时间才最终在法庭上洗刷了罪名。

idioms.meaning: 准确叫出……的名字；明确指认出某事物
idioms.example_en: I recognized the melody immediately, but I couldn't put a name to it.
idioms.example_zh: 我立刻认出了那段旋律，但一时叫不出它的名字。

idioms.meaning: 确定结婚日期；定下吉日
idioms.example_en: After five years of engagement, they have finally named the day.
idioms.example_zh: 订婚五年后，他们终于定下了婚期。

collocations.example_en: The seller asked us to name a price for the vintage painting.
collocations.example_zh: 卖家让我们给这幅古董画开个价。

collocations.example_en: We must name a date for the upcoming shareholder meeting.
collocations.example_zh: 我们必须为即将召开的股东大会定下日期。

collocations.meaning: 指定接班人；任命继任者
collocations.example_en: The board met privately to name a successor to the retiring CEO.
collocations.example_zh: 董事会秘密开会，指定了即将退休的首席执行官的继任者。

collocations.example_en: The research wing was named in honour of the Nobel laureate.
collocations.example_zh: 该研究中心侧楼是以这位诺贝尔奖得主的名字命名的，以示敬意。

collocations.example_en: The striking workers invited management to sit down and name terms.
collocations.example_zh: 罢工工人邀请管理层坐下来开出协商条件。

collocations.meaning: 全称列出；完整拼写出某物名称
collocations.example_en: Please avoid acronyms and name each institution in full on the application.
collocations.example_zh: 在申请表上请避免使用首字母缩写，务必完整写出每个机构的名称。

senses.example_en: I wrote a brief note to thank them for their warm hospitality during my stay.
senses.example_zh: 我写了一封简短的便条，感谢他们在逗留期间对我的热情款待。

senses.meaning: 受累于，怪罪于（反讽用法）
senses.example_en: You have only your own careless driving to thank for this hefty fine.
senses.example_zh: 这笔巨额罚款只能怪你自己开车太不小心了。

senses.example_en: We have our dedicated research team to thank for this medical breakthrough.
senses.example_zh: 这一医学突破要归功于我们专注投入的研发团队。

senses.meaning: 拜……所赐，把（坏的结果）归咎于
senses.example_en: We have the severe winter storm to thank for the widespread flight cancellations.
senses.example_zh: 大面积的航班取消全拜这场严重的冬季暴风雪所赐。

senses.meaning: 通过客气道谢来婉拒退出
senses.example_en: He politely thanked himself out of the organizing committee due to his heavy workload.
senses.example_zh: 由于工作繁忙，他客客气气地道谢并退出了筹备委员会。

senses.meaning: 挨个向众人致谢，到处道谢
senses.example_en: After the concert, the conductor went backstage and thanked around the entire orchestra.
senses.example_zh: 音乐会结束后，指挥走到后台，向整个管弦乐团的成员逐一道谢。

senses.example_en: I’d like to thank ahead all the team members who will be working overtime this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我想预先感谢本周末将加班的所有团队成员。

senses.meaning: 回谢，对别人的道谢予以回应
senses.example_en: When she praised his assistance, he smiled and warmly thanked her back.
senses.example_zh: 当她夸赞他的帮助时，他微笑着热情地回谢了她。

senses.meaning: 客套道谢后打发走，礼貌谢绝送别
senses.example_en: The manager thanked the persistent salesperson off without committing to any purchase.
senses.example_zh: 经理客气地道谢打发走了那位推销员，没有做出任何购买承诺。

senses.meaning: （在致辞结束时）向台下或全场依次致谢
senses.example_en: The guest speaker finished his talk by thanking down the rows of the audience.
senses.example_zh: 特邀演讲嘉宾在演讲结束时依次向台下各排的听众致谢。

idioms.meaning: 谢天谢地；庆幸自己的好运
idioms.example_en: I thank my lucky stars every day that no one was injured in the accident.
idioms.example_zh: 我每天都谢天谢地，庆幸在那场事故中没有人受伤。

idioms.phrase: I'll thank you to do sth
idioms.meaning: 请你……（用于表示不满或警告，带有讽刺命令口吻）
idioms.example_en: I'll thank you to mind your own business and stay out of my affairs.
idioms.example_zh: 我希望你少管闲事，别插手我的私事。

idioms.meaning: 谢天谢地；幸好（表示如释重负）
idioms.example_en: Thank goodness the storm cleared up before the outdoor wedding began.
idioms.example_zh: 谢天谢地，暴风雨在户外婚礼开始前就停了。

idioms.meaning: 全怪自己；自作自受
idioms.example_en: If you fail the test after skipping classes, you have only yourself to thank.
idioms.example_zh: 要是你逃课导致考试不及格，那只能怪你自己自食其果。

idioms.meaning: 不用谢我；举手之劳何足挂齿
idioms.example_en: "No need to thank me," she replied with a smile, "anyone would have done the same."
idioms.example_zh: “不用谢我，”她微笑着回答，“换作任何人都会这么做的。”

idioms.meaning: 多谢某人；非常感谢（稍带幽默或客套色彩）
idioms.example_en: "I thank you kindly for the lift, sir," the old traveller said.
idioms.example_zh: “先生，非常感谢您让我搭便车，”那位老旅人说道。

collocations.meaning: 对某人感激不尽；感谢之情无以言表
collocations.example_en: We cannot thank the rescue team enough for saving our family.
collocations.example_zh: 我们对救援队挽救了我们一家人的性命感激不尽。

collocations.meaning: 连声向某人道谢；再三由衷致谢
collocations.example_en: The lost tourist thanked us profusely when we returned his passport.
collocations.example_zh: 迷路的游客在我们归还他的护照时连声道谢。

collocations.meaning: 预先感谢某人；提前向某人致意
collocations.example_en: Thank you in advance for your cooperation with the building inspection.
collocations.example_zh: 预先感谢您对大楼安全检查工作的配合。

collocations.example_en: The patient made a special trip to the hospital to thank the surgeon personally.
collocations.example_zh: 该患者特意去了一趟医院，当面向主刀医生致谢。

collocations.meaning: 热情真挚地向某人道谢
collocations.example_en: The host thanked the guest speaker warmly before concluding the seminar.
collocations.example_zh: 主持人在研讨会结束前热情真挚地向主讲嘉宾致谢。

collocations.meaning: 由衷地感谢某人；真诚地向某人道谢
collocations.example_en: I want to thank you sincerely for standing by me through these difficult times.
collocations.example_zh: 我想由衷地感谢你在这些艰难时刻始终陪伴在我身边。

senses.meaning: 继续前进，离开并前往下一处
senses.example_en: After spending two days in Paris, we moved on to Lyon.
senses.example_zh: 在巴黎待了两天后，我们动身前往里昂。

senses.meaning: 转换话题，开始下一项活动
senses.example_en: Let's move on to the next item on the agenda.
senses.example_zh: 我们接着讨论议程上的下一项吧。

senses.meaning: 释怀，走出阴影展开新生活
senses.example_en: It took her months to move on after the breakup.
senses.example_zh: 分手之后，她花了数月时间才真正走出来并开始新生活。

senses.example_en: Our new neighbors are moving in this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们的新邻居这个周末就要搬进来了。

senses.meaning: （警察或军队等）逼近并采取行动，介入
senses.example_en: The police moved in to disperse the gathering crowd.
senses.example_zh: 警方迅速逼近并采取行动驱散聚集的人群。

senses.example_en: His landlord gave him thirty days to move out.
senses.example_zh: 房东限他三十天之内搬走。

senses.example_en: Many young people move away from small towns in search of jobs.
senses.example_zh: 许多年轻人为了找工作而离开小镇搬往外地。

senses.meaning: 背离，逐步脱离（传统、原则或模式）
senses.example_en: The company decided to move away from traditional marketing strategies.
senses.example_zh: 公司决定逐渐脱离传统的营销策略。

senses.example_en: The line moved forward slowly toward the ticket counter.
senses.example_zh: 队伍缓慢地向前移动，走向售票柜台。

senses.example_en: We need approval from management before we can move forward with this project.
senses.example_zh: 在推进这个项目之前，我们需要获得管理层的批准。

senses.example_en: She moved up quickly within the ranks of the firm.
senses.example_zh: 她在公司内部迅速得到了晋升。

senses.meaning: 挪动位置腾出空间，往前/往里坐
senses.example_en: Could you move up a bit to make room for another passenger?
senses.example_zh: 你能往前挪一挪，给另一位乘客腾点地方吗？

senses.meaning: 提高，上升（排名、物价或数值）
senses.example_en: Oil prices moved up again amid rising supply concerns.
senses.example_zh: 因对供应短缺的担忧加剧，油价再次出现上涨。

senses.example_en: The security guards told the crowd to move back.
senses.example_zh: 保安人员让围观人群往后退。

senses.example_en: After five years in London, she decided to move back to her hometown.
senses.example_zh: 在伦敦生活了五年后，她决定搬回老家。

senses.example_en: The meeting has been moved back from Tuesday to Thursday.
senses.example_zh: 会议已经从周二推迟到了周四。

senses.meaning: 挪开让位，挪动以腾出空位
senses.example_en: Move over on the bench so I can sit down.
senses.example_zh: 你在长椅上往旁边挪一挪，好让我坐下。

senses.meaning: 让出职位或权力（以便他人接任）
senses.example_en: It's time for senior executives to move over and let younger leaders take charge.
senses.example_zh: 是时候让资深高管退位让贤，让年轻领导人挑起大梁了。

senses.example_en: The bus moved off just as I reached the stop.
senses.example_zh: 我刚跑到公交站，车子就开走了。

senses.example_en: The discussion began to move off the main topic.
senses.example_zh: 讨论开始偏离了核心议题。

senses.example_en: Please move down the bus to allow others to board.
senses.example_zh: 请往车厢里面走走，方便其他人上车。

senses.example_en: The team moved down to third place after yesterday's defeat.
senses.example_zh: 昨天的失利让该队名次滑落到了第三位。

senses.example_en: Troops were reported to be moving in on the rebel stronghold.
senses.example_zh: 据报道，部队正逐步包围逼近叛军据点。

senses.meaning: 企图抢占，蚕食（市场、权力或资源）
senses.example_en: Foreign rivals are rapidly moving in on their domestic market.
senses.example_zh: 外国竞争对手正迅速蚕食他们的国内市场。

senses.meaning: 走开，勿滞留（常用于指令）
senses.example_en: The officer ordered the bystanders to move along.
senses.example_zh: 警察命令围观群众走开，不要滞留。

senses.meaning: （事情、工作）顺利进展，持续开展
senses.example_en: Renovations are moving along nicely and should finish next week.
senses.example_zh: 装修进展得很顺利，预计下周就能完工。

senses.example_en: Sitting for hours is bad for your back; get up and move around.
senses.example_zh: 久坐对腰不好，站起来四处走动一下吧。

senses.meaning: 频繁搬家，辗转各地生活
senses.example_en: Because of his father's diplomatic career, they moved around a lot.
senses.example_zh: 由于父亲从事外交工作，他们常常辗转各地频繁搬迁。

senses.meaning: 搬进，迁入新住处或办公地
senses.example_en: The company is moving into a newly built office building next month.
senses.example_zh: 该公司下个月将迁入一座新建的办公大楼。

senses.meaning: 涉足，打入（新业务领域或市场）
senses.example_en: The tech giant is moving into the electric vehicle industry.
senses.example_zh: 这家科技巨头正在涉足电动汽车行业。

senses.meaning: 走在前面，取得领先地位
senses.example_en: With this new invention, the startup moved ahead of its competitors.
senses.example_zh: 凭借这项新发明，这家初创企业跑在了竞争对手前面。

senses.example_en: Despite initial objections, the board voted to move ahead with the plan.
senses.example_zh: 尽管最初有人反对，董事会还是投票决定继续推进该计划。

idioms.meaning: 采取行动；动身离开；（向某人）示爱或展开追求
idioms.example_en: If we want to secure this deal, we need to make a move now.
idioms.example_zh: 如果我们想拿下这笔交易，现在就必须采取行动。

idioms.meaning: 竭尽全力；排除万难
idioms.example_en: He promised to move heaven and earth to get her tickets to the sold-out concert.
idioms.example_zh: 他承诺会想尽一切办法为她搞到那场售罄演唱会的门票。

idioms.meaning: 改变规则；在进行中提高标准或改变目标
idioms.example_en: Every time we meet their requirements, they move the goalposts.
idioms.example_zh: 每次我们达到他们的要求，他们又改变标准刁难我们。

idioms.meaning: 与时俱进；顺应时代潮流
idioms.example_en: Traditional retailers must move with the times and embrace e-commerce.
idioms.example_zh: 传统零售商必须与时俱进，积极拥抱电子商务。

idioms.meaning: 飞黄腾达；社会地位或经济状况显著提升
idioms.example_en: Ever since his promotion, he has really been moving up in the world.
idioms.example_zh: 自从升职后，他的社会地位确实水涨船高了。

idioms.meaning: 抓紧时间；赶快
idioms.example_en: We'd better get a move on, or we'll miss our flight.
idioms.example_zh: 我们最好动作快点，否则要赶不上飞机了。

idioms.meaning: 朝正确的方向发展；有所好转
idioms.example_en: Inflation figures suggest the economy is finally moving in the right direction.
idioms.example_zh: 通胀数据表明经济终于在朝着好的方向发展。

collocations.example_en: The audience was moved to tears by the pianist's emotional performance.
collocations.example_zh: 观众被钢琴家深情动人的演奏感动得热泪盈眶。

collocations.example_en: Neither side was willing to make the first move in the peace talks.
collocations.example_zh: 在和平谈判中，双方都不愿意率先迈出第一步。

collocations.example_en: Moving house is widely considered one of the most stressful life events.
collocations.example_zh: 搬家被普遍认为是生活中最耗费心神的事情之一。

collocations.meaning: 付诸行动；开始投入运作
collocations.example_en: As soon as the alarm sounded, emergency crews moved into action.
collocations.example_zh: 警报一响，应急救援人员立刻投入行动。

collocations.meaning: 自由活动；畅通无阻地流动
collocations.example_en: After weeks in a cast, she can finally move her fingers freely.
collocations.example_zh: 打了数周石膏后，她的手指终于能够自如活动了。

collocations.example_en: The chairman moved a motion to adjourn the meeting until tomorrow morning.
collocations.example_zh: 主席提议休会，会议推迟至次日早晨继续进行。

collocations.meaning: 以某种速度移动或推进
collocations.example_en: Technological advancements are moving at a breakneck pace.
collocations.example_zh: 技术进步正以惊人的极快速度向前推进。

senses.meaning: 指出，向某人提醒（事实、错误或信息）
senses.example_en: She pointed out several typos in my first draft.
senses.example_zh: 她指出了我初稿中的几处拼写错误。

senses.meaning: 使注意到，指引看某人某物
senses.example_en: He pointed out the historic landmark to the tourists.
senses.example_zh: 他向游客们指认了那处历史地标。

senses.example_en: The compass needle pointed to the north.
senses.example_zh: 罗盘指针指向了北方。

senses.meaning: 表明，预示，显示出某种可能性
senses.example_en: All current indicators point to a strong economic recovery.
senses.example_zh: 目前的所有指标都预示着强劲的经济复苏。

senses.example_en: Critics point to the lack of funding as the primary cause of failure.
senses.example_zh: 批评人士将资金短缺列为失败的主要原因。

senses.meaning: （用手指、武器等直接）对准，指向
senses.example_en: It is considered rude to point at people in public.
senses.example_zh: 在公共场合用手指着别人被认为是不礼貌的。

senses.example_en: The road sign points towards the highway entrance.
senses.example_zh: 路标朝向高速公路入口方向。

senses.meaning: 显示出……的趋势，暗示未来走向
senses.example_en: Recent survey findings point towards a shift in consumer habits.
senses.example_zh: 近期的调查结果暗示了消费者习惯的转变趋势。

senses.meaning: 突出显示，凸显（问题、弱点或重要性）
senses.example_en: The crisis pointed up the urgent need for structural reform.
senses.example_zh: 这场危机凸显了进行结构性改革的紧迫性。

senses.meaning: 追溯到，表明其根源在于
senses.example_en: All the evidence points back to an error made in the initial system setup.
senses.example_zh: 所有的证据都追溯到系统初始配置时犯下的一个错误。

senses.example_en: The arrow on the screen points down to indicate a drop in temperature.
senses.example_zh: 屏幕上的箭头朝下指，表示温度下降。

senses.example_en: Make sure the nozzle is pointed away from your face before spraying.
senses.example_zh: 喷洒前请确保喷嘴指向别处，不要对着自己的脸。

idioms.meaning: 无关紧要的；离题的，不相干的
idioms.example_en: Whether you like him or not is beside the point; he is qualified for the job.
idioms.example_zh: 你喜不喜欢他无关紧要，关键是他能胜任这份工作。

idioms.meaning: 切中要害；简明扼要
idioms.example_en: Her remarks were brief and straight to the point.
idioms.example_zh: 她的发言简短有力且切中要害。

idioms.meaning: 没抓住要领；理解错误，领会错核心意图
idioms.example_en: You completely missed the point of what I was trying to explain.
idioms.example_zh: 你完全没有领会我想表达的核心意思。

idioms.meaning: 特别注意；务必做到；特意做（某事）
idioms.example_en: He makes a point of thanking every team member individually after each project.
idioms.example_zh: 每次项目结束后，他都会特意逐一致谢每位团队成员。

idioms.meaning: 证明自己的观点正确；证明自己的能力以博取认同
idioms.example_en: She ran the marathon not for the medal, but to prove a point to herself.
idioms.example_zh: 她跑马拉松不是为了奖牌，而是为了向自己证明自己的能力。

idioms.meaning: 破例；通融，放宽限制
idioms.example_en: The manager agreed to stretch a point and accept the late application.
idioms.example_zh: 经理同意破例一次，接受了逾期的申请。

idioms.meaning: 痛处；伤心事；触及容易引人不悦的话题
idioms.example_en: Don't ask about his exam results—it's a very sore point right now.
idioms.example_zh: 别问他的考试成绩，那现在可是他的伤心事。

idioms.meaning: 在那时；在那个当口/关头
idioms.example_en: We were completely exhausted, and at that point we gave up searching.
idioms.example_zh: 我们已经筋疲力尽，就在那个关头我们放弃了搜寻。

collocations.meaning: 阐明观点；提出有说服力的意见
collocations.example_en: You make a good point, but we still have to consider the cost implications.
collocations.example_zh: 你说的很有道理，但我们仍须考虑成本方面的影响。

collocations.example_en: I take your point, but I still believe my original plan is safer.
collocations.example_zh: 我明白你的意思，但我仍然认为我最初的方案更稳妥。

collocations.meaning: 出发点；起点；讨论的基点
collocations.example_en: This draft can serve as a useful starting point for our negotiations.
collocations.example_zh: 这份草案可以作为我们谈判的一个良好起点。

collocations.example_en: Winning that scholarship proved to be a major turning point in her life.
collocations.example_zh: 获得那笔奖学金被证明是她人生的一个重大转折点。

collocations.example_en: The fireplace serves as the main focal point of the living room.
collocations.example_zh: 壁炉是客厅整体视觉的核心焦点。

collocations.example_en: Try to look at the situation from a customer's point of view.
collocations.example_zh: 试着站在客户的立场来审视这一情况。

collocations.example_en: At this point in time, we cannot confirm whether any data was leaked.
collocations.example_zh: 在目前的这个时间节点，我们无法确认是否有数据遭到泄露。

senses.example_en: Let me write down your phone number before I forget it.
senses.example_zh: 趁我还没忘，让我把你的电话号码记下来。

senses.example_en: The bank had to write down the value of its property portfolio by twenty percent.
senses.example_zh: 该银行不得不将其房地产投资组合的账面价值减记20%。

senses.meaning: 认定…毫无价值/失败，放弃
senses.example_en: Critics were quick to write off the new venture as a total disaster.
senses.example_zh: 评论家们迅速断定这项新创事业彻底失败了。

senses.example_en: The government agreed to write off millions of dollars in student loans.
senses.example_zh: 政府同意注销数百万美元的学生贷款债务。

senses.meaning: 把（车辆等）彻底撞毁致报废
senses.example_en: He survived the accident without a scratch, but his car was completely written off.
senses.example_zh: 他在事故中毫发无伤，但他的车彻底报废了。

senses.meaning: 开具，填写（支票、处方、单据等）
senses.example_en: The doctor wrote out a prescription for some painkillers.
senses.example_zh: 医生开了一张止痛药处方。

senses.example_en: Please write out your answers in full sentences rather than short bullet points.
senses.example_zh: 请用完整的句子把答案详细写出来，而不是只写简短的要点。

senses.meaning: 把…写成报道或详尽总结/报告
senses.example_en: I need a couple of quiet hours to write up the lab experiment results.
senses.example_zh: 我需要一两个小时安静的时间来整理并写完实验报告。

senses.meaning: （因违规或过失）书面记过，向上级呈报
senses.example_en: The manager threatened to write him up if he arrived late again.
senses.example_zh: 经理威胁说如果他再迟到就会对他进行书面违纪记录。

senses.meaning: 致信（电视台、电台、报刊等）
senses.example_en: Thousands of viewers wrote in to complain about the controversial broadcast.
senses.example_zh: 成千上万的观众写信投诉那期极具争议的广播节目。

senses.meaning: 在选票上附笔提名（未印在选票上的候选人）
senses.example_en: Disappointed by the party nominees, many voters decided to write in an independent candidate.
senses.example_zh: 对两党提名人感到失望的许多选民决定在选票上补写一位独立候选人的名字。

senses.meaning: 将（条款、条件）明确写入（法律、合同或协议中）
senses.example_en: A confidentiality clause was explicitly written into their employment contract.
senses.example_zh: 一份保密条款被明确写入了他们的雇佣合同中。

senses.meaning: （通过编剧处理）把（角色）从剧情或剧本中剔除/写死
senses.example_en: After the actor decided to leave the show, the writers wrote his character out of the series.
senses.example_zh: 在这位演员决定离开该剧后，编剧们将他的角色从故事线中剔除了。

senses.example_en: I sent her a long email last week, but she hasn't written back yet.
senses.example_zh: 我上周给她发了一封长邮件，但她还没给我回信。

senses.meaning: 函购，写信索取（物品、资料等）
senses.example_en: As a kid, he would write away for free promotional stickers from magazines.
senses.example_zh: 小时候，他经常写信索取杂志上的免费宣传贴纸。

senses.meaning: 以居高临下/降尊迁就的通俗口吻迎合（读者或受众）
senses.example_en: Good children's authors never write down to their young readers.
senses.example_zh: 优秀的儿童文学作家从不会以居高临下、自降身段的口吻来迁就小读者。

senses.meaning: （向多家机构、个人等）群发信件征询信息
senses.example_en: The research team wrote around to several universities to gather data for the study.
senses.example_zh: 研究团队向数所大学发函征询，为课题收集数据。

senses.meaning: 将某事草率归结为…；将…轻视为…
senses.example_en: She wrote the strange noises off as nothing more than the wind rattling the window.
senses.example_zh: 她把那些奇怪的声音草草归结为不过是风在吹打窗户而已。

idioms.meaning: 平平常常，不值一提，没有什么特别出色的地方
idioms.example_en: The food at the new restaurant was okay, but nothing to write home about.
idioms.example_zh: 新餐馆的菜品尚可，但真没什么值得大书特书的。

idioms.meaning: （情绪、内疚或秘密等）昭然若揭，全写在脸上
idioms.example_en: Guilt was written all over his face when the manager walked in.
idioms.example_zh: 当经理走进来时，他的内疚全写在脸上了。

idioms.meaning: 开出自己的条件，自定待遇，随心所欲决定前途
idioms.example_en: With her extraordinary credentials, she can pretty much write her own ticket in the tech sector.
idioms.example_zh: 凭她过硬的资历，她在科技圈基本可以随意自开薪资待遇。

idioms.meaning: 板上钉钉，不可变更，固定不可更改
idioms.example_en: These schedule guidelines are flexible and not written in stone.
idioms.example_zh: 这些时间表安排是具有弹性的，并非板上钉钉不可更改。

idioms.meaning: 到此为止，全完了，事情彻底结束了
idioms.example_en: The engine blew up on the final lap, and that was all she wrote.
idioms.example_zh: 最后一圈时引擎爆炸了，这下彻底全完了。

idioms.meaning: 开空头支票；给予无限授权/全权支配
idioms.example_en: The government refused to write a blank check for the bailout.
idioms.example_zh: 政府拒绝为这次救助计划提供无限制的资金授权。

collocations.example_en: He pulled out his pen to write a check for the deposit.
collocations.example_zh: 他掏出钢笔开了一张押金支票。

collocations.example_en: Candidates are required to write the exam answers in blue or black ink.
collocations.example_zh: 考生须用蓝色或黑色墨水书写考试答案。

collocations.meaning: 撰写论文/报告/起草初稿
collocations.example_en: She had to write a comprehensive report before the board meeting.
collocations.example_zh: 她必须在董事会会议召开前撰写出一份详尽的报告。

collocations.example_en: Please write legibly so that our staff can read your delivery address.
collocations.example_zh: 请字迹工整清晰，以便工作人员辨认您的送货地址。

collocations.meaning: 给某人写信/发书面函件
collocations.example_en: I will write to the CEO directly regarding this unresolved dispute.
collocations.example_zh: 我将就这起尚未解决的纠纷直接致信首席执行官。

collocations.example_en: It is prudent to write a will while you are still in sound health.
collocations.example_zh: 趁身体健康时立下一份遗嘱是明智之举。

senses.meaning: 齐心协力，组队协作，联手合作
senses.example_en: The two rival tech companies decided to team up to develop the open-source platform.
senses.example_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技公司决定联手合作，共同开发该开源平台。

senses.example_en: The local charity teamed up with a major supermarket to distribute free meals.
senses.example_zh: 这家地方慈善机构与一家大型超市联手分发免费餐食。

senses.meaning: 与…紧密配对/联合；（与服装搭配时）与…搭配
senses.example_en: She teamed a crisp white shirt with tailored trousers for the interview.
senses.example_zh: 她穿了一件挺括的白衬衫搭配修身西裤去参加面试。

senses.example_en: The experienced engineer was teamed with a junior developer on the new project.
senses.example_zh: 这位经验丰富的工程师与一名初级开发人员搭档负责这个新项目。

senses.example_en: If we all team together, we can finish painting the community center by evening.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们大家协同组队一起干，傍晚前就能粉刷完社区中心。

senses.meaning: 联手共同对抗/对付（对手、困难等）
senses.example_en: Several independent retailers teamed up against the aggressive expansion of the retail giant.
senses.example_zh: 几家独立零售商联手对抗这家零售巨头的激进扩张。

senses.meaning: 跨部门/跨界组建团队协作
senses.example_en: The organization encourages employees to team across departments to solve complex product issues.
senses.example_zh: 该机构鼓励员工跨部门组队协作，以解决复杂的产品问题。

idioms.meaning: 为集体利益做出牺牲，顾全大局受委屈
idioms.example_en: John agreed to work through the holiday, taking one for the team.
idioms.example_zh: 约翰同意在假期全程值班，为了顾全团队大局做出了牺牲。

idioms.meaning: 具有团队协作精神的人，善于与集体配合的人
idioms.example_en: In modern corporate environments, being a team player is just as crucial as technical competence.
idioms.example_zh: 在现代企业环境中，具备团队协作精神与专业技能同样至关重要。

idioms.meaning: 梦之队，最强阵容组合
idioms.example_en: The firm assembled a dream team of top trial lawyers to handle the high-profile lawsuit.
idioms.example_zh: 该事务所召集了一支由顶级诉讼律师组成的梦之队来应对这场引人注目的诉讼。

idioms.phrase: cheer for / play for the other team
idioms.meaning: （俚语/幽默）站在对立阵营；特指同性恋倾向
idioms.example_en: We realized early in the debate that he was covertly cheering for the other team.
idioms.example_zh: 在辩论初期我们就意识到，他暗中站在了对方阵营一边。

idioms.meaning: 车轮战搭档；轮流接替配合
idioms.example_en: The detectives tag-teamed the suspect throughout the night during interrogation.
idioms.example_zh: 整夜的审讯中，侦探们轮番上阵接替讯问嫌疑人。

collocations.example_en: The company organized an outdoor retreat to facilitate team building and communication.
collocations.example_zh: 公司组织了一次户外拓展，以促进团队建设与沟通。

collocations.example_en: She proved that she has the leadership capabilities required to lead a team through a crisis.
collocations.example_zh: 她证明了自己具备带领团队渡过危机所需的领导能力。

collocations.example_en: Our marketing analysts team closely with the sales reps to identify consumer trends.
collocations.example_zh: 我们的市场分析师与销售代表紧密协作，捕捉消费趋势。

collocations.example_en: We are thrilled that a brilliant data scientist has decided to join our team.
collocations.example_zh: 我们非常高兴有一位才华横溢的数据科学家决定加入我们的团队。

collocations.meaning: 团队共同努力，集体协作
collocations.example_en: Winning this prestigious contract was truly a combined team effort.
collocations.example_zh: 赢得这份重要合同确实是全体成员共同努力的成果。

collocations.example_en: The manager implemented flexible work hours to boost team morale.
collocations.example_zh: 经理推行了弹性工作制以提振团队士气。

senses.example_en: Hurry up and put your coat on; it's freezing outside.
senses.example_zh: 快把外套穿上，外面冷极了。

senses.example_en: He put on a lot of weight over the winter holidays.
senses.example_zh: 他在寒假期间体重增加了不少。

senses.example_en: The local drama club is putting on a production of Hamlet.
senses.example_zh: 当地戏剧社正在排演《哈姆雷特》。

senses.meaning: 涂抹，施加（化妆品、护肤品等）
senses.example_en: She put on some sunscreen before heading out to the beach.
senses.example_zh: 她出门去海滩前涂了些防晒霜。

senses.example_en: Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
senses.example_zh: 今日事今日毕，切莫拖延到明天。

senses.example_en: The bad smell of the restaurant completely put us off our food.
senses.example_zh: 那家餐馆难闻的气味让我们彻底没了食欲。

senses.example_en: Please don't talk while I'm driving; it really puts me off.
senses.example_zh: 我开车时请别跟我说话，这很容易让我分心。

senses.example_en: I can't put up with his constant complaining any longer.
senses.example_zh: 我再也无法容忍他没完没了的抱怨了。

senses.example_en: Firefighters worked through the night to put out the blaze.
senses.example_zh: 消防队员通宵奋战扑灭了大火。

senses.example_en: The police have put out a warning about counterfeit banknotes.
senses.example_zh: 警方已发布关于假钞的预警声明。

senses.example_en: I hope our staying here for the night won't put you out too much.
senses.example_zh: 希望我们在这里借宿一晚不会给你添太多麻烦。

senses.example_en: The factory puts out over five thousand units a day.
senses.example_zh: 这家工厂每天生产五千多件产品。

senses.example_en: They put up a notice on the bulletin board about the upcoming meeting.
senses.example_zh: 他们在公告栏上张贴了关于即将召开会议的通知。

senses.example_en: A new housing development is being put up near the station.
senses.example_zh: 车站附近正在兴建一个新的住宅区。

senses.example_en: Could you put me up for the night while I'm in town?
senses.example_zh: 我进城期间你能让我借宿一晚吗？

senses.example_en: Landlords have put up rents by ten percent this year.
senses.example_zh: 房东们今年把租金提高了百分之十。

senses.example_en: She put forward a compelling proposal at the board meeting.
senses.example_zh: 她在董事会上提出了一个令人信服的方案。

senses.example_en: Several colleagues put him forward as a candidate for the committee.
senses.example_zh: 几位同事推荐他作为委员会的候选人。

senses.example_en: Remember to put your clocks forward one hour for daylight saving time.
senses.example_zh: 记得在进入夏令时把时钟往前拨快一小时。

senses.example_en: Put that fragile vase down carefully on the table.
senses.example_zh: 小心点把那个易碎的花瓶放到桌上。

senses.example_en: Let me put down your phone number before I forget it.
senses.example_zh: 趁我还没忘，先让我把你的电话号码记下来。

senses.example_en: Government troops swiftly put down the armed rebellion.
senses.example_zh: 政府军迅速平息了这场武装叛乱。

senses.meaning: 使（受伤或患病的动物）安乐死
senses.example_en: The dog was in terrible pain, so the vet advised putting him down.
senses.example_zh: 那只狗痛苦不堪，兽医建议为它实施安乐死。

senses.example_en: The children were told to put away their toys before dinner.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们被告知晚饭前要把玩具收拾好。

senses.example_en: She puts away a small portion of her salary every month for retirement.
senses.example_zh: 她每月都会从薪水中存下一小笔钱用于养老。

senses.meaning: 把…关进监狱或送进精神病院
senses.example_en: The serial burglar was finally caught and put away for ten years.
senses.example_zh: 那个连环窃贼终于落网，被判入狱十年。

senses.example_en: Hold the line, please; I'll put you through to the sales department.
senses.example_zh: 请别挂断，我马上为您转接销售部。

senses.meaning: 使经历，使经受（考验、苦难）
senses.example_en: No parent should have to be put through such an ordeal.
senses.example_zh: 任何父母都不应该遭受如此痛苦的折磨。

senses.meaning: 使（法案、方案等）顺利通过
senses.example_en: The government managed to put the new healthcare legislation through.
senses.example_zh: 政府成功促使新的医疗改革法案获得通过。

senses.example_en: Please put the reference books back on the shelf after reading them.
senses.example_zh: 查阅完工具书后，请放回书架原处。

senses.example_en: The departure time has been put back by two hours due to fog.
senses.example_zh: 因大雾影响，起飞时间被推迟了两个小时。

senses.meaning: 把（钟表指针）往回拨，调慢
senses.example_en: In autumn, clocks are put back one hour across the country.
senses.example_zh: 秋季时，全国各地的时钟都要往回拨慢一小时。

senses.example_en: We try to put aside fifty dollars each week for our holiday fund.
senses.example_zh: 我们尽量每周省下五十美元存作度假基金。

senses.meaning: 把…置于一旁，暂时搁置不理
senses.example_en: They agreed to put aside their political differences and work together.
senses.example_zh: 他们同意暂时搁置政治分歧，携手合作。

senses.example_en: It took me nearly three hours to put the flat-pack wardrobe together.
senses.example_zh: 我花了近三个小时才把那个平板包装的衣柜组装好。

senses.meaning: 筹集，组织，制定（团队、方案、材料）
senses.example_en: The manager put together a team of top engineers for the project.
senses.example_zh: 经理为该项目组建了一支由顶尖工程师构成的团队。

senses.example_en: She put in over sixty hours at the office this week to finish the report.
senses.example_zh: 她本周在办公室加了六十多个小时的班来完成这份报告。

senses.meaning: 正式提出（申请、索赔、要求）
senses.example_en: He decided to put in a claim for compensation after the accident.
senses.example_zh: 事故发生后，他决定正式提出赔偿申请。

senses.example_en: We are having central heating put in before winter comes.
senses.example_zh: 我们在入冬前正在安装集中供暖系统。

senses.meaning: 把…表达清楚，使被理解或接受
senses.example_en: He used simple analogies to put across complex scientific concepts.
senses.example_zh: 他运用简单的打比方，将复杂的科学概念表达得清晰易懂。

senses.example_en: He always puts his colleagues down in front of the boss to make himself look good.
senses.example_zh: 他总是在老板面前贬低同事，以抬高自己。

senses.example_en: She has a tidy sum put by for a rainy day.
senses.example_zh: 她存了一笔可观的备用金以备不时之需。

senses.meaning: 散布，散播（谣言、虚假消息）
senses.example_en: Someone has been putting about rumors that the company is going bankrupt.
senses.example_zh: 有人到处散播公司即将破产的谣言。

senses.meaning: 向某人提出（问题、建议以征询意见或求证）
senses.example_en: The journalist put the allegations directly to the minister during the interview.
senses.example_zh: 记者在专访期间直接向部长就这些指控进行了求证。

idioms.meaning: 根据现有事实推断出真相
idioms.example_en: He hadn't told anyone they were dating, but we easily put two and two together.
idioms.example_zh: 他没跟任何人提过他们在约会，但我们很容易就猜出真相了。

idioms.meaning: 坚决反对，采取强硬立场
idioms.example_en: When the kids demanded expensive phones, their father finally put his foot down.
idioms.example_zh: 当孩子们索要昂贵的手机时，父亲终于态度坚决地表示反对。

idioms.meaning: 准确指出症结所在，明确说出原因
idioms.example_en: There was something strange about his story, but I couldn't put my finger on it.
idioms.example_zh: 他的说法有些古怪，但我一时说不上来究竟不对在哪里。

idioms.phrase: put all one's eggs in one basket
idioms.meaning: 孤注一掷，把所有希望寄托于一处
idioms.example_en: Diversify your investments instead of putting all your eggs in one basket.
idioms.example_zh: 分散你的投资，不要把所有鸡蛋放在同一个篮子里。

idioms.phrase: put the cart before the horse
idioms.meaning: 本末倒置，因果倒置
idioms.example_en: Designing the marketing campaign before finishing the product is putting the cart before the horse.
idioms.example_zh: 产品还没完成就先设计营销活动，完全是本末倒置。

idioms.meaning: 让某人认清自己的地位，挫其傲气
idioms.example_en: His blunt response quickly put the arrogant newcomer in his place.
idioms.example_zh: 他直截了当的回答迅速挫伤了那个傲慢新人的锐气。

idioms.phrase: put one's cards on the table
idioms.meaning: 开诚布公，坦白交代自己的意图或底牌
idioms.example_en: Let's put our cards on the table and negotiate a fair deal.
idioms.example_zh: 我们打开天窗说亮话，谈一笔公平的交易吧。

collocations.example_en: The ceasefire agreement finally put an end to years of armed conflict.
collocations.example_zh: 停火协议终于结束了长达数年的武装冲突。

collocations.example_en: It is much harder to put these principles into practice than to preach them.
collocations.example_zh: 贯彻这些原则远比嘴上宣讲要困难得多。

collocations.example_en: Campaigners are putting pressure on the government to act immediately.
collocations.example_zh: 活动人士正向政府施压，要求其立即采取行动。

collocations.example_en: reckless driving puts innocent lives at risk.
collocations.example_zh: 鲁莽驾驶把无辜的生命置于危险境地。

collocations.example_en: She decided to put her multilingual skills to good use in diplomacy.
collocations.example_zh: 她决定在外事外交工作中充分发挥自己的多语言优势。

collocations.example_en: The new syllabus puts heavy emphasis on critical thinking skills.
collocations.example_zh: 新教学大纲重点强调批判性思维能力。

collocations.example_en: The emergency response system was put to the test during the storm.
collocations.example_zh: 应急响应系统在暴风雨期间经受了实战检验。

senses.example_en: The teacher read out the names of the winning students to the class.
senses.example_zh: 老师向全班大声宣读了获奖学生的名单。

senses.meaning: 从头到尾仔细阅读，通读
senses.example_en: Make sure you read through the contract thoroughly before signing it.
senses.example_zh: 签字之前，务必把合同从头到尾仔细通读一遍。

senses.example_en: I'll read over your essay tonight and mark any grammatical mistakes.
senses.example_zh: 我今晚会把你的文章细看一遍，并把语法错误标出来。

senses.meaning: （经验、模式）横向对照，跨领域借鉴推广
senses.example_en: We need to ensure that the findings from this study can read across to other sectors.
senses.example_zh: 我们需要确保这项研究的成果能够推广借鉴到其他行业。

senses.meaning: 过度解读，主观臆断深层含义
senses.example_en: Don't read too much into his silence; he's probably just tired.
senses.example_zh: 别对他的沉默过度解读，他可能只是累了。

senses.meaning: 专项研读，查阅资料深入了解
senses.example_en: I need to read up on local labor laws before the negotiation begins.
senses.example_zh: 谈判开始前，我需要深入研读一下当地的劳动法规。

senses.meaning: 照着念，迅速朗读（清单、仪表数据等）
senses.example_en: The technician read off the pressure figures directly from the control monitor.
senses.example_zh: 技术员直接从控制显示屏上逐一念出压力数据。

senses.meaning: 复诵，将记录的信息读回以核对确认
senses.example_en: The operator asked me to read back the security code to make sure it was correct.
senses.example_zh: 接线员让我复诵一遍安全验证码，以确认无误。

senses.example_en: The script failed because the system could not read in the input file.
senses.example_zh: 脚本运行失败，因为系统无法读取输入文件。

senses.meaning: 向（某人）通报机密内情或背景信息
senses.example_en: The new intelligence officer was quickly read in on the covert operation.
senses.example_zh: 那位新任情报官很快听取了关于该秘密行动的背景通报。

idioms.meaning: 体会言外之意，读出字里行间的深意
idioms.example_en: Reading between the lines of her email, it was clear she was unhappy.
idioms.example_zh: 从她邮件的字里行间可以看出，她显然很不高兴。

idioms.meaning: 把某人的心思看得一清二楚，了如指掌
idioms.example_en: You can't fool your mother; she can read you like a book.
idioms.example_zh: 你骗不过你母亲的，她对你的心思了如指掌。

idioms.meaning: 察言观色，审时度势
idioms.example_en: He completely failed to read the room and cracked an insensitive joke during the solemn meeting.
idioms.example_zh: 他完全不懂察言观色，在庄严肃穆的会议上讲了个不合时宜的笑话。

idioms.meaning: 严厉警告，申斥，大加训斥
idioms.example_en: The coach read the players the riot act after their lackluster performance.
idioms.example_zh: 在球员们表现疲软之后，教练把他们狠狠训斥了一顿。

idioms.meaning: 把…视为理所当然，想当然地认为无需讨论
idioms.example_en: We can take it as read that everyone agrees with the core objective.
idioms.example_zh: 我们可以想当然地认为大家都赞同这项核心目标。

idioms.meaning: 引人入胜的读物，一本好书
idioms.example_en: His latest historical thriller is an exceptionally compelling read.
idioms.example_zh: 他最新的历史惊悚小说是一本极其扣人心弦的佳作。

collocations.example_en: The teacher asked the student to read the poem aloud to the class.
collocations.example_zh: 老师让该学生把这首诗大声朗读给全班同学听。

collocations.example_en: As a child, she read voraciously about astronomy and space travel.
collocations.example_zh: 孩提时代，她便如饥似渴地阅读有关天文学和太空旅行的书籍。

collocations.example_en: Scholars are expected to read widely beyond their immediate field of study.
collocations.example_zh: 学者们理应博览群书，涉猎超出自身直接研究领域的知识。

collocations.example_en: I was just about to suggest coffee—you must have read my mind!
collocations.example_zh: 我正想提议去喝咖啡呢——你准是猜透了我的心思！

collocations.phrase: read the fine print / small print
collocations.meaning: 仔细阅读附加条款/细则
collocations.example_en: Always read the fine print before agreeing to the loan conditions.
collocations.example_zh: 在同意贷款条件之前，务必仔细阅读细则条款。

collocations.meaning: 从头到尾完整读完（整本书）
collocations.example_en: The biography was so gripping that I read it from cover to cover in one sitting.
collocations.example_zh: 这本传记太引人入胜了，我一口气从头到尾读完了整本书。

senses.meaning: 继续，坚持（尤指不顾阻碍或反复进行）
senses.example_en: Despite the pouring rain, they kept on walking toward the campsite.
senses.example_zh: 尽管下着倾盆大雨，他们还是继续向营地走去。

senses.meaning: 反复唠叨，没完没了地说
senses.example_en: I wish you wouldn't keep on about my mistakes in front of everyone.
senses.example_zh: 我希望你不要当着大家的面老是对我的错误唠叨个没完。

senses.example_en: The company decided to keep on all temporary staff after the busy season.
senses.example_zh: 旺季过后，公司决定留用所有的临时员工。

senses.meaning: 保持，维持（高水平、良好状态或速度）
senses.example_en: You've been doing fantastic work—keep it up!
senses.example_zh: 你一直干得很出色——继续保持！

senses.meaning: 使……无法入睡，使保持清醒
senses.example_en: The loud music from next door kept me up all night.
senses.example_zh: 隔壁吵闹的音乐让我整夜没合眼。

senses.example_en: If the rain keeps up, we will have to cancel the outdoor concert.
senses.example_zh: 如果雨一直下个不停，我们就不得不取消室外音乐会了。

senses.meaning: 跟上（步伐、速度），不落后于
senses.example_en: He walked so fast that the children couldn't keep up with him.
senses.example_zh: 他走得太快，孩子们跟不上他的脚步。

senses.meaning: 跟上，了解（最新消息、潮流或技术发展）
senses.example_en: It's essential for software engineers to keep up with industry trends.
senses.example_zh: 对软件工程师而言，跟进行业最新动态至关重要。

senses.example_en: She still keeps up with several of her high school classmates.
senses.example_zh: 她仍和几位高中同学保持着联系。

senses.meaning: 遵守，遵循（规则、计划、协议或时间表）
senses.example_en: We need to keep to the schedule if we want to finish by Friday.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们想在周五前完成，就必须严格遵守时间表。

senses.meaning: 局限于，不偏离（主题、路线）
senses.example_en: Please keep to the main point and avoid irrelevant details.
senses.example_zh: 请切中要害，不要扯无关紧要的细节。
