senses.example_en: You should keep away from the edge of the cliff.
senses.example_zh: 你应该离悬崖边缘远一点。

senses.example_en: Garlic is said to keep mosquitoes away during summer nights.
senses.example_zh: 据说夏天夜里大蒜能驱赶蚊子。

senses.example_en: He suspected that the witness was keeping something back.
senses.example_zh: 他怀疑证人隐瞒了某些事情。

senses.meaning: 阻挡，阻止上前（或退后不前）
senses.example_en: Police used barricades to keep back the surging crowd.
senses.example_zh: 警方设置路障以阻挡涌动的人群上前。

senses.example_en: She could hardly keep back her tears upon hearing the tragic news.
senses.example_zh: 听到这个噩耗时，她几乎无法忍住眼泪。

senses.example_en: Please keep your voice down; the baby is finally asleep.
senses.example_zh: 请放低声音，宝宝终于睡着了。

senses.meaning: 控制，抑制（成本、价格、通胀等）
senses.example_en: The management implemented new strategies to keep costs down.
senses.example_zh: 管理层实施了新策略以控制成本。

senses.meaning: 吃下或喝下而不吐出来（咽下食物）
senses.example_en: He was so sick that he couldn't even keep any water down.
senses.example_zh: 他病得很厉害，甚至连水都喝不下去，喝了就吐。

senses.example_en: The sign on the lawn clearly says, 'Keep off the grass.'
senses.example_zh: 草坪上的标牌明确写着：“请勿践踏草坪”。

senses.meaning: 避开（敏感或不快的话题）
senses.example_en: Let's keep off politics tonight to avoid unnecessary arguments.
senses.example_zh: 今晚我们避开政治话题吧，免得产生不必要的争执。

senses.meaning: 禁食，戒除（特定食物、烟酒等）
senses.example_en: The doctor advised him to keep off fatty foods until his tests improve.
senses.example_zh: 医生建议他在指标好转前不要吃油腻食物。

senses.example_en: Heavy curtains help keep out the chilly winter wind.
senses.example_zh: 厚窗帘有助于阻挡冬日的刺骨寒风。

senses.meaning: 留在外面，不进入（常见于警示牌）
senses.example_en: Danger! Construction site—keep out!
senses.example_zh: 危险！施工现场，严禁入内！

senses.meaning: 置身事外，不卷入（纠纷、麻烦等）
senses.example_en: I suggest you keep out of their family disputes.
senses.example_zh: 我建议你别卷进他们的家庭纠纷中去。

senses.meaning: 抑制，忍住（情感、怒火、笑声等）
senses.example_en: He was furious, but he tried hard to keep in his temper.
senses.example_zh: 他怒火中烧，但极力压抑着自己的脾气。

senses.example_en: Because of the blizzard, the school kept the children in all afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 由于暴风雪，学校整个下午都把孩子们留在室内。

senses.example_en: The teacher kept Mark in for half an hour for not submitting his homework.
senses.example_zh: 马克因为没交作业被老师罚留校半小时。

senses.meaning: 阻止，抑制（做某事；克制自己）
senses.example_en: She could not keep from laughing at his silly mistake.
senses.example_zh: 看到他犯了那么愚蠢的错误，她忍不住笑出声来。

senses.meaning: 隐瞒（消息、事实等不让某人知道）
senses.example_en: We decided to keep the bad news from her until after the exam.
senses.example_zh: 我们决定在考试结束前瞒着她这个坏消息。

senses.example_en: Learning a new language is tough, but you'll succeed if you keep at it.
senses.example_zh: 学一门新语言很艰难，但只要坚持下去你就会成功的。

senses.example_en: He is quite introverted and tends to keep to himself at social gatherings.
senses.example_zh: 他性格内向，在社交聚会上往往独来独往。

senses.meaning: 守口如瓶，对（消息或秘密）不声张
senses.example_en: I'll tell you about the promotion, but please keep it to yourself for now.
senses.example_zh: 我可以告诉你升职的事，但请你暂时保守秘密。

senses.meaning: 保留在身边，留在近处随时备用
senses.example_en: I always keep a flashlight around in case the power goes out.
senses.example_zh: 我总在手边备着一个手电筒，以防停电。

senses.meaning: 保持领先地位，保持竞争优势
senses.example_en: Continuous innovation is the only way for the company to keep ahead of rivals.
senses.example_zh: 持续创新是该公司在竞争对手面前保持领先地位的唯一途径。

idioms.meaning: 密切注意，留意，照看
idioms.example_en: Could you please keep an eye on my luggage while I go to the restroom?
idioms.example_zh: 我去洗手间时，你能帮我照看一下行李吗？

idioms.meaning: 祈求好运，希望一切顺利
idioms.example_en: I'm keeping my fingers crossed that the interview goes well tomorrow.
idioms.example_zh: 我祈祷明天的面试一切顺利。

idioms.meaning: 绷着脸不笑，强忍住笑意
idioms.example_en: It was impossible to keep a straight face after his hilarious blunder.
idioms.example_zh: 在他闹出那个搞笑的大乌龙后，谁也憋不住笑了。

idioms.meaning: 随时向某人通报最新进展/情况
idioms.example_en: I'm waiting for the lab results, and I'll keep you posted as soon as they arrive.
idioms.example_zh: 我正在等化验结果，一出来我就会随时向你通报。

idioms.meaning: 使某人保持高度警惕，让人不敢松懈
idioms.example_en: The unpredictable pop quizzes are designed to keep the students on their toes.
idioms.example_zh: 难以预测的突击测验旨在让学生们时刻保持警觉不敢懈怠。

idioms.meaning: 保持乐观，不气馁，振作精神
idioms.example_en: Keep your chin up; things are bound to get better soon.
idioms.example_zh: 振作起来，情况很快就会好转的。

idioms.meaning: 密切监视，记录核查...的行踪或动向
idioms.example_en: The manager uses modern software to keep tabs on project milestones.
idioms.example_zh: 经理使用现代软件来密切跟进项目的各个里程碑。

collocations.meaning: 铭记于心，牢记，考虑在内
collocations.example_en: Keep in mind that prices are subject to change without prior notice.
collocations.example_zh: 请牢记，价格如有更改，恕不另行通知。

collocations.meaning: 记录，掌握...的线索/最新信息
collocations.example_en: I use a budgeting app to keep track of my daily expenses.
collocations.example_zh: 我使用记账软件来记录并掌握我每天的花销。

collocations.phrase: keep a promise / keep one's word
collocations.example_en: He earned everyone's trust because he always keeps his word.
collocations.example_zh: 他赢得了所有人的信任，因为他总是言出必行。

collocations.example_en: Even after graduating, the roommates promised to keep in touch regularly.
collocations.example_zh: 即使在毕业后，室友们也承诺会经常保持联系。

collocations.meaning: 保持冷静，控制脾气不发火
collocations.example_en: It was difficult to keep his temper when provoked so rudely.
collocations.example_zh: 遭到如此粗鲁的挑衅，要抑制住怒火确实很难。

collocations.example_en: Thank you for staying behind to keep me company while I finished the report.
collocations.example_zh: 谢谢你留下来陪我完成这份报告。

senses.meaning: 最终到达，最后来到（某地）
senses.example_en: We took a wrong turn on the highway and ended up in an unfamiliar town.
senses.example_zh: 我们在高速上拐错了弯，最后来到了一座陌生的小镇。

senses.meaning: 最终处于，最终落得……结局（后接形容词、介词短语或动名词）
senses.example_en: If you keep spending recklessly, you will end up in debt.
senses.example_zh: 如果你继续挥霍无度，最终会负债累累。

senses.meaning: 以……告终，导致……结局（接 failure, disaster, a draw 等结果词）
senses.example_en: The negotiations ended in deadlock after hours of bitter argument.
senses.example_zh: 经过数小时的激烈争吵，谈判最终以僵局告终。

senses.meaning: 以……结束，以……收尾（指最后的组成部分、乐章或环节）
senses.example_en: The symphony ended with a thunderous crescendo of drums.
senses.example_zh: 交响乐在雷鸣般的鼓声高潮中落下帷幕。

senses.meaning: 彻底结束，画上句号；收尾
senses.example_en: Let's end off the meeting with a quick summary of next week's goals.
senses.example_zh: 让我们对下周的目标做个简要总结，以此结束今天的会议。

senses.meaning: 最终得到，最终落得拥有/面临（常指意外或不愿看到的结果）
senses.example_en: After hours of haggling, she ended up with a deal far worse than expected.
senses.example_zh: 讨价还价几个小时后，她最终达成的交易远比预期的要差。

senses.meaning: 最终以做某事收尾，最后做了某事
senses.example_en: He started out defending his decision, but ended by apologizing to everyone.
senses.example_zh: 他一开始还在为自己的决定辩解，但最后却向所有人道了歉。

senses.meaning: 最终成为，最终沦为（某种身份、角色或状态）
senses.example_en: The ambitious start-up ended up as just another failed project.
senses.example_zh: 那家雄心勃勃的初创公司最终沦为了又一个失败的项目。

senses.meaning: 终极目标，最关键/最核心的事物（常用于 the be-all and end-all）
senses.example_en: Making money is important, but it shouldn't be the end-all of your life.
senses.example_zh: 赚钱固然重要，但不应成为你人生的终极追求。

idioms.meaning: 量入为出，使收支平衡，维持生计
idioms.example_en: Many families are working multiple jobs just to make ends meet in this economy.
idioms.example_zh: 在当前的经济形势下，许多家庭身兼数职仅仅是为了勉强维持生计。

idioms.phrase: at the end of the day
idioms.meaning: 归根结底，说到底，到头来
idioms.example_en: At the end of the day, client satisfaction is the only metric that truly matters.
idioms.example_zh: 说到底，客户满意度才是唯一真正重要的衡量指标。

idioms.meaning: 智穷才尽，束手无策，走投无路
idioms.example_en: I'm at my wit's end trying to figure out why this computer program keeps crashing.
idioms.example_zh: 我实在想不通为什么这个电脑程序老是崩溃，已经束手无策了。

idioms.phrase: burn the candle at both ends
idioms.meaning: 起早贪黑，过度透支精力，过度操劳
idioms.example_en: You will ruin your health if you keep burning the candle at both ends.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你继续这样起早贪黑过度透支，身体迟早会垮掉的。

idioms.phrase: light at the end of the tunnel
idioms.meaning: 隧道尽头的亮光；（困境中）苦尽甘来的希望，曙光
idioms.example_en: After months of painful medical treatments, she can finally see the light at the end of the tunnel.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数月痛苦的治疗后，她终于看到了康复的曙光。

idioms.meaning: 遥遥无期，看不到尽头
idioms.example_en: With the rain pouring relentlessly, there was no end in sight to the delays.
idioms.example_zh: 大雨倾盆而下，航班延误看起来遥遥无期。

idioms.meaning: 尽到自己的职责，不甘示弱，独当一面
idioms.example_en: In a team effort, every member is expected to hold their end up.
idioms.example_zh: 在团队合作中，每位成员都应当恪尽职守、各司其职。

collocations.example_en: The long era of rapid economic growth has finally come to an end.
collocations.example_zh: 经济高速增长的漫长时代终于画上了句号。

collocations.example_en: The government introduced strict laws to put an end to illegal poaching.
collocations.example_zh: 政府出台了严厉的法律，以彻底杜绝非法偷猎行为。

collocations.example_en: The signing of the peace treaty brought the decades-long war to an end.
collocations.example_zh: 和平条约的签署使这场长达数十年的战争走向了终结。

collocations.meaning: 结束一段感情关系/婚姻
collocations.example_en: They mutually decided to end their marriage on amicable terms.
collocations.example_zh: 他们和平商定，以友好的方式结束彼此的婚姻。

collocations.meaning: 以灾难/失败收场，惨淡告终
collocations.example_en: The ill-conceived military expedition ended in total disaster.
collocations.example_zh: 这次谋划不周的军事远征最终以彻底的灾难惨淡收场。

collocations.example_en: As the fiscal year drew near the end, departments rushed to balance their books.
collocations.example_zh: 随着财政年度临近尾声，各部门纷纷抓紧结清账目。

senses.example_en: I need to quickly change into something more comfortable before the guests arrive.
senses.example_zh: 客人来之前，我得赶紧换上一身舒服点的衣服。

senses.example_en: With a wave of the wand, the pumpkin changed into a golden carriage.
senses.example_zh: 魔杖一挥，南瓜就变成了一辆金色的马车。

senses.example_en: As soon as he got home, he changed out of his wet suit.
senses.example_zh: 他一到家就换掉了身上湿透的西装。

senses.meaning: 切换，转向（系统、方式或技术）
senses.example_en: The hospital is planning to change over to a fully digital records system next month.
senses.example_zh: 该医院计划下个月全面切换至数字化病历系统。

senses.example_en: The nurses usually change over at seven in the morning.
senses.example_zh: 护士们通常在早上七点进行交接班。

senses.meaning: 调换位置，重新摆放（家具或物品）
senses.example_en: We decided to change the living room furniture around to create more space.
senses.example_zh: 我们决定把客厅的家具重新摆放一下，以腾出更多空间。

senses.meaning: 改变顺序，重新调整安排
senses.example_en: The director changed around the running order of the show at the last minute.
senses.example_zh: 导演在最后一刻调整了节目的演出顺序。

senses.example_en: At midnight, the carriage changed back into a pumpkin.
senses.example_zh: 午夜时分，马车又变回了南瓜。

senses.meaning: 换回（原本的衣服、货币等）
senses.example_en: You can change your leftover foreign currency back into local money at the airport.
senses.example_zh: 你可以在机场把没用完的外币兑换回本国货币。

senses.example_en: You should change down to second gear when going up a steep hill.
senses.example_zh: 上陡坡时，你应该减到二挡。

senses.example_en: Once you reach sixty miles per hour, you can change up into fifth gear.
senses.example_zh: 时速达到六十英里后，你就可以换到五挡了。

senses.meaning: 做出改变，调整策略（以寻求突破）
senses.example_en: The team needs to change up its tactics if it wants to win the championship.
senses.example_zh: 该队如果想夺冠，就必须改变战术打法。

senses.meaning: 轮流，交替替换（分担某项工作）
senses.example_en: During the long drive across the desert, the two drivers changed off every two hours.
senses.example_zh: 在穿越沙漠的长途驾驶中，两位司机每隔两小时轮流开一次。

idioms.meaning: 改变主意；改变想法
idioms.example_en: She was planning to study law, but she changed her mind at the last moment.
idioms.example_zh: 她本打算学法律，但在最后一刻改变了主意。

idioms.meaning: 态度改变；回心转意
idioms.example_en: The landlord had a change of heart and decided to extend our lease.
idioms.example_zh: 房东回心转意，决定延长我们的租约。

idioms.meaning: （因情势变化）彻底改变口风或态度
idioms.example_en: He opposed the project until he saw the budget, and then he quickly changed his tune.
idioms.example_zh: 他原本反对这个项目，但一看到预算就立刻改了口风。

idioms.meaning: （财产、公司等）易主；转手
idioms.example_en: The historic manor has changed hands several times over the past century.
idioms.example_zh: 过去一个世纪里，这座历史悠久的庄园已经多次易主。

idioms.meaning: 换换节奏；调节一下生活/工作状态
idioms.example_en: Working from home once a week provides a welcome change of pace.
idioms.example_zh: 每周在家办公一天是调节工作节奏的不错方式。

idioms.meaning: 换汤不换药；以不同方式变换花样
idioms.example_en: You can ring the changes on this simple recipe by adding different herbs.
idioms.example_zh: 你可以在这道简单食谱中加入不同的香草，变出新花样。

idioms.meaning: 别老调重弹；换个话题（常用于表示厌烦）
idioms.example_en: Stop complaining about the weather and change the record!
idioms.example_zh: 别老抱怨天气了，换个话题吧！

collocations.example_en: His health took a sudden change for the worse over the weekend.
collocations.example_zh: 周末他的健康状况突然恶化。

collocations.example_en: Whenever I ask about his finances, he immediately changes the subject.
collocations.example_zh: 每当我问起他的财务状况，他就立刻岔开话题。

collocations.meaning: 与某人调换位置；与某人易地而处
collocations.example_en: Nobody in their right mind would want to change places with the prime minister right now.
collocations.example_zh: 眼下头脑清醒的人谁都不想与首相换位处之。

collocations.meaning: 做出改变；（以 It makes a change 开头）真难得/换个样真好
collocations.example_en: It makes a pleasant change to see the sun after weeks of rain.
collocations.example_zh: 连绵阴雨数周后终于见到太阳，真是让人心情舒畅。

collocations.example_en: When direct criticism failed, the manager decided to change tack and offer encouragement.
collocations.example_zh: 当直接批评无济于事时，经理决定改变策略，转而给予鼓励。

collocations.meaning: 转变方向；转变人生/事业轨迹
collocations.example_en: After twenty years in banking, she changed direction and opened a bakery.
collocations.example_zh: 在银行业工作二十年后，她转变了职业方向，开了一家面包店。

senses.example_en: Prolonged stress can lead to a variety of serious health issues.
senses.example_zh: 长期的压力会导致各种严重的健康问题。

senses.example_en: This narrow stone path leads directly to the mountain summit.
senses.example_zh: 这条狭窄的石阶小路直通山顶。

senses.meaning: （时间上）作为…的先导，在…之前发生
senses.example_en: Security was significantly heightened in the weeks leading up to the election.
senses.example_zh: 在选举前的几周里，安保级别显著提升。

senses.meaning: 逐渐引出（某个话题或请求）
senses.example_en: He made small talk for ten minutes, leading up to asking for a loan.
senses.example_zh: 他闲聊了十分钟，借此巧妙地引出想借钱的话题。

senses.meaning: 误导，哄骗（使人抱有虚假希望）
senses.example_en: She had no intention of marrying him; she was just leading him on.
senses.example_zh: 她根本无意嫁给他，只是在吊着他玩弄感情。

senses.meaning: 领路前行，带头走在前面
senses.example_en: You know the trail best, so you lead on and we will follow.
senses.example_zh: 你对这条路线最熟，你带头往前走，我们在后面跟着。

senses.example_en: The keynote speaker led off with an amusing anecdote about his early career.
senses.example_zh: 主讲人以一段关于他早年职业生涯的趣闻轶事作为开场。

senses.example_en: He led off the bottom of the ninth inning with a solo home run.
senses.example_zh: 他在第九局下半场首棒登场，轰出了一记单人本垒打。

senses.meaning: 押走，带走（拘留或远离现场）
senses.example_en: The handcuffed suspect was led away by two armed police officers.
senses.example_zh: 戴着手铐的嫌疑人被两名持枪警官押解离开。

senses.example_en: The mother bird feigned an injury to lead predators away from her nest.
senses.example_zh: 母鸟假装受伤，以把捕食者从鸟巢旁引开。

senses.meaning: 过渡到，平滑引入（下一部分或话题）
senses.example_en: The acoustic guitar solo nicely leads into the energetic chorus.
senses.example_zh: 这段原声吉他独奏非常自然地过渡到了充满力量的高潮副歌。

senses.meaning: 通入，连接到（另一个空间）
senses.example_en: The main hallway leads into a spacious open-plan kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 主走廊直接通向一个宽敞的开放式厨房。

senses.meaning: 带头离场，领出（人员、队伍等）
senses.example_en: The captain led out the team onto the pitch amidst roaring cheers.
senses.example_zh: 队长在雷鸣般的欢呼声中带领球队步入球场。

senses.meaning: （自行车等竞速中）为冲刺队员领骑
senses.example_en: His teammate worked tirelessly to lead him out for the final bunch sprint.
senses.example_zh: 他的队友不知疲倦地为他领骑，以便助他在最后的大团冲刺中夺冠。

senses.example_en: All the evidence uncovered by the investigation leads back to the same offshore account.
senses.example_zh: 调查发现的所有线索最终都指向了同一个离岸账户。

senses.example_en: If we follow this winding creek downstream, it will lead us back to the campsite.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们顺着这条蜿蜒的小溪顺流而下，它会把我们带回营地。

idioms.meaning: 牵着某人的鼻子走；彻底操纵某人
idioms.example_en: He is so gullible that his business partner leads him by the nose in every deal.
idioms.example_zh: 他太轻信他人了，以至于生意合伙人在每笔交易中都牵着他的鼻子走。

idioms.meaning: 引路；走在前面；树立榜样/处于领跑地位
idioms.example_en: The company has led the way in developing renewable energy solutions.
idioms.example_zh: 该公司在开发可再生能源解决方案方面始终处于领跑地位。

idioms.phrase: lead sb up the garden path
idioms.meaning: 故意误导；欺骗某人
idioms.example_en: Consumers were led up the garden path by false claims in the advertisement.
idioms.example_zh: 消费者被广告中的虚假宣传彻底误导了。

idioms.meaning: 过双重生活
idioms.example_en: It turned out that the mild-mannered accountant was leading a double life as a master thief.
idioms.example_zh: 事实证明，这位举止温和的会计师竟然过着大盗的暗地双重生活。

idioms.meaning: 身先士卒；以身作则树立榜样
idioms.example_en: A good manager should lead from the front during challenging crises.
idioms.example_zh: 优秀的管理者在面临危机挑战时应当身先士卒。

idioms.meaning: 处于领头羊地位；在竞争中拔得头筹
idioms.example_en: With its innovative camera technology, the smartphone brand continues to lead the pack.
idioms.example_zh: 凭借创新的摄像技术，该智能手机品牌继续在行业中领跑。

idioms.meaning: 过着牛马不如的生活；日子困苦悲惨
idioms.example_en: Under the tyranny of the cruel boss, the factory workers led a dog's life.
idioms.example_zh: 在那位残酷老板的暴政下，工厂工人们过着牛马不如的生活。

collocations.example_en: Great leaders inspire others by leading by example rather than just giving orders.
collocations.example_zh: 伟大的领导者通过以身作则而非仅仅发号施令来激励他人。

collocations.example_en: Even in her eighties, my grandmother continues to lead an active life.
collocations.example_zh: 即使到了八十多岁，我祖母依然过着活力充沛的生活。

collocations.example_en: A senior detective was appointed to lead the murder investigation.
collocations.example_zh: 一名资深侦探被指派主持这起谋杀案的调查工作。

collocations.example_en: Our team took the lead in the second quarter and held it until the final whistle.
collocations.example_zh: 我们队在第二节取得领先，并将优势一直保持到终场哨声吹响。

collocations.meaning: 把某人引上歧途；误导某人
collocations.example_en: The teenager was led astray by older kids who were involved in petty theft.
collocations.example_zh: 这名青少年被涉嫌小偷小摸的大龄孩子引上了歧途。

collocations.example_en: She managed to hold the lead throughout the entire marathon.
collocations.example_zh: 她在整场马拉松比赛中都成功保持了领先地位。

senses.example_en: We've run out of coffee, so I'll grab some on my way home.
senses.example_zh: 我们的咖啡喝完了，我下班回家路上顺便买点。

senses.example_en: My passport runs out next month, so I need to renew it.
senses.example_zh: 我的护照下个月就要到期了，我得去换发一本新护照。

senses.example_en: I ran into an old college friend at the supermarket yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 我昨天在超市偶遇了一位大学老同学。

senses.example_en: The delivery truck lost control and ran into a lamppost.
senses.example_zh: 那辆送货卡车失控撞上了路灯杆。

senses.meaning: 遭遇，陷入（困难、麻烦或债务）
senses.example_en: The startup ran into severe financial difficulties within its first year.
senses.example_zh: 这家初创公司在第一年就遭遇了严重的财务困难。

senses.meaning: 偶然碰见（某人）或发现（某物）
senses.example_en: I ran across some old family letters while cleaning out the attic.
senses.example_zh: 我在清理阁楼时偶然发现了一些旧的家信。

senses.example_en: The teenager ran away from home after a heated argument with his parents.
senses.example_zh: 那个少年和父母激烈争吵后离家出走了。

senses.meaning: 逃避，回避（问题、责任或现实）
senses.example_en: You can't keep running away from your responsibilities forever.
senses.example_zh: 你不能永远这样逃避自己的责任。

senses.example_en: She ran after the bus, waving frantically to catch the driver's attention.
senses.example_zh: 她拼命追赶公共汽车，疯狂挥手想引起司机的注意。

senses.example_en: He spent the entire semester running after Sarah, but she wasn't interested.
senses.example_zh: 他整个学期都在追求萨拉，但她毫无兴趣。

senses.example_en: He braked hard, terrified that he had run over a stray dog.
senses.example_zh: 他紧急刹车，生怕自己撞到了一只流浪狗。

senses.example_en: The morning meeting ran over by twenty minutes, delaying the presentation.
senses.example_zh: 早会超时了二十分钟，耽误了后面的展示汇报。

senses.example_en: Turn off the tap before the bathwater runs over onto the floor.
senses.example_zh: 在浴缸的水溢到地板上之前快把水龙头关掉。

senses.example_en: Let's run over the key points once more before the client arrives.
senses.example_zh: 在客户到达之前，我们再快速过一遍核心要点吧。

senses.meaning: 排练，快速过一遍（流程、台词等）
senses.example_en: The cast ran through the opening scene one last time before the curtain went up.
senses.example_zh: 开演前，演员们最后把开场戏排练了一遍。

senses.example_en: A subtle sense of nostalgia runs through all of his novels.
senses.example_zh: 淡淡的怀旧情愫贯穿于他的所有小说之中。

senses.example_en: He ran through his entire inheritance in less than two years.
senses.example_zh: 他在不到两年的时间里就挥霍光了所有遗产。

senses.meaning: （电池、钟表等）电量耗尽，停止运转
senses.example_en: My phone's battery has run down completely; do you have a charger?
senses.example_zh: 我手机电量彻底耗尽了，你有充电器吗？

senses.example_en: Stop running yourself down—you did a fantastic job on the project.
senses.example_zh: 别再妄自菲薄贬低自己了——你在这个项目上做得非常出色。

senses.example_en: The cyclist was run down by a speeding taxi at the intersection.
senses.example_zh: 这名骑车人在十字路口被一辆超速的出租车撞倒了。

senses.meaning: 逐步减少，缩减（业务规模或库存）
senses.example_en: The company decided to run down its coal operations over the next decade.
senses.example_zh: 该公司决定在未来十年内逐步削减其煤炭业务。

senses.meaning: 积欠，累积（大额账单、债务）
senses.example_en: She ran up huge credit card debts while shopping in Paris.
senses.example_zh: 她在巴黎购物时欠下了巨额信用卡债务。

senses.example_en: The crew ran up the national flag as the ship entered the port.
senses.example_zh: 当轮船驶入港口时，船员们迅速升起了国旗。

senses.meaning: 匆忙缝制，快速赶制（衣物等）
senses.example_en: My grandmother ran up a lovely dress for the party in just one afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 我奶奶仅用一个下午就赶制出了一件漂亮的聚会礼服。

senses.meaning: 遭遇，面临（困难、阻力、强硬对手）
senses.example_en: The proposed tax reforms ran up against fierce opposition in parliament.
senses.example_zh: 拟议中的税制改革在议会遭遇了强烈的反对。

senses.example_en: This new hybrid vehicle can run on either petrol or electricity.
senses.example_zh: 这款新型混合动力汽车既能用汽油也能用电驱动运转。

senses.example_en: The debate ran on well past midnight with no sign of a consensus.
senses.example_zh: 辩论一直持续到深夜，丝毫没有达成共识的迹象。

senses.meaning: 滔滔不绝，喋喋不休地说
senses.example_en: Once Uncle Joe starts talking about politics, he just runs on and on.
senses.example_zh: 乔叔叔一旦聊起政治，就会喋喋不休地说个没完。

senses.example_en: The shoplifter ran off as soon as the security guard turned his back.
senses.example_zh: 保安一转身，那个小偷就拔腿逃跑了。

senses.example_en: Could you please run off fifty copies of this agenda for the conference?
senses.example_zh: 你能帮我把这份会议议程印制五十份吗？

senses.meaning: 与……私奔，抛下原有生活出走 (run off with)
senses.example_en: Rumor has it that he ran off with his former secretary.
senses.example_zh: 有传言说他和之前的前秘书私奔了。

senses.example_en: Heavy rain quickly ran off the steep roof into the gutters.
senses.example_zh: 大雨迅速从陡峭的屋顶顺势流进了排水沟。

senses.example_en: Avoid driving at high speeds while you are running in the new car engine.
senses.example_zh: 在磨合新车引擎期间，请尽量避免高速行驶。

senses.example_en: The police ran him in for disorderly conduct outside the bar.
senses.example_zh: 警方因他在酒吧外扰乱公共秩序而将他拘捕带回局里。

senses.example_en: I'll run in on Mrs. Gable on my way to the pharmacy to see if she needs anything.
senses.example_zh: 我去药房顺路拐过去看看盖博太太，问问她是否需要什么。

senses.meaning: 遗弃，抛弃（家庭、伴侣或需要帮助的人）
senses.example_en: He ran out on his wife and two young children without leaving a penny.
senses.example_zh: 他抛弃了妻子和两个年幼的孩子，甚至一分钱都没留下。

senses.meaning: 走开，离开（常用于温和、客气地吩咐儿童离开）
senses.example_en: Run along now, kids; the adults need to discuss some serious matters.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们快自己去玩吧，大人们要商量些正经事了。

senses.meaning: 把……向某人讲一遍以征求意见 (run sth by sb)
senses.example_en: I have a few new marketing ideas I'd love to run by you before the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 我有些新的营销想法，想在开会前先跟您念叨念叨征求一下意见。

senses.example_en: I've been running around all day trying to sort out my visa paperwork.
senses.example_zh: 我今天一整天都在四处奔波，忙着办理我的签证材料。

senses.example_en: The children were running around in the backyard until sunset.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们在后院到处嬉戏打闹，一直玩到日落。

senses.example_en: Could you run that tape back? I couldn't hear what he said at the end.
senses.example_zh: 你能把那段录音倒回去重放一下吗？我最后那句没听清。

senses.example_en: Don't bother calling a cab; I'll run you back to your hotel.
senses.example_zh: 别叫出租车了，我顺道开车送你回酒店。

idioms.meaning: 精疲力竭，失去势头或动力
idioms.example_en: After five consecutive hours of intense negotiations, both parties seemed to run out of steam.
idioms.example_zh: 在连续进行了五个小时的紧张谈判后，双方似乎都筋疲力尽、没了后劲。

idioms.meaning: （特征、才华或疾病）世代相传，家族遗传
idioms.example_en: Musical talent runs in their family; every single child plays at least one instrument well.
idioms.example_zh: 音乐天赋是他们家族世代相传的；每个孩子都至少精通一种乐器。

idioms.meaning: 管理严格，纪律严明
idioms.example_en: The new headmistress runs a tight ship, ensuring every teacher adheres to the strict schedule.
idioms.example_zh: 新任女校长治校极严，确保每位老师都严格遵守时间表。

idioms.meaning: 从长远来看，终究
idioms.example_en: Investing in high-quality equipment may seem expensive now, but it will save money in the long run.
idioms.example_zh: 现在投资高品质设备看似昂贵，但从长远来看能够节省资金。

idioms.meaning: 冒着……的风险
idioms.example_en: If you skip the testing phase, you run the risk of releasing a defective software update.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你跳过测试环节，就会冒着发布有缺陷软件更新的风险。

idioms.meaning: 普通的，平淡无奇的，乏善可陈的
idioms.example_en: It wasn't an extraordinary movie, just a run-of-the-mill romantic comedy.
idioms.example_zh: 那并不是一部特别出彩的电影，只是一部平淡无奇的浪漫喜剧。

idioms.meaning: 远胜于某人，把某人耍得团团转
idioms.example_en: In debates, she easily runs circles around her opponents thanks to her sharp legal mind.
idioms.example_zh: 在辩论中，凭借敏锐的法律思维，她可以轻而易举地把对手驳得毫无还手之力。

collocations.example_en: Running a small business requires not only capital but also relentless dedication.
collocations.example_zh: 经营一家小企业不仅需要资金，还需要不懈的投入与专注。

collocations.example_en: The lab technicians will run several diagnostic tests on the blood samples today.
collocations.example_zh: 实验室技术人员今天将对这些血液样本进行几项诊断测试。

collocations.example_en: The child woke up crying in the middle of the night and was running a high fever.
collocations.example_zh: 孩子半夜哭着醒来，发着高烧。

collocations.example_en: I'm terribly sorry for running late; my commuter train was delayed by signal failures.
collocations.example_zh: 非常抱歉我迟到了，我坐的通勤火车因为信号故障延误了。

collocations.example_en: I have to spend my Saturday afternoon running errands like grocery shopping and picking up dry cleaning.
collocations.example_zh: 我周六下午得用来跑腿办杂务，比如买菜和取干洗的衣服。

collocations.meaning: （情感、信念、传统等）根深蒂固，刻骨铭心
collocations.example_en: Rivalry between the two neighboring cities runs deep and dates back several centuries.
collocations.example_zh: 这两座相邻城市之间的对抗根深蒂固，可以追溯到几个世纪之前。

senses.meaning: 争取过来，赢得……的好感与支持
senses.example_en: His witty presentation helped win over even the most skeptical investors.
senses.example_zh: 他机智风趣的演说赢得了哪怕是最持怀疑态度的投资者的支持。

senses.meaning: 赢回，夺回，重获（信任、市场份额、失地）
senses.example_en: The brand is launching a loyalty program to win back lost customers.
senses.example_zh: 该品牌正在推出会员忠诚计划，以赢回流失的客户。

senses.meaning: 最终战胜，占上风，克服困难后获胜
senses.example_en: Despite all the political interference, common sense eventually won out.
senses.example_zh: 尽管受到重重政治干扰，常识和理性最终还是占了上风。

senses.meaning: 渡过难关，历经艰险最终成功
senses.example_en: It was a grueling year of cancer treatment, but she won through in the end.
senses.example_zh: 那是一整年艰难的癌症治疗过程，但她最终挺了过来战胜了病魔。

senses.meaning: 说服，使转变观念，赢得赞同（英式常用）
senses.example_en: Her parents were initially against the move, but she managed to win them round.
senses.example_zh: 她父母起初反对这次搬迁，但她最终成功说服了他们。

senses.example_en: He bragged about the fifty dollars he had won off his brother at poker.
senses.example_zh: 他吹嘘自己在打扑克时从他哥哥那里赢了五十美元。

senses.meaning: 将（客户、拥护者等）从竞争对手处争取或抢夺过来
senses.example_en: The innovative platform succeeded in winning users away from established rivals.
senses.example_zh: 这个创新平台成功地从老牌竞争对手手中争夺到了大量用户。

senses.meaning: 战胜，压倒（对手、阻力或消极情绪）
senses.example_en: In the end, his passion for filmmaking won out over his fears of financial instability.
senses.example_zh: 最终，他对电影制作的热忱战胜了对经济不稳定的恐惧。

idioms.meaning: 轻而易举地获胜，毫无悬念地赢得
idioms.example_en: Given her remarkable experience, she won the mayoral election hands down.
idioms.example_zh: 鉴于她卓越的资历与经验，她轻而易举地赢得了市长选举。

idioms.meaning: 获得最终胜利，取得成功
idioms.example_en: It was their team's superior endurance and disciplined defense that ultimately won the day.
idioms.example_zh: 正是该团队出色的耐力和纪律严明的防守最终锁定了胜局。

idioms.meaning: 赢得某人的芳心，博得某人的喜爱
idioms.example_en: With his warm sense of humor and attentiveness, he quickly won her heart.
idioms.example_zh: 凭借温暖的幽默感和体贴入微，他迅速赢得了她的芳心。

idioms.meaning: 人生不可能事事如意，胜败乃家常便饭（安慰他人）
idioms.example_en: Don't be too disheartened by losing this single contract; you can't win them all.
idioms.example_zh: 不要因为失去这一份合同就太沮丧；胜败乃兵家常事，不可能事事顺心。

idioms.meaning: 立功立业，崭露头角，确立自己的地位与声誉
idioms.example_en: He won his spurs as a fearless foreign correspondent covering conflicts across the Middle East.
idioms.example_zh: 他作为一名无畏的战地记者报道中东冲突，从而确立了自己的行业声誉。

idioms.meaning: 不论输赢，无论成败
idioms.example_en: Win or lose, we should be proud of having given everything we had on the pitch.
idioms.example_zh: 不论输赢，我们都应该为自己在球场上拼尽全力而感到自豪。

collocations.example_en: Her debut novel won several prestigious literary awards within months of release.
collocations.example_zh: 她的处女作小说在出版数月内便赢得了数个极具声望的文学奖项。

collocations.example_en: The incumbent governor won the election by an unexpectedly wide margin.
collocations.example_zh: 现任州长以出人意料的巨大优势赢得了大选。

collocations.example_en: The infrastructure proposal must win parliamentary approval before funds can be released.
collocations.example_zh: 这项基础设施方案必须在获得议会批准后才能拨付资金。

collocations.example_en: The engineering consortium successfully won the multimillion-dollar railway construction contract.
collocations.example_zh: 该工程财团成功赢得了这项价值数百万美元的铁路建设合同。

collocations.example_en: Over three decades, the hospital has won an international reputation for cardiac surgery.
collocations.example_zh: 三十多年来，该医院在心脏外科手术领域赢得了国际声誉。

collocations.example_en: The newly appointed CEO worked tirelessly to win the confidence of skeptical shareholders.
collocations.example_zh: 新任命的首席执行官不知疲倦地工作，以赢得多疑股东们的信任。

senses.meaning: 符合，达到（期望、标准、诺言）
senses.example_en: The concert didn't quite live up to our high expectations.
senses.example_zh: 这场音乐会并没能完全达到我们很高的期望。

senses.meaning: 靠（特定金钱或食物）生活
senses.example_en: They had to live on bread and water during the harsh winter.
senses.example_zh: 在严冬里，他们不得不靠面包和水勉强维生。

senses.meaning: （名声、记忆、精神等）继续存在，流传
senses.example_en: Her legacy will live on through the charity she founded.
senses.example_zh: 她的精神将通过她创办的慈善机构永远流传下去。

senses.meaning: 忍受，接受（不可改变的不快局面）
senses.example_en: The damage is done, and now we just have to live with the consequences.
senses.example_zh: 损失已经造成，现在我们只能承受后果。

senses.example_en: She moved to London to live with her boyfriend.
senses.example_zh: 她搬到伦敦和男朋友住在一起。

senses.meaning: 度过，经历（艰难时期、灾难等考验）
senses.example_en: He lived through two world wars and several major crises.
senses.example_zh: 他经历了两次世界大战和几场重大危机。

senses.meaning: 让人忘掉，洗刷（过去的过失或耻辱）
senses.example_en: If you make such a silly mistake on stage, you'll never live it down.
senses.example_zh: 如果你在舞台上犯了这么愚蠢的错误，这辈子都别想让人忘记了。

senses.meaning: 依靠（积蓄、养老金或他人）过活，啃老
senses.example_en: He's nearly thirty and still living off his parents.
senses.example_zh: 他快三十岁了，还在靠父母养活。

senses.example_en: The stray dog lived off scraps from the local restaurant.
senses.example_zh: 那只流浪狗靠当地餐馆倒掉的剩菜剩饭为生。

senses.example_en: She was finally able to live out her dream of traveling the world.
senses.example_zh: 她终于实现了环游世界的梦想。

senses.example_en: The retired couple moved to the coast to live out their days in peace.
senses.example_zh: 这对退休夫妇搬到了海边，安享晚年。

senses.meaning: （佣人、学生等）住在工作或学习场所以外
senses.example_en: Most domestic staff at the estate live out.
senses.example_zh: 庄园里的大多数家政人员都不住在这里。

senses.meaning: 遵循，信奉（某种原则或信条）
senses.example_en: Honesty is the golden rule he chose to live by.
senses.example_zh: 诚实是他选择恪守的处世金科玉律。

senses.example_en: The villagers lived by fishing and trading goods.
senses.example_zh: 村民们靠捕鱼和以物易物维生。

senses.meaning: 为……而活；视……为生命中最重要的事情
senses.example_en: He lives for football and spends every weekend on the pitch.
senses.example_zh: 他简直为足球而生，每个周末都在球场上度过。

senses.meaning: 住在工作场所（如保姆、管家、住院医生等）
senses.example_en: They are looking for a reliable live-in nanny for their twins.
senses.example_zh: 他们正在为双胞胎物色一位可靠的住家保姆。

senses.example_en: They decided to live together before getting married.
senses.example_zh: 他们决定在结婚前先住在一起。

senses.meaning: 重新经历；重温（过去的体验或记忆）
senses.example_en: In his mind, he lived over the moments of their first meeting.
senses.example_zh: 在他脑海里，他一遍遍重温着初次相遇的场景。

idioms.meaning: 尽情狂欢，纵情享乐
idioms.example_en: After winning the lottery, they went to Las Vegas to live it up.
idioms.example_zh: 中彩票之后，他们去拉斯维加斯尽情享乐了一番。

idioms.meaning: 待人宽容，各行其是（包容他人的不同生活方式）
idioms.example_en: I don't agree with their lifestyle, but I believe in live and let live.
idioms.example_zh: 我并不认同他们的生活方式，但我主张宽以待人、互不干涉。

idioms.meaning: 过着勉强度日、朝不保夕的生活
idioms.example_en: Without a steady income, the family was forced to live hand to mouth.
idioms.example_zh: 没有稳定的收入，这一家人不得不勉强糊口度日。

idioms.meaning: 活一天算一天；时日无多；大难不死而苟活
idioms.example_en: Since surviving the plane crash, he felt he was living on borrowed time.
idioms.example_zh: 自从空难幸存以来，他觉得自己多活的每一天都是赚来的。

idioms.meaning: 过着自欺欺人、掩盖真相的虚伪生活
idioms.example_en: She could no longer bear to live a lie and finally told her family the truth.
idioms.example_zh: 她再也无法忍受这种自欺欺人的生活，终于向家人坦白了真相。

idioms.meaning: 形影不离；过于密切以致缺乏个人空间
idioms.example_en: Sharing a tiny studio made them feel like they were living in each other's pockets.
idioms.example_zh: 挤在一间狭小的单身公寓里，让他们觉得彼此毫无隐私和个人空间。

collocations.example_en: Financial advisors urge young workers to live within their means.
collocations.example_zh: 理财顾问敦促年轻工薪族要量入为出。

collocations.example_en: Relying on multiple credit cards led him to live beyond his means.
collocations.example_zh: 依靠多张信用卡透支导致他陷入了入不敷出的生活。

collocations.example_en: Civilians in the conflict zone have to live in fear every day.
collocations.example_zh: 冲突地区的平民每天都不得不生活在恐惧之中。

collocations.example_en: The secret agent lived a double life as a quiet bookstore owner.
collocations.example_zh: 这名特工过着双重生活，表面上是一家书店的沉静店主。

collocations.meaning: 死里逃生，幸存下来讲述经历
collocations.example_en: The storm was devastating, but luckily all the crew lived to tell the tale.
collocations.example_zh: 暴风雨极具毁灭性，但幸运的是所有船员都大难不死。

collocations.meaning: 和平与和睦地共处生活
collocations.example_en: The treaty allowed both communities to live in peace and harmony.
collocations.example_zh: 该条约使两个族群得以和平与睦邻共处。

senses.example_en: He was carefully schooled in the nuances of international diplomacy.
senses.example_zh: 他在国际外交的微妙规则方面受过严格细致的训练。

senses.meaning: 严格约束自己做……；强迫自己适应……
senses.example_en: She had to school herself to remain calm despite the barrage of insults.
senses.example_zh: 尽管面对连番侮辱，她还是强迫自己保持克制与冷静。

senses.example_en: The coach schooled his players to anticipate the opponent's moves.
senses.example_zh: 教练调教队员们要学会预判对手的动作。

senses.meaning: （鱼群等海洋生物）聚集成群游动
senses.example_en: Tiny herring school together to confuse predators.
senses.example_zh: 微小的鲱鱼聚集结群游动以迷惑捕食者。

senses.meaning: 通过教导使某人改掉（坏习惯或粗鄙举止）
senses.example_en: His mentor patiently schooled him out of his arrogant attitude.
senses.example_zh: 他的导师耐心地教导他，帮他改掉了傲慢的习气。

senses.meaning: 进修；系统提升知识或专业技能
senses.example_en: He spent the summer schooling up on the latest data analysis techniques.
senses.example_zh: 他利用整个夏天恶补并进修了最新的数据分析技术。

senses.meaning: 把……调教成……；训练使之养成（特定思维或行为模式）
senses.example_en: Recruits are gradually schooled into absolute obedience during basic training.
senses.example_zh: 新兵在基础训练中逐渐被调教成绝对服从命令的军人。

senses.meaning: 严厉教训/申斥某人；（在辩论或竞技中）完胜并给对方上一课
senses.example_en: The veteran lawyer completely schooled his younger opponent down in court today.
senses.example_zh: 今天在法庭上，那位资深律师完胜了年轻对手，狠狠地给他上了一课。

idioms.meaning: 思想学派；某种特定观点流派
idioms.example_en: There is a prominent school of thought advocating for lower corporate taxes.
idioms.example_zh: 有一个著名的思想流派主张降低企业税率。

idioms.meaning: 老派的；守旧的；具有传统道德风尚的
idioms.example_en: The professor is a gentleman of the old school who still writes letters with a fountain pen.
idioms.example_zh: 教授是位老派的绅士，至今仍坚持用钢笔写信。

idioms.meaning: 社会大学；艰难挫折的生活历练
idioms.example_en: He never attended college; everything he learned came from the school of hard knocks.
idioms.example_zh: 他从未上过大学，他所有的本事都是在社会的摸爬滚打中学来的。

idioms.meaning: 揭丑，搬弄是非；泄露内部秘密
idioms.example_en: I don't mean to tell tales out of school, but Mark was the one who leaked the memo.
idioms.example_zh: 我不想在背后说人闲话，但那份备忘录确实是马克泄露出去的。

idioms.meaning: （口语）给某人上一课；在某方面狠狠教训/击败某人
idioms.example_en: The young prodigy schooled the veteran players on advanced chess tactics.
idioms.example_zh: 这位年轻的神童在高阶棋艺战术上给那些老手们狠狠上了一课。

idioms.meaning: 装酷；自命不凡，不屑于合群
idioms.example_en: He sat at the back of the room acting like he was too cool for school.
idioms.example_zh: 他坐在房间后排，一副自命不凡、不屑与他人为伍的样子。

collocations.meaning: 受过……良好教育/训练；深谙于……
collocations.example_en: She was well schooled in the classical traditions of European art.
collocations.example_zh: 她在欧洲古典艺术传统方面受过极为扎实的熏陶。

collocations.meaning: 收敛/克制脸上的表情；强作镇定
collocations.example_en: He carefully schooled his expression so as not to betray his inner shock.
collocations.example_zh: 他极力克制住脸上的表情，以免暴露内心的震惊。

collocations.example_en: A successful negotiator must learn how to school their temper under pressure.
collocations.example_zh: 成功的谈判代表必须学会在压力下克制自己的脾气。

collocations.example_en: He dropped out of school at seventeen to start his own technology firm.
collocations.example_zh: 他在十七岁时辍学去开创自己的科技公司。

collocations.example_en: In many remote areas, children still have to walk miles to attend school.
collocations.example_zh: 在许多偏远地区，孩子们仍然要步行数英里去上学。

collocations.example_en: After graduating from school, she joined an international NGO.
collocations.example_zh: 从学校毕业后，她加入了一家国际非政府组织。

senses.example_en: Their successful partnership was founded on mutual trust and respect.
senses.example_zh: 他们成功的合作关系建立在相互信任和尊重的基础之上。

senses.meaning: 基于；以……为根据（正式用语，同 found on）
senses.example_en: The legal system is founded upon the principle that everyone is equal before the law.
senses.example_zh: 该法律体系基于法律面前人人平等的原则。

senses.example_en: The philosopher's theories are deeply founded in classical humanism.
senses.example_zh: 这位哲学家的理论深深根植于古典人道主义之中。

senses.meaning: 有事实根据；建立在事实之上
senses.example_en: These serious allegations must be founded on facts, not mere speculation.
senses.example_zh: 这些严重的指控必须建立在事实之上，而不能仅凭臆测。

senses.meaning: 把（金属等）熔铸成；铸造成
senses.example_en: The molten bronze was carefully found into ornate statues for the temple.
senses.example_zh: 熔化的青铜被精心铸造成寺庙用的华丽雕像。

idioms.meaning: 有充分事实根据的；理由充分的
idioms.example_en: Her concerns about the safety of the plant proved to be well-founded.
idioms.example_zh: 她对该工厂安全性的担忧事实证明是有充分依据的。

idioms.meaning: 毫无根据的；无稽之谈的
idioms.example_en: Fears of an imminent economic collapse turned out to be completely ill-founded.
idioms.example_zh: 对经济即将崩溃的恐慌结果被证实完全是毫无根据的。

idioms.meaning: 开创家族；繁衍显赫后代
idioms.example_en: He arrived as an immigrant and went on to found a prominent business family.
idioms.example_zh: 他以移民身份来到这里，后来开创了一个著名的商业家族。

idioms.meaning: 开创王朝；建立长期统治地位
idioms.example_en: The general seized power and founded a dynasty that lasted three centuries.
idioms.example_zh: 这位将军夺取了政权，并建立了一个延续三个世纪的王朝。

idioms.meaning: 创立学派；开创学术流派
idioms.example_en: The philosopher went on to found a school of thought that challenged classical ethics.
idioms.example_zh: 这位哲学家继而开创了一个挑战古典伦理学的思想学派。

collocations.example_en: She founded a tech startup right after graduating from college.
collocations.example_zh: 大学毕业后她随即创立了一家科技初创公司。

collocations.meaning: 创设机构；创立学院或组织
collocations.example_en: The philanthropist used his fortune to found a world-class research institution.
collocations.example_zh: 这位慈善家利用自己的财富创立了一所世界一流的研究机构。

collocations.example_en: The two scientists jointly founded a biotechnology laboratory.
collocations.example_zh: 这两位科学家共同创办了一所生物技术实验室。

collocations.meaning: 根基稳固的；牢固确立的
collocations.example_en: Our democratic traditions are firmly founded in centuries of public debate.
collocations.example_zh: 我们的民主传统深深植根于数百年的公众辩论之中。

collocations.meaning: 建立定居点；开拓殖民地
collocations.example_en: Pioneers crossed the river and founded a new settlement along the valley.
collocations.example_zh: 开拓者渡过河流，沿着山谷建立了一处新的定居点。

collocations.example_en: The hospital was originally founded as a small military dispensary in 1890.
collocations.example_zh: 该医院最初于1890年作为一所小型军用诊所而创立。

senses.meaning: 给……提供住所；将……安置在（某处）
senses.example_en: The university houses all international students in modern residence halls.
senses.example_zh: 大学将所有留学生安置在现代化的学生公寓内。

senses.meaning: 将（设备、构件）安装在……内；装入（保护罩或外壳）
senses.example_en: The sensitive sensor is safely housed in a waterproof aluminum casing.
senses.example_zh: 高灵敏度传感器被安全地装在防水铝制外壳内。

senses.meaning: 收藏于；坐落于；设在（某建筑物中）
senses.example_en: The national art collection is permanently housed in this historic gallery.
senses.example_zh: 国家艺术藏品永久收藏于这座历史悠久的美术馆内。

senses.meaning: 将……安置在同一处；安排合住
senses.example_en: Rescued animals of compatible temperaments are often housed together.
senses.example_zh: 性情合得来的获救动物通常会被安置在同一处饲养。

senses.meaning: 在外面安置；安排……住到机构外部
senses.example_en: Due to a lack of campus dorms, several students had to be housed out with local host families.
senses.example_zh: 由于校内宿舍不足，一些学生不得不被安置在校外的寄宿家庭中。

senses.meaning: 妥善储藏；收藏入库（尤指农作物或工具）
senses.example_en: The farmers worked tirelessly to house away the harvested grain before the heavy rains arrived.
senses.example_zh: 农民们赶在暴雨来临前不知疲倦地把收获的粮食妥善入库。

idioms.meaning: 博得满堂喝彩；激起全场雷鸣般掌声
idioms.example_en: Her electrifying musical performance brought the house down.
idioms.example_zh: 她激动人心的音乐表演博得了全场观众的雷鸣般喝彩。

idioms.meaning: 料理家务；掌管家政
idioms.example_en: He worked remotely from home while keeping house for his family.
idioms.example_zh: 他一边在家远程工作，一边料理家务。

idioms.meaning: 建立小家庭；安家并开始独立生活
idioms.example_en: After getting married, the couple decided to set up house in a quiet suburb.
idioms.example_zh: 婚后，这对夫妇决定在一个宁静的郊区安家生活。

idioms.meaning: 整顿清除内部不良人员/作风；彻底大扫除
idioms.example_en: The new CEO wasted no time in cleaning house across top management.
idioms.example_zh: 新任首席执行官毫不迟疑地彻底整顿了高管层团队。

idioms.phrase: eat sb out of house and home
idioms.meaning: 把某人吃穷；大吃特吃耗尽主人的粮食
idioms.example_en: My teenage sons and their friends are eating me out of house and home.
idioms.example_zh: 我十几岁的儿子和他们的朋友快把我吃得倾家荡产了。

idioms.meaning: 由店家出钱；免费招待
idioms.example_en: The bartender apologized for the delay and said the drinks were on the house.
idioms.example_zh: 调酒师为延误致歉，并表示这几杯饮品由酒吧免费招待。

collocations.meaning: 安置难民；为难民提供居所
collocations.example_en: Temporary shelters were constructed to house thousands of displaced refugees.
collocations.example_zh: 修建了临时避难所，用来安置数以千计流离失所的难民。

collocations.example_en: The new wing of the museum houses an extensive collection of modern art.
collocations.example_zh: 博物馆的新展翼陈列着丰富的现代艺术藏品。

collocations.example_en: The convention center is scheduled to house an international trade exhibition.
collocations.example_zh: 会议中心按计划将承办一场国际贸易展。

collocations.meaning: 充分妥善地安置；提供适宜住所
collocations.example_en: The local council struggles to adequately house low-income families.
collocations.example_zh: 地方委员会正竭力为低收入家庭提供妥善的住房安置。

collocations.example_en: Disaster victims were temporarily housed in the high school gymnasium.
collocations.example_zh: 受灾群众被临时安置在中学体育馆内。

collocations.example_en: The aircraft's streamlined fuselage houses two powerful turbofan engines.
collocations.example_zh: 飞机的流线型机身容纳了两台强劲的涡扇发动机。

senses.meaning: 表达关爱；疼爱；宠爱（常用于美式非正式英语）
senses.example_en: Grandma spent the whole afternoon loving on her new grandbaby.
senses.example_zh: 奶奶整个下午都在宠溺地疼爱着刚出生的小孙子。

senses.example_en: The puppy ran straight into my lap, waiting to be loved up.
senses.example_zh: 小狗直接跳进我怀里，等着被抱抱和抚摸。

senses.example_en: They fell in love while studying abroad together in Florence.
senses.example_zh: 他们在佛罗伦萨一起留学时坠入了爱河。

senses.example_en: The moment she arrived in the coastal town, she fell in love with its quiet charm.
senses.example_zh: 一到达那个海滨小镇，她就深深迷上了它宁静的魅力。

senses.example_en: They have been in love for over a decade and are still inseparable.
senses.example_zh: 他们相爱了十多年，如今依然形影不离。

senses.example_en: They stayed up all night, talking softly and making love until dawn.
senses.example_zh: 他们整夜未眠，轻声细语，相拥缠绵直至黎明。

senses.meaning: 逐渐喜欢上；慢慢适应并爱上
senses.example_en: I hated classical music at first, but I eventually learned to love it.
senses.example_zh: 我起初讨厌古典音乐，但后来渐渐喜欢上了它。

senses.meaning: 因某特质或某事而深爱某人
senses.example_en: I love him for his honesty and dry sense of humor.
senses.example_zh: 我爱他是因为他的真诚和冷幽默。

senses.example_en: She loves her rescue cat to death and buys him all kinds of toys.
senses.example_zh: 她疼极了那只救助来的猫，给它买了各种各样的玩具。

idioms.meaning: 毫无好感；互相厌恶；视同水火
idioms.example_en: There was no love lost between the two political rivals during the debate.
idioms.example_zh: 辩论期间，这两位政界对手之间毫无好感、针锋相对。

idioms.meaning: 心甘情愿做的工作；情愿付出劳力的事情
idioms.example_en: Restoring the vintage sports car took three years, but it was a true labor of love.
idioms.example_zh: 修复这辆老式跑车花了三年时间，但这完全是出于热爱的自愿付出。

idioms.meaning: 神魂颠倒；彻底坠入爱河
idioms.example_en: Mark was head over heels in love with Sarah from the first date.
idioms.example_zh: 从第一次约会起，马克就彻底为萨拉神魂颠倒了。

idioms.meaning: 严厉的爱；用严厉手段迫使其自立的爱
idioms.example_en: Sometimes parents need to practice tough love to help their children overcome addiction.
idioms.example_zh: 有时父母需要采取严厉的爱，以帮助孩子克服成瘾问题。

idioms.meaning: 看在上帝的份上；求求你（用于表达愤怒、绝望或恳求）
idioms.example_en: For the love of God, please turn down that loud music!
idioms.example_zh: 看在老天爷的份上，求你把那吵闹的音乐关小一点吧！

idioms.meaning: 情人眼里出西施；爱情让人盲目
idioms.example_en: She ignored all his obvious flaws because love is truly blind.
idioms.example_zh: 她忽视了他所有明显的缺点，因为爱情确实是盲目的。

collocations.example_en: Please send my love to your parents when you call them tonight.
collocations.example_zh: 今晚给你父母打电话时，请代我向他们问好。

collocations.example_en: They fell madly in love while backpacking across Europe.
collocations.example_zh: 他们在欧洲背包旅行时疯狂地相爱了。

collocations.example_en: He gathered his courage and finally declared his love to her.
collocations.example_zh: 他鼓起勇气，终于向她表白了爱意。

collocations.meaning: 单相思；单恋；未得回报的爱
collocations.example_en: The novel portrays the painful bitterness of unrequited love.
collocations.example_zh: 这部小说刻画了单相思带来的痛苦与心酸。

collocations.example_en: Children thrive when parents regularly show love and affection.
collocations.example_zh: 当父母经常表达爱意和温情时，孩子们会茁壮成长。

collocations.example_en: After years of failed relationships, she finally found true love.
collocations.example_zh: 在经历了多年的感情波折后，她终于寻得了真爱。

senses.example_en: The outdoor concert was called off due to a severe thunderstorm.
senses.example_zh: 由于严重雷暴，户外音乐会被取消了。

senses.meaning: 命令（人或动物）停止攻击或追踪；叫走
senses.example_en: The guard called off the attack dog once the intruder surrendered.
senses.example_zh: 入侵者投降后，警卫叫住了攻击犬。

senses.example_en: This promotion definitely calls for a celebration tonight.
senses.example_zh: 这次升职今晚绝对值得好好庆祝一番。

senses.example_en: Activists are calling for an immediate investigation into the incident.
senses.example_zh: 活动人士正公开呼吁立即对该事件展开调查。

senses.example_en: I'll call for you at seven so we can head to the theatre together.
senses.example_zh: 我七点钟去接你，这样我们可以一起去剧院。

senses.example_en: I'm in a meeting right now; can I call you back in half an hour?
senses.example_zh: 我正在开会，半小时后给你回电话好吗？

senses.meaning: 召回（有缺陷的产品）；叫回（人员）
senses.example_en: The automaker called back thousands of sedans over a faulty brake system.
senses.example_zh: 该汽车制造商因刹车系统故障召回了数千辆轿车。

senses.meaning: 通知（应聘者或演员）参加复试/二轮面试
senses.example_en: Out of sixty auditionees, only three were called back for a second reading.
senses.example_zh: 在六十位试镜者中，只有三个人获得了复试机会。

senses.meaning: 请来，召集（专业人员来协助或修理）
senses.example_en: The company had to call in a crisis management expert to handle the leak.
senses.example_zh: 公司不得不请来一位危机公关专家来处理这次泄密事件。

senses.example_en: David woke up with a high fever and called in sick this morning.
senses.example_zh: 戴维今天早上发高烧，所以打电话请了病假。

senses.example_en: I'll call in on my way home from work to see how you're feeling.
senses.example_zh: 我下班回家的路上会顺道来看看你感觉怎么样。

senses.meaning: 收回（流通纸币）；要求偿还（贷款）
senses.example_en: The bank reserved the right to call in the loan should repayments lapse.
senses.example_zh: 银行保留在还款违约时提前收回贷款的权利。

senses.meaning: 大声呼喊；喊出（某人名字）
senses.example_en: The teacher called out the names from the attendance register.
senses.example_zh: 老师照着考勤表大声点名。

senses.meaning: 公开指责；批评指出（不当行为）
senses.example_en: She was widely praised for calling out the sexist remarks made by her colleague.
senses.example_zh: 她因公开指责同事的不当性别歧视言论而受到广泛赞誉。

senses.meaning: 调动，派出（军队、救援队应对紧急状况）
senses.example_en: The National Guard was called out to assist flood-stricken communities.
senses.example_zh: 国民警卫队被调派前往援助受洪水侵袭的社区。

senses.example_en: The union leaders threatened to call out all transport workers if talks failed.
senses.example_zh: 工会领导人威胁称，如果谈判破裂，将号召所有交通工人举行罢工。

senses.example_en: The Prime Minister called on citizens to remain calm during the crisis.
senses.example_zh: 首相呼吁民众在危机期间保持冷静。

senses.meaning: （课堂上等）点名让某人回答问题
senses.example_en: The professor called on Emma to explain the second theorem.
senses.example_zh: 教授点名让艾玛来解释第二个定理。

senses.example_en: We plan to call on our former neighbours when we visit town next weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们打算下周末去城里时拜访一下我们以前的邻居。

senses.example_en: Call me up as soon as you touch down at the airport.
senses.example_zh: 你一在机场落地就给我打电话。

senses.meaning: 征召入伍；征调（入国家队）
senses.example_en: The young winger was called up to the national football squad for the first time.
senses.example_zh: 这位年轻的边锋首次入选国家足球队。

senses.example_en: The scent of lavender called up vivid memories of her childhood in Provence.
senses.example_zh: 薰衣草的香气勾起了她在普罗旺斯度过的童年记忆。

senses.example_en: The doctor called up the patient's medical records on her monitor.
senses.example_zh: 医生在电脑屏幕上调出了病人的病历档案。

senses.meaning: 四处打电话打听（询价或收集信息）
senses.example_en: I had to call around several repair shops before finding a decent quote.
senses.example_zh: 我四处给好几家修理厂打了电话，才问到一个合理的价格。

senses.meaning: 顺道走访；去某人家拜访（常作 call round，英式）
senses.example_en: Why don't you call round for coffee this Sunday afternoon?
senses.example_zh: 这周日下午你顺道来我家喝杯咖啡怎么样？

senses.meaning: 因公或急事叫走；使离开
senses.example_en: The surgeon was called away from dinner to deal with an emergency in the OR.
senses.example_zh: 这位外科医生在晚饭时被紧急叫走，前往手术室处理急症。

senses.example_en: The government's new tax policy called forth fierce public opposition.
senses.example_zh: 政府的新税收政策引发了公众的强烈反对。

senses.meaning: 展现出，使激发出（勇气、力量等）
senses.example_en: Sailing through the gale called forth all his navigational skill.
senses.example_zh: 在狂风大作的海面上航行激发出了他所有的航海技巧。

senses.meaning: 顺便拜访；路过时顺道探望
senses.example_en: I'll call by after work to drop off those books you wanted.
senses.example_zh: 我下班后会顺道过去一趟，把你想要的那些书带给你。

senses.example_en: The overnight express calls at York and Newcastle before terminating in Edinburgh.
senses.example_zh: 这趟夜间特快列车在终到爱丁堡之前会停靠约克和纽卡斯尔。

senses.meaning: 以……命名（英式，美式通常用 name after）
senses.example_en: She was called Charlotte after her paternal grandmother.
senses.example_zh: 她以祖母的名字被命名为夏洛特。

senses.meaning: 责骂；严厉斥责（美式非正式）
senses.example_en: The supervisor called him down in front of the entire team for missing the deadline.
senses.example_zh: 主管当着整个团队的面因他耽误截止期限而严厉斥责了他。

senses.meaning: 祈求降下（诅咒、神怒或灾难）
senses.example_en: In the play, the prophet calls down curses upon the corrupt rulers.
senses.example_zh: 在戏剧中，先知祈求上天降下诅咒惩罚腐败的统治者。

senses.example_en: The customer called over the waiter to ask for the bill.
senses.example_zh: 顾客把服务员叫过来结账。

senses.example_en: The captain called over the roll before the regiment embarked.
senses.example_zh: 团部队登船前，上尉逐一点名宣读花名册。

senses.example_en: We called in on Sarah on our way back from the countryside.
senses.example_zh: 我们从乡下回来的路上顺道探望了萨拉。

idioms.meaning: 今天就到此为止；收工；停止工作
idioms.example_en: We've made substantial progress on the project, so let's call it a day.
idioms.example_zh: 我们的项目取得了实质性进展，今天就收工吧。

idioms.meaning: 掌权；发号施令；作决定
idioms.example_en: In this department, it is the director who calls the shots.
idioms.example_zh: 在这个部门里，发号施令做主的人是主任。

idioms.meaning: 实话实说；直言不讳
idioms.example_en: She always calls a spade a spade, even when the truth is uncomfortable.
idioms.example_zh: 即便真相令人不快，她也总是直言不讳、直截了当。

idioms.meaning: 决定放弃；就此作罢；协议分手
idioms.example_en: After years of constant arguing, they mutually agreed to call it quits.
idioms.example_zh: 经过多年的不断争吵，他们一致同意就此分手。

idioms.meaning: 侥幸脱险；千钧一发；险情
idioms.example_en: That speeding truck almost hit our car—it was a very close call.
idioms.example_zh: 那辆超速的卡车差点撞上我们的车——真是千钧一发。

idioms.meaning: 定调子；掌权；操纵局面
idioms.example_en: The biggest investor naturally gets to call the tune in the boardroom.
idioms.example_zh: 最大的投资者自然能在董事会里掌握主导权。

idioms.meaning: 待命；随叫随到
idioms.example_en: Surgeons are frequently on call throughout weekends in case of emergencies.
idioms.example_zh: 遇到紧急情况时，外科医生在周末通常需要随叫随到待命。

collocations.example_en: The recent scientific discoveries call into question earlier theories about planetary formation.
collocations.example_zh: 最近的科学发现使先前关于行星形成的理论受到了质疑。

collocations.meaning: 唤起对……的注意；提醒关注
collocations.example_en: The report calls attention to the growing problem of youth unemployment.
collocations.example_zh: 该报告提醒人们关注日益严重的青年失业问题。

collocations.meaning: 宣布举行大选；召集会议
collocations.example_en: The prime minister decided to call an early election to consolidate power.
collocations.example_zh: 首相决定提前举行大选以巩固权力。

collocations.example_en: The municipal government called a halt to construction until environmental safety was ensured.
collocations.example_zh: 市政府叫停了施工，直到环境安全得到保障为止。

collocations.example_en: Solving this complex engineering problem will call into play all your technical skills.
collocations.example_zh: 解决这个复杂的工程问题将需要调动你所有的专业技能。

collocations.example_en: The railway union voted overwhelmingly to call a nationwide strike.
collocations.example_zh: 铁路工会以压倒性多数投票决定举行全国性罢工。

senses.example_en: We were expecting thirty people, but only twenty showed up.
senses.example_zh: 我们原本预计有三十人，但只来了二十人。

senses.example_en: The scratch on the car door didn't show up in the photo.
senses.example_zh: 车门上的划痕在照片里看不出来。

senses.meaning: 使某人难堪，让某人出丑
senses.example_en: Stop arguing with me in public; you're just showing us both up.
senses.example_zh: 别在大庭广众之下跟我争了，你这样只会让我们俩都下不来台。

senses.meaning: 比某人表现更优而使其相形见绌
senses.example_en: The young intern's impressive presentation really showed up the senior staff.
senses.example_zh: 那名年轻实习生精彩的陈述让资深员工们相形见绌。

senses.example_en: He's always showing off how much money he makes.
senses.example_zh: 他总是到处炫耀自己赚了多少钱。

senses.example_en: The simple black dress showed off her diamond necklace perfectly.
senses.example_zh: 那件朴素的黑裙子完美地衬托出了她的钻石项链。

senses.meaning: 带某人参观，领某人四处走走
senses.example_en: Welcome to the company! Let me show you around the office.
senses.example_zh: 欢迎加入公司！我带你在办公室各处转转吧。

senses.example_en: The receptionist showed the client in as soon as the manager was ready.
senses.example_zh: 经理一准备好，前台就把客户领了进去。

senses.example_en: Thank you for coming; my assistant will show you out.
senses.example_zh: 感谢您的光临，我的助理会送您出去。

senses.example_en: The white paint was so thin that the dark surface below showed through.
senses.example_zh: 白漆太薄了，以至于底层的暗色都透了出来。

senses.example_en: Despite his calm exterior, his anxiety clearly showed through in his trembling voice.
senses.example_zh: 尽管他表面平静，但他颤抖的声音暴露了他内心的焦虑。

senses.meaning: 引导某人到（特定位置或房间）
senses.example_en: The waiter smiled politely and showed us to our table by the window.
senses.example_zh: 服务员礼貌地微笑，引我们入座靠窗的餐位。

senses.meaning: 带领某人参观（建筑物、房产等）并详细讲解
senses.example_en: The real estate agent showed prospective buyers over the historic house.
senses.example_zh: 房产经纪人带领意向买家参观了这栋历史悠久的老宅。

senses.example_en: He was too ashamed of his mistake to show himself at the gathering.
senses.example_zh: 他因犯错而感到羞愧，不敢在聚会上露面。

senses.meaning: 展现，显扬（力量、品质或荣耀）
senses.example_en: The poet sought to show forth the beauty and fragility of human life.
senses.example_zh: 诗人试图展现人类生命的美丽与脆弱。

senses.example_en: At the final round of betting, both poker players had to show down.
senses.example_zh: 在最后一轮下注时，两位扑克玩家都必须亮牌决胜负。

senses.meaning: 把某人领进（特定房间或办公室）
senses.example_en: She was showed into the conference room to wait for the interview to begin.
senses.example_zh: 她被领进了会议室，等待面试开始。

senses.meaning: 在记录或屏幕上显示为…，呈现为…
senses.example_en: The mystery fee showed up as an unauthorized charge on my monthly bill.
senses.example_zh: 那笔莫名其妙的费用在我的月度账单上显示为一笔未经授权的扣款。

senses.meaning: 在某人面前故意卖弄/显摆
senses.example_en: The boy performed dangerous skateboard tricks just to show off to his classmates.
senses.example_zh: 那个男孩做出危险的滑板特技，纯粹是为了在同学面前显摆。

idioms.meaning: 抢尽风头，成为全场瞩目的焦点
idioms.example_en: The child actor completely stole the show with his heartfelt monologue.
idioms.example_zh: 那位小演员凭借发自肺腑的独白彻底抢尽了风头。

idioms.meaning: 露出真面目，显露本来嘴脸
idioms.example_en: Under intense financial pressure, he finally showed his true colors.
idioms.example_zh: 在巨大的经济压力下，他终于露出了真面目。

idioms.meaning: 向某人传授诀窍，指导新手熟悉门道
idioms.example_en: A senior engineer was assigned to show the new recruit the ropes.
idioms.example_zh: 一位资深工程师被指派指导这名新员工熟悉业务门道。

idioms.meaning: 逐客，将某人扫地出门；解雇某人
idioms.example_en: When he refused to follow safety protocols, the manager showed him the door.
idioms.example_zh: 当他拒绝遵守安全规程时，经理直接将他扫地出门。

idioms.meaning: 举手表决
idioms.example_en: The motion was passed easily by an overwhelming show of hands.
idioms.example_zh: 通过压倒性的举手表决，该提案顺利通过。

idioms.meaning: 掌管大局，当家做主
idioms.example_en: Although his father founded the company, Mark now runs the show.
idioms.example_zh: 虽然是他父亲创办了这家公司，但如今由马克全面掌管大局。

collocations.example_en: The global economy is beginning to show tentative signs of recovery.
collocations.example_zh: 全球经济开始呈现出试探性的复苏迹象。

collocations.example_en: You should show respect for traditional customs when visiting abroad.
collocations.example_zh: 到国外旅游时，你应该尊重当地的传统习俗。

collocations.example_en: Several prominent venture capitalists have shown interest in our startup.
collocations.example_zh: 已有数家知名风投机构对我们的初创企业表现出兴趣。

collocations.example_en: She sent a personalized card to show gratitude to all her supporters.
collocations.example_zh: 她寄出了一张手写贺卡，向所有支持者表达感激之情。

collocations.meaning: 毫无悔意；毫不仁慈/心狠手辣
collocations.example_en: The judge noted that the defendant showed no remorse for his actions.
collocations.example_zh: 法官指出，被告对自己的行为毫无悔意。

collocations.example_en: The patient's condition has shown steady improvement over the weekend.
collocations.example_zh: 整个周末患者的病情都有了持续稳定的好转。

senses.example_en: I don't feel like cooking tonight, so why don't we order takeout?
senses.example_zh: 我今晚不想做饭，我们叫外卖怎么样？

senses.example_en: The air was heavy and humid; it felt like rain was coming.
senses.example_zh: 空气沉闷潮湿，感觉像是要下雨了。

senses.meaning: 感觉有精力/能力应付（某事）
senses.example_en: I'm still recovering from the flu and don't feel up to a long workout.
senses.example_zh: 我流感刚见好，还觉得自己没体力进行高强度锻炼。

senses.example_en: I really feel for anyone who had their home damaged by the storm.
senses.example_zh: 我十分同情那些房屋在暴风雨中受损的人。

senses.example_en: She felt for her keys at the bottom of her handbag.
senses.example_zh: 她在手提包底部摸索着找钥匙。

senses.meaning: 试探，摸底（某人的想法、意向）
senses.example_en: We should feel out the board members before submitting the proposal.
senses.example_zh: 在提交提案之前，我们应该先探探董事会成员的口风。

senses.meaning: 摸索，四处摸探（以寻找某物）
senses.example_en: When the lights went out, he felt around for a flashlight in the drawer.
senses.example_zh: 灯熄灭后，他在抽屉里摸索着找手电筒。

senses.meaning: （非礼性地）抚摸某人身体，摸索
senses.example_en: She slapped the stranger who tried to feel her up on the crowded subway.
senses.example_zh: 在拥挤的地铁上，有人企图对她动手动脚，她直接给了那陌生人一巴掌。

senses.example_en: How do you feel towards the management's new remote-work policy?
senses.example_zh: 你对管理层出台的远程办公新政策持什么态度？

senses.meaning: 随意，尽管去做某事（不必拘束）
senses.example_en: Feel free to grab a drink from the fridge whenever you want.
senses.example_zh: 想喝什么随时从冰箱里拿，别客气。

senses.example_en: Whenever I feel down, taking a walk in the park helps clear my mind.
senses.example_zh: 每当我心情沮丧时，去公园散散步总能帮我理清思绪。

senses.example_en: It takes time to feel through your grief instead of just bottling it up.
senses.example_zh: 充分体会并消化内心的悲伤需要时间，而不是一味压抑它。

idioms.meaning: 感到无拘无束，感觉像在自己家一样舒适自在
idioms.example_en: The hosts were so warm and hospitable that we felt at home immediately.
idioms.example_zh: 主人非常热情好客，让我们立刻感到宾至如归。

idioms.meaning: 身体略感不适，有点小病小痛
idioms.example_en: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I think I'll skip the gym.
idioms.example_zh: 我今天感觉身体有点不舒服，所以打算不去健身房了。

idioms.meaning: （因经济困难）手头拮据，感受到财政压力
idioms.example_en: With surging inflation, working families everywhere are feeling the pinch.
idioms.example_zh: 随着通货膨胀飙升，各地的工薪家庭都感受到了手头拮据的压力。

idioms.meaning: 打心底直觉到，对…有强烈的预感
idioms.example_en: I can feel it in my bones that something extraordinary is about to happen.
idioms.example_zh: 我有一种强烈的直觉，非比寻常的大事即将发生。

idioms.phrase: feel on top of the world
idioms.meaning: 感到极度幸福，春风得意，飘飘欲仙
idioms.example_en: After receiving the scholarship, she felt on top of the world.
idioms.example_zh: 拿到奖学金后，她感觉幸福得如同登上世界之巅。

idioms.meaning: 怨恨，心怀芥蒂（常用在 no hard feelings 中表示“别往心里去”）
idioms.example_en: We had a fierce debate, but there are no hard feelings between us.
idioms.example_zh: 我们辩论得很激烈，但彼此之间绝没有心存芥蒂。

collocations.meaning: 感到一种…感（如归属感、成就感等）
collocations.example_en: Volunteering gave him a renewed sense of purpose and fulfillment.
collocations.example_zh: 志愿服务让他重新获得了一种人生目标感与充实感。

collocations.meaning: 觉得有义务/不得不去做某事
collocations.example_en: I felt obliged to clarify the misunderstanding before rumors spread.
collocations.example_zh: 我觉得有责任在谣言扩散前把误会解释清楚。

collocations.meaning: 对…感触极深，非常关切/在乎
collocations.example_en: She feels deeply about animal rights and devotes weekends to shelter work.
collocations.example_zh: 她对动物权益深感关切，并将周末时间都奉献给了收容所工作。

collocations.example_en: Small retail shops are feeling the direct impact of online commerce.
collocations.example_zh: 小型零售店正切身承受着电子商务带来的直接冲击。

collocations.meaning: 感到一阵剧烈的（内疚、嫉妒、悲伤等）痛楚
collocations.example_en: He felt a sharp pang of guilt for forgetting his mother's birthday.
collocations.example_zh: 因为忘记了母亲的生日，他心头掠过一阵强烈的内疚。

collocations.example_en: His gentle voice and calm demeanor made the nervous patient feel at ease.
collocations.example_zh: 他温和的语调和平静的举止让紧张的患者渐渐放松下来。

senses.example_en: The flight was delayed due to bad weather and finally took off at midnight.
senses.example_zh: 航班因天气恶劣而延误，最终在半夜起飞。

senses.example_en: Please take off your shoes before entering the house.
senses.example_zh: 进屋前请脱鞋。

senses.meaning: 迅速走红，事业蒸蒸日上
senses.example_en: Her singing career really took off after she won the television contest.
senses.example_zh: 她在赢得电视比赛后，歌唱事业真正走红了。

senses.example_en: As soon as he saw the police, he took off down the alley.
senses.example_zh: 他一看见警察就飞快地溜进了小巷。

senses.example_en: The bomb went off in a crowded market, causing severe damage.
senses.example_zh: 炸弹在拥挤的市场上爆炸，造成了严重破坏。

senses.example_en: My alarm went off at six o'clock, but I was too tired to get up.
senses.example_zh: 我的闹钟六点就响了，但我太累了起不来。

senses.example_en: Put the milk in the fridge, or it will go off in this heat.
senses.example_zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱，否则在这么热的天气里会变质的。

senses.example_en: Despite a few minor issues, the wedding went off without a hitch.
senses.example_zh: 尽管有些小问题，婚礼还是进展得非常顺利。

senses.example_en: Don't forget to take your umbrella when you get off the bus.
senses.example_zh: 下公交车时别忘了带伞。

senses.example_en: What time do you usually get off work on Fridays?
senses.example_zh: 你周五通常几点下班？

senses.example_en: He got off with just a fine instead of going to jail.
senses.example_zh: 他仅被处以罚款而免受牢狱之灾。

senses.example_en: If we want to avoid the morning traffic, we should get off early.
senses.example_zh: 如果想避开早高峰，我们就得早点出发。

senses.example_en: Remember to turn off the lights before you leave the room.
senses.example_zh: 离开房间前记得关灯。

senses.example_en: Turn off the motorway at junction 12.
senses.example_zh: 在12号交叉口驶离高速公路。

senses.example_en: His rude manners completely turned her off.
senses.example_zh: 他粗鲁无礼的举止彻底让她失去了兴趣。

senses.example_en: Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
senses.example_zh: 今日事今日毕，莫推明日。

senses.example_en: The bad smell of the restaurant put us off eating there.
senses.example_zh: 那家餐馆难闻的气味让我们打消了在那儿吃饭的念头。

senses.example_en: Please stop tapping your pen; it's putting me off my work.
senses.example_zh: 别再敲笔了，这搞得我分心无法工作。

senses.example_en: The outdoor concert was called off because of the heavy rain.
senses.example_zh: 露天音乐会因大雨而取消。

senses.meaning: 叫走，命令……停止进攻/骚扰
senses.example_en: Call off your dog before it bites someone!
senses.example_zh: 快把你的狗叫回去，别让它咬到人！

senses.example_en: We packed our bags and set off on our journey at dawn.
senses.example_zh: 我们收拾好行李，在破晓时分踏上旅途。

senses.meaning: 引爆（炸弹），燃放（烟花），触发（警报）
senses.example_en: Smoking inside the building could set off the smoke detector.
senses.example_zh: 在室内吸烟可能会触发烟雾报警器。

senses.example_en: The government's new policy set off a wave of protests.
senses.example_zh: 政府的新政策引发了一波抗议浪潮。

senses.example_en: That dark blue dress really sets off the color of her eyes.
senses.example_zh: 那件深蓝色的连衣裙非常衬托她眼睛的颜色。

senses.example_en: The electricity was cut off because they hadn't paid the bill.
senses.example_zh: 由于没交账单，他们的电被停了。

senses.example_en: The heavy snow cut off several remote mountain villages from the outside world.
senses.example_zh: 大雪使几个偏远山村与外界隔绝。

senses.example_en: We were suddenly cut off in the middle of our phone conversation.
senses.example_zh: 我们电话讲到一半时突然断线了。

senses.example_en: His angry father threatened to cut him off without a penny.
senses.example_zh: 他愤怒的父亲威胁说要断绝父子关系，不给他留一分钱遗产。

senses.example_en: All his hard work finally paid off when he passed the bar exam.
senses.example_zh: 当他通过司法考试时，所有的辛勤努力终于得到了回报。

senses.example_en: It took them twenty years to pay off their mortgage.
senses.example_zh: 他们花了二十年才还清房贷。

senses.example_en: The criminal tried to pay off the witness to keep him silent.
senses.example_zh: 罪犯试图收买目击证人以让他保持沉默。

senses.example_en: The factory had to lay off hundreds of workers due to the economic downturn.
senses.example_zh: 由于经济不景气，该工厂不得不裁员数百人。

senses.example_en: Lay off me! I’m doing the best I can.
senses.example_zh: 别冲我嚷嚷了！我已经尽力了。

senses.meaning: 戒除，暂停使用（烟酒、药物等）
senses.example_en: The doctor told him to lay off alcohol for at least a month.
senses.example_zh: 医生让他至少戒酒一个月。

senses.meaning: 顺道送下（人），顺路放下（东西）
senses.example_en: I can drop you off at the station on my way to work.
senses.example_zh: 我上班顺路可以把你送到车站放下。

senses.example_en: I was so exhausted that I dropped off during the movie.
senses.example_zh: 我太累了，看电影时不知不觉就睡着了。

senses.example_en: Sales usually drop off sharply after the holiday season.
senses.example_zh: 假期过后销售额通常会大幅下滑。

senses.meaning: 成功完成（困难或意外之事）
senses.example_en: Against all odds, the underdog team pulled off an unexpected victory.
senses.example_zh: 出乎所有人意料，这支不被看好的队伍成功赢得了胜利。

senses.example_en: He pulled off the road to check the strange noise under the hood.
senses.example_zh: 他把车靠边停下，检查引擎盖下的异响。

senses.example_en: He pulled off his wet boots as soon as he got inside.
senses.example_zh: 他一进屋就脱掉了湿漉漉的靴子。

senses.example_en: He bought a sports car just to show off to his neighbors.
senses.example_zh: 他买跑车纯粹是为了向邻居炫耀。

senses.example_en: The simple frame shows off the painting beautifully.
senses.example_zh: 这个朴素的画框把画作衬托得非常漂亮。

senses.example_en: The officer told the crowd to back off and give the paramedics room.
senses.example_zh: 警察让群众后退，给医护人员腾出空间。

senses.example_en: I wish you would back off and let me make my own decisions.
senses.example_zh: 我希望你别再步步紧逼，让我自己做决定。

senses.example_en: A heavy branch broke off the tree during the storm.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雨中，一根粗树枝从树上折断了。

senses.example_en: She decided to break off their engagement after the argument.
senses.example_zh: 争吵之后，她决定解除两人的婚约。

senses.example_en: He broke off in mid-sentence when the door suddenly opened.
senses.example_zh: 门突然开了，他的话说到一半戛然而止。

senses.meaning: （药效、感觉、影响等）逐渐消退，减弱
senses.example_en: The painkiller began to wear off after about four hours.
senses.example_zh: 止痛药的药效在大概四小时后开始消退。

senses.example_en: The bank agreed to write off bad debts worth millions of dollars.
senses.example_zh: 银行同意勾销价值数百万美元的坏账。

senses.meaning: 认定……毫无价值，认为……注定失败
senses.example_en: Don't write him off just because he failed once.
senses.example_zh: 不要仅仅因为他失败了一次就将他全盘否定。

senses.example_en: His car was completely written off in the highway crash.
senses.example_zh: 他的车在高速公路事故中彻底报废了。

senses.example_en: The teacher told him off for chatting during the class.
senses.example_zh: 老师因他在课堂上讲话而训斥了他。

senses.example_en: Local merchants often rip off tourists by charging double prices.
senses.example_zh: 当地商贩经常向游客收取双倍价格来敲竹杠。

senses.example_en: Their new design completely ripped off our original concept.
senses.example_zh: 他们的新设计完全抄袭了我们的原创理念。

senses.example_en: He ripped off the packaging to see what was inside.
senses.example_zh: 他撕开包装看里面是什么。

senses.example_en: The championship final is scheduled to kick off at 8 p.m.
senses.example_zh: 冠军总决赛定于晚上八点开球。

senses.example_en: We will kick off the festival with a spectacular fireworks display.
senses.example_zh: 我们将以一场壮丽的烟火秀拉开节日的序幕。

senses.meaning: 挑起争端，突然爆发冲突
senses.example_en: Trouble kicked off outside the stadium after the referee made the call.
senses.example_zh: 裁判做出判决后，体育场外突然爆发了冲突。

idioms.meaning: 摆脱困境/脱身；免受责罚；（电话听筒）没挂好
idioms.example_en: Admitting his mistake early got him off the hook with the disciplinary committee.
idioms.example_zh: 及早承认错误使他免受了纪律委员会的严厉处分。

idioms.meaning: 即兴地；未经准备地
idioms.example_en: She gave a brilliant speech entirely off the cuff without looking at any notes.
idioms.example_zh: 她没看任何讲稿，完全即兴发表了一场精彩绝伦的演说。

idioms.meaning: 不公开发表的；非正式私下透露的
idioms.example_en: The senator spoke off the record about the ongoing internal deliberations.
idioms.example_zh: 参议员以不公开发表的方式私下透露了正在进行的内部审议情况。

idioms.meaning: 境况更好；更宽裕；明智的做法是
idioms.example_en: You would be far better off investing your savings in index funds than in speculative stocks.
idioms.example_zh: 与其投资投机性股票，将积蓄投入指数基金你的境况会好得多。

idioms.meaning: 人迹罕至的；偏僻独特的
idioms.example_en: We chose a secluded cabin off the beaten track for our summer vacation.
idioms.example_zh: 我们选择了一处远离尘嚣、人迹罕至的僻静小木屋来度暑假。

idioms.phrase: off the top of one's head
idioms.meaning: 凭记忆粗略估计；不假思索地
idioms.example_en: Off the top of my head, I'd say the renovation will cost around fifty thousand dollars.
idioms.example_zh: 不假思索地凭直觉估算，我认为翻新费用大约需要五万美元。

idioms.meaning: 断断续续地；间歇地
idioms.example_en: It rained off and on throughout the entire weekend, spoiling our camping plans.
idioms.example_zh: 整个周末断断续续地下着雨，打乱了我们的露营计划。

collocations.meaning: 失去平衡；措手不及/心慌意乱
collocations.example_en: The tough opening question caught the spokesperson completely off balance.
collocations.example_zh: 开场那个棘手的问题让新闻发言人瞬间措手不及。

collocations.example_en: The competitor's aggressive price reduction caught our sales department off guard.
collocations.example_zh: 竞争对手激进的降价策略让我们销售部猝不及防。

collocations.meaning: 禁止入内；禁止讨论/触及
collocations.example_en: The military testing facility is strictly off limits to unauthorized personnel.
collocations.example_zh: 该军事试验基地严禁未经授权的人员进入。

collocations.example_en: An off-duty police officer stepped in and disarmed the suspect.
collocations.example_zh: 一名当时不当班的警察果断介入并缴下了嫌疑人的武器。

collocations.example_en: Let's stick to the agenda so that our discussion doesn't drift off track.
collocations.example_zh: 让我们紧扣议程，免得讨论偏离了正题。

collocations.example_en: Early poll predictions turned out to be wildly off the mark.
collocations.example_zh: 早期的民调预测结果最终证明相差甚远。

collocations.example_en: His assessment of the company's financial health was entirely off base.
collocations.example_zh: 他对公司财务状况的评估完全是大错特错。

senses.example_en: Please stand still while I take your photograph.
senses.example_zh: 我给你拍照时请站着别动。

senses.example_en: Time seemed to stand still in that peaceful ancient village.
senses.example_zh: 在那座宁静的古村落里，时间仿佛停滞了。

senses.example_en: Keep still so the doctor can stitch your wound.
senses.example_zh: 别乱动，这样医生才能给你缝合伤口。

senses.example_en: The children found it very difficult to keep still during the ceremony.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们觉得在仪式期间保持安静坐着非常困难。

senses.meaning: 静止不动，保持姿势别动
senses.example_en: Hold still for a second; there is an insect on your collar.
senses.example_zh: 别动，等一下；你衣领上有只虫子。

senses.example_en: He is so energetic that he can hardly sit still for five minutes.
senses.example_zh: 他精力太旺盛了，连五分钟都坐不住。

senses.meaning: 坐视不管，袖手旁观（多用于否定）
senses.example_en: We cannot simply sit still and allow injustice to prevail.
senses.example_zh: 我们不能坐视不管，任由不公横行。

senses.meaning: 静卧不动，平躺保持静止
senses.example_en: The nurse told the patient to lie still after the injection.
senses.example_zh: 护士嘱咐病人在注射后静卧不要乱动。

senses.meaning: 留在原地不动，保持静止状态
senses.example_en: If you encounter a bear, stay still and do not run away.
senses.example_zh: 如果遇到熊，保持静止别动，切勿乱跑。

senses.example_en: The deer froze still the moment it heard the sound of footsteps.
senses.example_zh: 小鹿一听到脚步声就瞬间僵住不动了。

senses.meaning: 依然保持静止，维持平静
senses.example_en: The surface of the lake remained still as the morning mist lifted.
senses.example_zh: 随着晨雾散去，湖面依旧平静无波。

senses.example_en: Be still and listen to the voice within your heart.
senses.example_zh: 静下心来，倾听你内心的声音。

idioms.meaning: 静水流深；大智若愚；表面沉静者内心深沉
idioms.example_en: He seldom speaks in public, but still waters run deep—his strategic insights are unmatched.
idioms.example_zh: 他很少公开发言，但静水流深——他的战略洞察力无人能及。

idioms.meaning: 更好的是；更妙的是
idioms.example_en: We can email them today, or better still, arrange a face-to-face meeting tomorrow.
idioms.example_zh: 我们今天可以发邮件给他们，或者更好的是，明天安排一次面谈。

idioms.meaning: 尽管如此；毕竟；话虽如此
idioms.example_en: The plan is risky; still and all, it remains our only realistic avenue for survival.
idioms.example_zh: 这项方案风险很高；话虽如此，它依然是我们求生存的唯一现实途径。

idioms.meaning: 时间凝固；时光停滞
idioms.example_en: Walking through the ancient ruined temple, it felt as though time stood still.
idioms.example_zh: 漫步走过这座古老破败的寺庙时，让人感觉时光仿佛凝固了一般。

idioms.phrase: in the still of the night
idioms.meaning: 在万籁俱寂的深夜
idioms.example_en: A distant siren broke the silence in the still of the night.
idioms.example_zh: 在万籁俱寂的深夜，远处的一声警笛划破了宁静。

idioms.meaning: 内心微弱的声音；良知的呼唤
idioms.example_en: Despite the applause of the crowd, a still small voice warned him against arrogance.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管人群掌声雷动，内心微弱的声音仍在警告他切勿骄傲自满。

idioms.meaning: 坐立难安；躁动不安
idioms.example_en: Excited about tomorrow's excursion, the children simply could not sit still.
idioms.example_zh: 想到明天的远足旅行，孩子们兴奋得根本坐不住。

collocations.meaning: 平息某人的恐惧；消除忧虑
collocations.example_en: The captain's calm demeanor helped still the passengers' mounting fears.
collocations.example_zh: 机长沉着冷静的风度帮助平息了乘客们日益加剧的恐慌。

collocations.meaning: 平息风浪；缓和紧张局势
collocations.example_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly behind the scenes to still the troubled waters between the nations.
collocations.example_zh: 外交官们在幕后不知疲倦地斡旋，以平息两国间的紧张局势。

collocations.example_en: Traffic came to a complete standstill following a multi-vehicle pileup on the bridge.
collocations.example_zh: 大桥上发生多车连环相撞事故后，交通彻底陷入停滞。

collocations.example_en: A nationwide rail strike brought the country's transport network to a standstill.
collocations.example_zh: 全国范围的铁路大罢工使该国的交通运输网络陷入瘫痪。

collocations.example_en: The art student spent the afternoon sketching a still life of fruit and copper bowls.
collocations.example_zh: 这位艺术系学生花了一整个下午素描一组水果与铜碗的静物画。

collocations.example_en: Would you prefer sparkling mineral water or still water with your dinner?
collocations.example_zh: 用餐时您想要带气矿泉水还是不带气水？

collocations.meaning: 无风的空气；死寂的空气
collocations.example_en: Smoke from the campfire rose straight up into the crisp, still air.
collocations.example_zh: 营火产生的青烟笔直地升入清冷无风的空气中。

senses.example_en: The teacher told him off for chatting during the exam.
senses.example_zh: 老师因为他在考试中聊天而严厉训斥了他。

senses.example_en: If you don't let me play, I'm going to tell on you to Mom.
senses.example_zh: 如果你不让我玩，我就去向妈妈告你的状。

senses.meaning: 对…产生明显不良影响，使显出疲态
senses.example_en: The prolonged stress and lack of sleep were beginning to tell on his health.
senses.example_zh: 长期的压力和睡眠不足已经开始对他的身体健康产生明显不良影响。

senses.example_en: The twins look so similar that even their teachers can hardly tell them apart.
senses.example_zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，连他们的老师都很难分清。

senses.example_en: It is often hard to tell genuine leather from high-quality synthetic alternatives.
senses.example_zh: 通常很难区分真皮与高品质的合成革替代品。

senses.example_en: The novel tells of a young sailor's perilous journey across the ocean.
senses.example_zh: 这部小说讲述了一位年轻水手横渡大洋的险恶旅程。

senses.example_en: The dark circles under her eyes told of many sleepless nights.
senses.example_zh: 她眼眶下的黑眼圈表明她度过了许多不眠之夜。

senses.meaning: 对…不利，成为对…不利的证据或因素
senses.example_en: His lack of relevant industry experience ultimately told against him in the final interview.
senses.example_zh: 缺乏相关行业经验最终在终面中成了对他的不利因素。

idioms.meaning: 老实说，说实话
idioms.example_en: To tell the truth, I was completely surprised by their sudden decision to merge.
idioms.example_zh: 说实话，他们突然决定合并让我感到非常意外。

idioms.meaning: 时间会证明一切，日后见分晓
idioms.example_en: Only time will tell whether this massive investment will yield the expected profits.
idioms.example_zh: 只有时间才能证明这笔巨额投资能否带来预期的利润。

idioms.meaning: （表示完全感同身受或无奈赞同）可不是嘛，那还用你说
idioms.example_en: "Finding an affordable apartment in this city is impossible." "Tell me about it!"
idioms.example_zh: “在这个城市找一套租得起的公寓简直不可能。”“可不是嘛！”

idioms.phrase: you never can tell / there's no telling
idioms.meaning: 谁也说不准，很难预料
idioms.example_en: There's no telling how the market will react to the new regulations tomorrow.
idioms.example_zh: 谁也说不准明天市场会对新规作出何种反应。

idioms.meaning: 搬弄是非，泄露内部秘密
idioms.example_en: I don't mean to tell tales out of school, but the project manager is planning to resign.
idioms.example_zh: 我不想搬弄是非泄露内幕，但项目经理确实打算辞职了。

idioms.phrase: tell sb a thing or two
idioms.meaning: 狠狠教训某人一顿；给某人点颜色瞧瞧
idioms.example_en: If he speaks to me so rudely again, I'm going to tell him a thing or two.
idioms.example_zh: 如果他再对我这么无礼，我一定要好好教训他一顿。

collocations.example_en: Can you tell the difference between authentic leather and synthetic materials?
collocations.example_zh: 你能辨别真皮与合成皮革之间的区别吗？

collocations.example_en: He promised never to tell a lie to his parents again.
collocations.example_zh: 他保证再也不对父母撒谎了。

collocations.example_en: Children usually learn how to tell the time when they enter primary school.
collocations.example_zh: 孩子们通常在进入小学时学习看钟表认时间。

collocations.example_en: The old woman by the temple claimed she could tell fortunes using tarot cards.
collocations.example_zh: 庙旁的老妇人声称自己能用塔罗牌为人算命。

collocations.example_en: Truth be told, we simply didn't have enough budget to execute the original campaign.
collocations.example_zh: 坦白讲，我们根本没有足够的预算来执行最初的营销方案。

collocations.meaning: 讲述故事；说明问题，反映情况
collocations.example_en: The financial figures tell a very different story from what the executives claim.
collocations.example_zh: 财务数据所反映的情况与高管们宣称的大相径庭。

senses.meaning: 模拟推演，对（局势、对策及各种后果）进行兵棋推演
senses.example_en: The military leadership gathered to game out several potential crisis scenarios.
senses.example_zh: 军方高层齐聚一堂，对数种潜在的危机情况进行了模拟推演。

senses.meaning: 比赛/较量正式打响，挑战开始
senses.example_en: When our rival company slashed their prices, our CEO just smiled and said, 'Game on.'
senses.example_zh: 当我们的竞争对手大幅降价时，我们的首席执行官只是笑了笑说：“较量开始了。”

senses.meaning: 做好迎战准备，装备就绪
senses.example_en: The esports team gamed up with new hardware and spent the whole weekend in intense training.
senses.example_zh: 电竞战队配齐了新装备，整个周末都在进行高强度的迎战集训。

idioms.meaning: 诡计被识破，败局已定，全完蛋了
idioms.example_en: When the police surrounded the warehouse, the smugglers realized the game was up.
idioms.example_zh: 当警察包围仓库时，走私犯们意识到一切都完了。

idioms.meaning: 走漏风声，泄露秘密，露出马脚
idioms.example_en: We wanted the farewell party to be a surprise, but his nervous smile gave the game away.
idioms.example_zh: 我们本想把欢送会办成惊喜，但他紧张的笑容露出了马脚。

idioms.phrase: beat sb at their own game
idioms.meaning: 用某人擅长的招数打败某人，以其人之道还治其人之身
idioms.example_en: The startup beat the tech giant at its own game by deploying cutting-edge AI faster.
idioms.example_zh: 这家初创公司通过更快地部署前沿人工智能，在科技巨头最擅长的领域击败了对方。

idioms.meaning: 按规则办事，讲究公道；遵循行业潜规则
idioms.example_en: If you want to advance in corporate politics, you have to learn how to play the game.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你想在企业内部晋升，就必须学会适应职场规则。
