idioms.meaning: 处于领先地位，占得先机
idioms.example_en: Investing in renewable energy early allowed the firm to stay well ahead of the game.
idioms.example_zh: 及早投资可再生能源使该企业在行业中保持了绝对领先地位。

idioms.phrase: two can play at that game
idioms.meaning: 谁都会耍这种把戏，以牙还牙（警告对方自己也能采用同类手段）
idioms.example_en: If they cut their advertising rates to steal our clients, two can play at that game.
idioms.example_zh: 如果他们靠降低广告费来抢我们的客户，我们也能奉陪到底。

collocations.meaning: 钻制度漏洞，利用规则漏洞谋取不正当利益
collocations.example_en: Several wealthy investors managed to game the tax system through complex offshore trusts.
collocations.example_zh: 几位富有的投资者通过复杂的离岸信托钻税收制度的空子。

collocations.meaning: 夸夸其谈，话说得漂亮（但未必能做到）
collocations.example_en: He talks a good game during interviews, but his actual delivery falls far short.
collocations.example_zh: 他在面试时说得头头是道，但实际工作表现却差得远。

collocations.meaning: 提升个人表现，提高业务水准
collocations.example_en: With younger talents entering the team, the senior engineers had to raise their game.
collocations.example_zh: 随着年轻人才加入团队，资深工程师们也不得不提高自己的专业水平。

collocations.example_en: By defying the regulatory authorities, the CEO is playing a very dangerous game.
collocations.example_zh: 公然违抗监管机构，这位首席执行官正在铤而走险。

collocations.meaning: 合法的捕猎对象；人人皆可批评或戏弄的目标
collocations.example_en: Celebrities often complain that their private lives are treated as fair game by the tabloids.
collocations.example_zh: 名人经常抱怨他们的私生活被小报当作随意猎奇攻击的靶子。

collocations.meaning: 最终阶段，残局，决定性结局
collocations.example_en: Diplomats are now entering the end game of the protracted trade negotiations.
collocations.example_zh: 外交官们目前正进入这场旷日持久的贸易谈判的收官阶段。

senses.meaning: 渴望，盼望，热切期盼（某人或某物）
senses.example_en: After months in the desert, the soldiers longed for cold water and fresh food.
senses.example_zh: 在沙漠中度过了几个月后，士兵们极度渴望喝到凉水、吃到新鲜食物。

senses.meaning: 深切追忆，深切向往（尤指已逝去的时光或人）
senses.example_en: Even in his old age, he still longed after the carefree summers of his youth.
senses.example_zh: 即便到了晚年，他仍然深深怀念着年轻时那些无忧无虑的夏天。

senses.meaning: 极度渴望做某事，迫切希望做某事
senses.example_en: She had lived in the noisy city for so long that she longed to return to the quiet countryside.
senses.example_zh: 她在喧闹的城市生活了太久，以至于极度渴望回到宁静的乡下。

phrasal_verbs.phrase: long for sb to do sth

senses.meaning: 期盼某人做某事，渴望某事发生
senses.example_en: The anxious parents were longing for their son to call and confirm his safe arrival.
senses.example_zh: 焦急的父母正期盼着儿子打电话来确认他已平安到达。

idioms.meaning: 全心全意地渴望，发自内心地期盼
idioms.example_en: He longed with all his heart for a peaceful end to the bitter conflict.
idioms.example_zh: 他全心全意地期盼这场激烈的冲突能够和平收场。

idioms.meaning: 翘首以盼那一天的到来
idioms.example_en: She longed for the day when justice would finally be served.
idioms.example_zh: 她翘首以盼正义终将伸张的那一天到来。

idioms.phrase: long to the point of pain
idioms.meaning: 渴望得心痛，相思成疾
idioms.example_en: Far away from her homeland, she longed for her family to the point of pain.
idioms.example_zh: 远离故土的她思念家人到了心痛的地步。

idioms.meaning: 极度渴望挣脱束缚，渴望自由
idioms.example_en: Trapped in an unfulfilling corporate routine, she longed to break free and travel the world.
idioms.example_zh: 困在毫无成就感的公司日常中，她极度渴望挣脱束缚去环游世界。

idioms.meaning: 极度渴望片刻安宁
idioms.example_en: After hours of managing screaming toddlers, the exhausted mother longed for peace and quiet.
idioms.example_zh: 在带了几个小时哭闹的幼儿后，疲惫的母亲极度渴望能有片刻安宁。

collocations.meaning: 不顾一切地渴望，极度盼望
collocations.example_en: The refugees desperately longed for a safe haven away from violence.
collocations.example_zh: 难民们极度渴望能有一个远离暴力的避难所。

collocations.meaning: 暗自渴望，内心深处期盼
collocations.example_en: Though she appeared content, she secretly longed to pursue a career in painting.
collocations.example_zh: 虽然她看起来很满足，但内心深处其实一直渴望从事绘画事业。

collocations.example_en: During his first cold winter abroad, he longed for home and familiar comforts.
collocations.example_zh: 在异国的第一个寒冬里，他倍感思乡，渴望熟悉的温暖与慰藉。

collocations.meaning: 渴望被接纳，期盼获得认同
collocations.example_en: Every teenager naturally longs for acceptance among their peers.
collocations.example_zh: 每个青少年都自然而然地渴望获得同龄人的接纳与认同。

collocations.example_en: Stuck in the same monotonous job for ten years, he longed for a change.
collocations.example_zh: 在同一份单调的工作上干了十年，他极度渴望做出改变。

collocations.meaning: 渴望获得第二次机会，期盼重新来过
collocations.example_en: Regretting his hasty decision, he longed for a second chance to explain himself.
collocations.example_zh: 为自己草率的决定后悔不已，他渴望能有第二次机会向对方解释清楚。

senses.example_en: We should start off early tomorrow morning to beat the rush hour traffic.
senses.example_zh: 我们明天得一大早动身，以避开早高峰的拥堵。

senses.example_en: The speaker started off by sharing an amusing personal anecdote with the audience.
senses.example_zh: 演讲者以向听众分享一段有趣的个人轶事作为开场。

senses.meaning: 动身，启程（尤指一段漫长的旅程）
senses.example_en: They packed their hiking gear and started out at dawn.
senses.example_zh: 他们收拾好徒步装备，在黎明时分启程出发。

senses.meaning: 起初打算，本意要做（通常后接不定式）
senses.example_en: I started out to write a short article, but it eventually turned into a full-length book.
senses.example_zh: 我起初打算写一篇短文，但最终却写成了一整本书。

senses.meaning: （职业生涯或人生）最初从业，起初以某种身份从业
senses.example_en: Many acclaimed film directors started out as low-paid production assistants.
senses.example_zh: 许多著名电影导演最初都是从低薪的剧组助理做起的。

senses.meaning: 启动，发动（机器、汽车或设备）
senses.example_en: The old car made a strange rattling noise when the engine started up.
senses.example_zh: 发动机启动时，这辆老旧汽车发出了奇怪的咔嗒声。

senses.meaning: 创办，开办（公司、业务或项目）
senses.example_en: She decided to leave her corporate job to start up her own tech consultancy.
senses.example_zh: 她决定辞去大公司的工作，创办自己的科技咨询公司。

senses.meaning: 突然站起；（争端、风雨等）突然爆发
senses.example_en: He started up from his armchair the moment the smoke alarm went off.
senses.example_zh: 烟雾警报器一响，他猛地从扶手椅上弹了起来。

senses.example_en: As soon as dinner was cleared away, she started on her chemistry assignment.
senses.example_zh: 晚饭一收拾完，她就着手做化学作业了。

senses.meaning: 开始数落，挑剔或指责某人
senses.example_en: Please don't start on me about the mess—I've had an exhausting day.
senses.example_zh: 请别又拿屋子乱来数落我了——我今天累坏了。

senses.example_en: When the unsaved document closed unexpectedly, the designer had no choice but to start over.
senses.example_zh: 未保存的文档意外关闭后，设计师别无选择，只能从头再来。

senses.meaning: 开始动手干，着手干（常接 on 或 doing）
senses.example_en: Grab a shovel and start in—we have a lot of snow to clear before noon.
senses.example_zh: 拿把铁锹开始干吧——中午前我们得清理掉大量的积雪。

senses.meaning: 开始责难、抱怨或攻击某人（常接 on sb）
senses.example_en: She started in on her brother the minute he walked through the front door.
senses.example_zh: 弟弟刚一迈进大门，她就开始没完没了地数落他。

senses.example_en: Let's start with a quick review of the vocabulary we learned yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 我们先从快速复习昨天学过的词汇开始吧。

senses.meaning: 首先，起初（常用于 to start with 表首要原因）
senses.example_en: We can't buy the apartment; to start with, it's far beyond our budget.
senses.example_zh: 我们买不起这套公寓；首先，它远远超出了我们的预算。

senses.example_en: The storm clouds look threatening, so we had better start back to camp right now.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雨的乌云看起来很凶猛，我们最好现在就动身返回营地。

senses.meaning: 因吃惊或恐惧而猛然退缩
senses.example_en: He started back in terror when he saw a snake coiled on the pathway.
senses.example_zh: 当看到小路上盘着一条蛇时，他惊恐地猛然向后退去。

senses.meaning: 帮助或指导某人入门/开始
senses.example_en: The mentor started the intern off on a few straightforward bug-fixing tasks.
senses.example_zh: 导师安排实习生先做几个简单的漏洞修复任务，以此带其入门。

senses.meaning: 引发某人开始大笑、痛哭或滔滔不绝
senses.example_en: Don't mention politics around Uncle Bob, or you'll start him off on an endless rant.
senses.example_zh: 别在鲍勃叔叔面前提政治，否则会引得他滔滔不绝地大发牢骚。

senses.meaning: 因惊吓而猛地跳起或缩身退避
senses.example_en: The deer started away into the thick bushes when a dry twig snapped.
senses.example_zh: 一根枯树枝被踩断时，那只鹿受惊猛然跳起，窜进了灌木丛深处。

senses.example_en: Upon hearing the urgent call, the physician started away without finishing his lunch.
senses.example_zh: 一接到紧急传呼，那位内科医生午饭都没吃完就急匆匆动身离开了。

senses.meaning: 翻开新的一页，重新再来，洗心革面
senses.example_en: Moving to a new city gave him the perfect opportunity to leave his past behind and start afresh.
senses.example_zh: 搬到一座新城市给了他绝佳的机会，让他能够告别过去，重新再来。

idioms.meaning: 从零开始，白手起家，从一无所有开始
idioms.example_en: After the fire destroyed their workshop, the founders had to start from scratch.
idioms.example_zh: 大火摧毁作坊后，创始团队不得不从零开始重新创业。

idioms.meaning: 率先行动，带头开展，抛砖引玉拉开序幕
idioms.example_en: To start the ball rolling, the chairman pledged a personal donation of ten thousand dollars.
idioms.example_zh: 为带头推动活动开展，主席率先认捐了一万美元。

idioms.meaning: 首先，作为开头第一点（常用于列举理由或批评）
idioms.example_en: We can't afford the vacation; for a start, the airfares are outrageous.
idioms.example_zh: 我们承担不起这次度假；首先，机票价格就贵得离谱。

idioms.phrase: get off to a flying start
idioms.meaning: 旗开得胜，取得开门红，开局势如破竹
idioms.example_en: The new product got off to a flying start, selling out within twenty-four hours.
idioms.example_zh: 新产品取得了开门红，在二十四小时内便销售一空。

idioms.meaning: 别提了，别惹我打开话匣子（表示一旦展开讲就会抱怨个没完）
idioms.example_en: Don't get me started on the public transport here; trains are perpetually delayed.
idioms.example_zh: 别跟我提这儿的公共交通了，火车永远在晚点。

idioms.meaning: 既往不咎，不计前嫌，重新开始
idioms.example_en: Both managers agreed to put past rivalries behind them and start with a clean slate.
idioms.example_zh: 两位经理一致同意放下过去的恩怨，重新建立合作关系。

idioms.meaning: 开局不利，出师不顺
idioms.example_en: The merger was off to a bad start when key executives resigned on day one.
idioms.example_zh: 核心高管在第一天就集体辞职，使得这次合并出师不利。

collocations.example_en: She took a leap of faith and left her secure job to start a business.
collocations.example_zh: 她毅然辞去了稳定的工作，勇敢迈出一步去开办自己的企业。

collocations.example_en: They bought a house in the suburbs and decided it was the right time to start a family.
collocations.example_zh: 他们在郊区买了房，并觉得是时候生儿育女、组建家庭了。

collocations.meaning: 打破沉默，挑起话头，开启对话
collocations.example_en: He made a witty remark about the weather to start a conversation with the woman beside him.
collocations.example_zh: 他就天气说了句俏皮话，与身旁的女士攀谈起来。

collocations.example_en: Dry leaves and high winds made it terrifyingly easy to start a catastrophic forest fire.
collocations.example_zh: 干燥的落叶和狂风使得引发灾难性森林大火变得极易发生。

collocations.example_en: He turned the ignition key, but the old battery failed to start the engine.
collocations.example_zh: 他转动点火钥匙，但老化的电瓶没能将发动机发动起来。

collocations.meaning: 从零打基础，从基层逐步做起
collocations.example_en: The software architecture had to be redesigned and started from the ground up.
collocations.example_zh: 该软件架构必须彻底重新设计，从零开始搭建基础。

collocations.example_en: Construction crews are scheduled to start work on the new highway extension next Monday.
collocations.example_zh: 施工队预定于下周一正式着手新高速公路延伸段的建设。

senses.example_en: I'll stay here and keep you company while you wait for the bus.
senses.example_zh: 你在等公交车的时候，我留在这里陪你吧。

senses.meaning: 与……分道扬镳，因分歧而散伙或断绝往来
senses.example_en: The band parted company with their manager over creative differences.
senses.example_zh: 由于创作上的分歧，乐队与他们的经纪人分道扬镳了。

senses.example_en: We walked together as far as the station, where we parted company.
senses.example_zh: 我们一起走到车站，然后在那里各奔东西。

senses.meaning: 常与……交往，同……混在一起（常带贬义或过时用法）
senses.example_en: His parents worried that he was keeping company with a bad crowd.
senses.example_zh: 父母担心他正和一群不良少年混在一起。

senses.meaning: 陪伴某人，陪同某人（较正式）
senses.example_en: Would you bear me company on my walk to the library?
senses.example_zh: 你能陪我一起走到图书馆吗？

senses.meaning: 喜欢和某人待在一起，享受某人的陪伴
senses.example_en: I really enjoy her company because she has a great sense of humor.
senses.example_zh: 我非常喜欢和她待在一起，因为她很有幽默感。

senses.meaning: 喜欢独处，享受一人清静
senses.example_en: He is rather introverted and has always preferred his own company.
senses.example_zh: 他性格相当内向，向来更喜欢一个人独处。

senses.meaning: 主动寻找某人作伴，想和某人待在一起
senses.example_en: Whenever he felt anxious, he sought his brother's company.
senses.example_zh: 每当感到焦虑时，他都会主动去找哥哥作伴。

senses.meaning: 交友不慎，结交坏朋友，误入歧途
senses.example_en: After moving to the new city, the teenager fell into bad company and started skipping school.
senses.example_zh: 搬到新城市后，那个少年结交了坏朋友，开始旷课。

idioms.meaning: 有同行者（因而无需尴尬/自责）；大有人在
idioms.example_en: If you failed the exam, you're in good company—half the class did too.
idioms.example_zh: 要是你考试不及格，也别难过，全班有一半人都没过呢。

idioms.meaning: 两人成伴，三人不欢；二人世界容不下第三者
idioms.example_en: I won't join you two at dinner—two's company, three's a crowd.
idioms.example_zh: 我就不掺和你们俩吃晚餐了——二人世界，三人多余。

idioms.meaning: 倒霉有人作伴心稍宽；同病相怜
idioms.example_en: He was glad others also got wet in the rain, proving misery loves company.
idioms.example_zh: 看到其他人也被雨淋了，他竟感到一丝宽慰，真是倒霉有人陪心稍宽。

idioms.meaning: 在座各位除外；不包括在场的人
idioms.example_en: Politicians can never be trusted, present company excepted, of course.
idioms.example_zh: 政客从来都不可信，当然，在座的各位除外。

idioms.phrase: a man is known by the company he keeps
idioms.meaning: 观其友而知其人；物以类聚，人以群分
idioms.example_en: Remember that a man is known by the company he keeps, so choose your friends wisely.
idioms.example_zh: 记住，观其友而知其人，所以交朋友务必慎重。

idioms.meaning: 为了作伴；为了不感到孤单
idioms.example_en: Living alone in the countryside, she adopted a stray cat for company.
idioms.example_zh: 独自在乡村生活，她收养了一只流浪猫来作伴。

collocations.example_en: She has been running the tech company successfully for over a decade.
collocations.example_zh: 她成功经营这家科技公司已经十多年了。

collocations.phrase: start / set up / found a company
collocations.example_en: The two college friends decided to set up a software company together.
collocations.example_zh: 那两位大学好友决定联手创办一家软件公司。

collocations.example_en: The local airline is a subsidiary of a major European parent company.
collocations.example_zh: 这家本土航空公司是一家大型欧洲母公司的子公司。

collocations.example_en: Transparency is strictly required for any publicly listed company.
collocations.example_zh: 对于任何一家上市公司而言，信息公开透明都是硬性要求。

collocations.meaning: 公司文化 / 公司规章制度
collocations.example_en: Encouraging open feedback is a central pillar of our company culture.
collocations.example_zh: 鼓励公开反馈是我们公司文化的核心支柱。

collocations.meaning: 与他人在一起；身处社交场合
collocations.example_en: He behaves very differently when he is in company compared to when he is alone.
collocations.example_zh: 他身处众人之中与独处时的表现大不相同。

senses.meaning: 劝服某人做某事，说服某人参与
senses.example_en: She managed to talk him into applying for the new job.
senses.example_zh: 她设法说服了他去申请那份新工作。

senses.meaning: 劝阻某人做某事，说服某人放弃
senses.example_en: I tried to talk her out of quitting university, but she had already made up her mind.
senses.example_zh: 我试图劝她不要退学，但她已经下定了决心。

senses.meaning: 以居高临下的口吻对……说话，傲慢地对待
senses.example_en: Don't talk down to me as if I know nothing about this project.
senses.example_zh: 别用那种居高临下的口气跟我说话，好像我对这个项目一无所知似的。

senses.meaning: 劝降，劝解（企图轻生或情绪激动者）放弃危险举动
senses.example_en: A trained negotiator spent hours talking the man down from the bridge ledge.
senses.example_zh: 一名训练有素的谈判专家花了好几个小时，才劝说那名男子从桥梁边缘退回来。

senses.meaning: 大声压制对方的发言，把人说得哑口无言
senses.example_en: Whenever I tried to raise an objection, he shouted and talked me down.
senses.example_zh: 每当我想提出异议时，他就大声嚷嚷把我压制下去。

senses.meaning: 说服降价，讨价还价成功
senses.example_en: The seller wanted $500, but I managed to talk him down to $400.
senses.example_zh: 卖家开价500美元，但我成功把价格压到了400美元。

senses.meaning: 无线电指引（遇险飞机）安全降落
senses.example_en: Air traffic controllers managed to talk the inexperienced pilot down safely.
senses.example_zh: 空中交通管制员设法通过无线电指引，让那位缺乏经验的飞行员安全降落。

senses.example_en: Children shouldn't talk back to their teachers when they are corrected.
senses.example_zh: 孩子在被批评时不应该对老师顶嘴。

senses.example_en: We need to sit down and talk over the details before signing the contract.
senses.example_zh: 在签署合同之前，我们需要坐下来详细商讨各个细节。

senses.meaning: 向某人步步讲解，逐步指导操作
senses.example_en: The technician talked me through the software installation step by step.
senses.example_zh: 技术人员一步步指导我完成了软件的安装。

senses.meaning: 透彻交谈以疏导（某人的情绪、困惑或问题）
senses.example_en: The counselor helped talk her through her panic attack.
senses.example_zh: 心理咨询师耐心地引导交流，帮她平复了恐慌发作。

senses.meaning: 说服某人改变主意或立场
senses.example_en: He was firmly against the plan at first, but we finally talked him around.
senses.example_zh: 起初他坚决反对这项计划，但我们最终说服他改变了主意。

senses.meaning: 拐弯抹角，回避核心话题而不直奔主题
senses.example_en: Stop talking around the problem and tell us honestly what went wrong.
senses.example_zh: 别再拐弯抹角了，老老实实告诉我们究竟出了什么问题。

senses.meaning: 大肆吹捧，极力夸赞……的价值或前景
senses.example_en: The company talked up the new phone, but users found it quite ordinary.
senses.example_zh: 公司对那款新手机大加吹捧，但用户发现它其实平平无奇。

senses.meaning: 通过坦诚交谈解决（分歧或矛盾）
senses.example_en: Instead of staying angry, they sat down together to talk out their differences.
senses.example_zh: 他们没有继续生闷气，而是坐下来通过坦诚交谈化解了分歧。

senses.meaning: 自顾自地对某人说教，单向唠叨不容对方插话
senses.example_en: I felt exhausted because he spent the entire lunch just talking at me rather than listening.
senses.example_zh: 我感到精疲力竭，因为整顿午饭他都在自顾自地对我滔滔不绝，根本不听我说话。

senses.meaning: 全面细致地探讨，透彻梳理（方案、问题等）
senses.example_en: Let's talk through all the possible risks before making a final decision.
senses.example_zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们先把所有潜在风险彻底梳理讨论一遍。

senses.meaning: 不停地闲扯，滔滔不绝地说个没完
senses.example_en: The two old friends sat in the corner, talking away for hours.
senses.example_zh: 那两位老朋友坐在角落里，滔滔不绝地聊了好几个小时。

senses.example_en: We talked away the long evening over cups of hot tea.
senses.example_zh: 我们喝着热茶聊天，打发了漫长的夜晚。

senses.meaning: 通过解释消弭，借言语化解（疑虑、问题等）
senses.example_en: He tried to talk away his mistakes, but the evidence was undeniable.
senses.example_zh: 他试图通过巧舌如簧掩盖自己的错误，但证据确凿不容辩驳。

senses.example_en: The villagers were talking of the strange lights seen in the mountains.
senses.example_zh: 村民们都在谈论山里出现的奇异光芒。

senses.example_en: There is already talk of early elections following the scandal.
senses.example_zh: 丑闻发生后，已有关于提前举行大选的传闻传出。

senses.example_en: I need to talk to you about the upcoming presentation.
senses.example_zh: 关于接下来的汇报演示，我需要和你谈谈。

senses.example_en: If he keeps coming in late, the manager will have to talk to him.
senses.example_zh: 如果他继续迟到，经理就得找他严肃谈话了。

idioms.meaning: 三句话不离本行；在社交场合大谈工作业务
idioms.example_en: We promised not to talk shop at the dinner party, but we couldn't resist.
idioms.example_zh: 我们答应过晚宴上不聊工作，但最后还是忍不住三句话不离本行。

idioms.meaning: 说得头头是道；说得天花乱坠（通常与 walk the walk 连用）
idioms.example_en: He can certainly talk the talk, but let's see if he can deliver results.
idioms.example_zh: 他确实能说会道、讲得头头是道，但且看他能不能拿出实际成果。

idioms.meaning: 吹大牛；说大话；夸夸其谈
idioms.example_en: He talks big about his wealth, but he actually rents that luxury car.
idioms.example_zh: 他大吹特吹自己多么富有，其实那辆豪车是他租来的。

idioms.meaning: 信口雌黄；胡说八道；不懂装懂
idioms.example_en: Ignore his opinion on economics—he's just talking through his hat.
idioms.example_zh: 别理他对经济学的见解——他纯粹是在不懂装懂、胡说八道。

idioms.meaning: 把某人的耳朵都说出茧来；喋喋不休地说个没完
idioms.example_en: My neighbor caught me in the hallway and nearly talked my ear off.
idioms.example_zh: 邻居在楼道里撞见我，没完没了地讲个不停，差点把我耳朵说出茧来。

idioms.meaning: 这才像话；这才对嘛；正合我意
idioms.example_en: A weekend trip to the beach? Now you're talking!
idioms.example_zh: 周末去海滩度假？这才对嘛，正合我意！

idioms.meaning: 金钱万能；钱能通神；有钱能使鬼推磨
idioms.example_en: In professional sports negotiations, money talks louder than sentiment.
idioms.example_zh: 在职业体育的商业谈判中，金钱往往比情怀更有话语权。

collocations.meaning: 说话在理 / 胡说八道
collocations.example_en: It's refreshing to hear someone talk sense in this heated debate.
collocations.example_zh: 在这次激烈的争辩中，听到有人说了几句明白在理的话，真令人耳目一新。

collocations.meaning: 言归正传谈正事；洽谈生意业务
collocations.example_en: After enjoying our coffee, let's get down to work and talk business.
collocations.example_zh: 喝完咖啡后，我们言归正传谈正事吧。

collocations.example_en: The team was encouraged to talk openly about any bottlenecks they encountered.
collocations.example_zh: 团队成员被鼓励畅所欲言，提出自己遇到的任何瓶颈。

collocations.example_en: The coach needs to have a serious talk with the captain before the final match.
collocations.example_zh: 教练在决赛前需要和队长认真谈一谈。

collocations.example_en: She was invited to give a talk on renewable energy at the annual summit.
collocations.example_zh: 她受邀在年度峰会上就可再生能源作专题报告。

collocations.example_en: He tried to use sweet talk to persuade her into lending him the car.
collocations.example_zh: 他试图用甜言蜜语哄骗她说服她借车给自己。

senses.example_en: It took them twenty years to pay off the mortgage on their house.
senses.example_zh: 他们花了二十年时间才还清房贷。

senses.example_en: All her hard work finally paid off when she received the promotion.
senses.example_zh: 当她获得晋升时，她所有的辛勤努力终于得到了回报。

senses.example_en: The criminals tried to pay off the security guards to look the other way.
senses.example_zh: 罪犯试图收买保安，让他们装作没看见。

senses.example_en: The shipyard paid off hundreds of workers as orders dried up.
senses.example_zh: 随着订单枯竭，造船厂结清工资解雇了数百名工人。

senses.example_en: I can lend you fifty dollars, but you have to pay me back by Friday.
senses.example_zh: 我可以借给你五十美元，但你必须在周五前还我。

senses.example_en: He swore he would pay them back for the humiliation they caused him.
senses.example_zh: 他发誓一定要为他们带给他的羞辱进行报复。

senses.example_en: I can never pay you back for all the support you gave me during difficult times.
senses.example_zh: 你在艰难时期给予我的全力支持，我感激不尽、无以为报。

senses.example_en: Put your wallet away; I'm going to pay for dinner tonight.
senses.example_zh: 把钱包收起来吧，今晚的晚饭我来买单。

senses.example_en: He ignored the warning signs and paid for his carelessness with an injury.
senses.example_zh: 他忽视了警告标志，因粗心大意而付出了受伤的代价。

senses.example_en: The insurance company had to pay out millions after the flood.
senses.example_zh: 洪水过后，保险公司不得不赔付数百万美元。

senses.example_en: The sailors paid out the cable slowly into the deep water.
senses.example_zh: 水手们将缆绳慢慢放入深水中。

senses.meaning: 付清全部欠款；（尤指勉强或被迫）交款
senses.example_en: After several legal warnings, the tenant finally paid up the overdue rent.
senses.example_zh: 经过几次法律警告后，租客终于结清了拖欠的房租。

senses.example_en: She went to the local branch to pay in a check she received yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 她去当地银行网点把昨天收到的一张支票存入账户。

senses.meaning: 向（基金、养老金或特定账户）定期存入/缴纳款项
senses.example_en: He pays ten percent of his monthly salary into a private pension scheme.
senses.example_zh: 他每月将工资的百分之十存入个人养老金计划中。

senses.meaning: 分期偿还，逐步减少（债务总额）
senses.example_en: The company used its excess cash to pay down its long-term debt.
senses.example_zh: 该公司利用富余资金来逐步削减其长期债务。

senses.example_en: They paid down ten thousand dollars on the new apartment.
senses.example_zh: 他们为这套新公寓当场付了一万美元的首付款。

senses.meaning: 为……承担一部分费用，贴补
senses.example_en: Her parents agreed to pay towards the cost of her college textbooks.
senses.example_zh: 她的父母同意帮她分担一部分大学课本的费用。

senses.meaning: 把（收到的款项）立即转付给他人
senses.example_en: Nearly half of the profits were paid away in taxes and commissions.
senses.example_zh: 近一半的利润立即被用于缴纳税款和支付佣金。

senses.example_en: Pay away more anchor rope so the ship won't drag.
senses.example_zh: 再放一些锚绳，以免船只走锚。

senses.meaning: 把（款项）正式转交/移交给官方或指定受益人
senses.example_en: The trustee was required to pay over the remaining funds to the heirs.
senses.example_zh: 受托人被要求将剩余资金正式移交给继承人。

senses.meaning: 自掏腰包支付；从（某笔专款/预算）中支出
senses.example_en: Employees will have to pay for parking out of their own pockets.
senses.example_zh: 员工必须自掏腰包支付停车费。

idioms.meaning: 花大价钱，被敲竹杠，付出过高的代价
idioms.example_en: They had to pay through the nose for last-minute flight tickets during peak season.
idioms.example_zh: 在旺季，他们不得不花大价钱购买临近起飞的机票。

idioms.meaning: 自食其果，承担（享乐或鲁莽行为的）后果
idioms.example_en: If you live beyond your means for years, you will eventually have to pay the piper.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你多年来一直入不敷出，最终必然要自食其果。

idioms.meaning: 口惠而实不至，做表面文章，虚应故事
idioms.example_en: The management paid lip service to workplace safety but cut the protective gear budget.
idioms.example_zh: 管理层口头上承诺重视职场安全，却削减了防护用具的预算。

idioms.meaning: 吃苦熬出头，历经磨砺获得认可或资格
idioms.example_en: She spent a decade working night shifts at local clinics, paying her dues before becoming chief surgeon.
idioms.example_zh: 她在地方诊所上了十年的夜班，历尽艰辛熬出头，才成为主任医师。

idioms.phrase: pay sb back in their own coin
idioms.meaning: 以其人之道还治其人之身
idioms.example_en: When he refused to share information, the rival team paid him back in his own coin.
idioms.example_zh: 当他拒绝共享信息时，对手团队以其人之道还治其人之身。

idioms.meaning: 作恶无好下场，违法犯罪终遭惩罚
idioms.example_en: The convicted fraudster learned the hard way that crime doesn't pay.
idioms.example_zh: 被定罪的诈骗犯尝到了苦头，明白了多行不义必自毙的道理。

collocations.example_en: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions demonstrated by the crew.
collocations.example_zh: 请仔细留意机组人员演示的安全须知。

collocations.phrase: pay a visit / pay a call
collocations.example_en: We decided to pay a visit to our former teacher while staying in town.
collocations.example_zh: 在城里停留期间，我们决定去探望一下当年的老师。

collocations.example_en: Thousands gathered at the square to pay tribute to the fallen heroes.
collocations.example_zh: 成千上万的人聚集在广场上，向牺牲的英雄们致敬。

collocations.meaning: 自食其力，自掏腰包（不欠人情/不依赖他人）
collocations.example_en: He worked part-time throughout college to pay his own way.
collocations.example_zh: 他在大学期间一直做兼职，自食其力完成学业。

collocations.meaning: 产生丰厚收益，带来长期回报
collocations.example_en: Investing in employee training always pays dividends in the long run.
collocations.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资员工培训总会带来丰厚的回报。

collocations.meaning: 支付溢价，支付额外费用
collocations.example_en: Consumers are willing to pay a premium for organic produce.
collocations.example_zh: 消费者愿意为有机农产品支付溢价。

senses.example_en: He walked into the office and asked for a glass of water.
senses.example_zh: 他走进办公室要了一杯水。

senses.example_en: Driving at such high speed on an icy road is just asking for trouble.
senses.example_zh: 在结冰的路面上开这么快纯粹是自找麻烦。

senses.example_en: He finally gathered the courage to ask her out for a movie.
senses.example_zh: 他终于鼓起勇气约她出去看电影。

senses.meaning: 四处打听，向周围人询问
senses.example_en: I'm looking for a good mechanic, so I'll ask around at work tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 我在找一个靠谱的汽修工，明天去上班时我四处打听打听。

senses.meaning: 问候，询问（某人的近况或身体状况）
senses.example_en: I bumped into your former teacher today, and she asked after you.
senses.example_zh: 我今天碰到了你以前的老师，她问起你的近况。

senses.example_en: Don't leave our guests standing on the porch—ask them in!
senses.example_zh: 别让客人站在门廊外，快请他们进屋！

senses.meaning: 邀请（某人）到自己家里做客
senses.example_en: We should ask the new neighbors over for dinner this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 我们这周末应该请新邻居来家里吃顿晚饭。

senses.meaning: 邀请（求职者）参加第二轮面试
senses.example_en: She was thrilled when the company asked her back for a second interview.
senses.example_zh: 得知公司通知她参加第二轮面试，她兴奋不已。

senses.example_en: They invited us to their party last month, so we must ask them back.
senses.example_zh: 他们上个月邀请我们参加了派对，所以我们一定要回请他们。

senses.example_en: Several potential buyers called to ask about the price of the house.
senses.example_zh: 几位潜在买家打电话来询问房子的售价。

senses.meaning: 邀请（某人）到乡间或楼下
senses.example_en: My uncle asked us down to his cottage in Devon for the holidays.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔邀请我们假期去他在德文郡的乡间小屋度假。

idioms.meaning: 依我看，在我看来（用于表达个人观点）
idioms.example_en: If you ask me, the whole marketing campaign is a waste of money.
idioms.example_zh: 依我看，整场营销活动纯粹是浪费钱。

idioms.meaning: 只要开口就能得到，唾手可得
idioms.example_en: There are plenty of grants available for young entrepreneurs, just for the asking.
idioms.example_zh: 有大量面向青年创业者的补助资金，只要提出申请就能拿到。

idioms.meaning: 别提了！一言难尽！（表示情况很糟糕或尴尬）
idioms.example_en: 'How was your journey back?' 'Don't ask! The flight was canceled twice.'
idioms.example_zh: “你返程顺利吗？”“别提了！航班取消了两次。”

idioms.meaning: 自讨苦吃，自作自受，活该
idioms.example_en: Walking down unlit alleys late at night holding expensive gadgets is just asking for it.
idioms.example_zh: 大半夜拿着贵重数码产品在黑黢黢的巷子里晃荡，简直是自讨苦吃。

idioms.meaning: 异想天开，提出过高或不可能的要求
idioms.example_en: Expecting a zero-error rate in such a complex prototype is asking for the moon.
idioms.example_zh: 指望如此复杂的样机达到零差错率，简直是异想天开。

idioms.phrase: ask no questions and hear no lies
idioms.meaning: 少打听就少听假话（劝人莫管闲事）
idioms.example_en: Where did I find the cash? Ask no questions and you'll hear no lies.
idioms.example_zh: 这钱我是从哪儿弄来的？少问少听假话，别多管闲事。

collocations.example_en: I hate to impose, but could I ask a favor of you regarding tomorrow's shift?
collocations.example_zh: 我真不想麻烦你，但能不能请你帮个忙替一下明天的班？

collocations.example_en: You must ask permission from the property owner before filming on site.
collocations.example_zh: 在此地拍摄前，你必须先征求业主的许可。

collocations.example_en: She consulted her mentor to ask advice on career transitions.
collocations.example_zh: 她向导师请教关于职业转型的建议。

collocations.example_en: The seller is refusing to budge below the original asking price of $400,000.
collocations.example_zh: 卖家拒绝在原先40万美元的挂牌要价上做出任何让步。

collocations.example_en: The junior officer asked leave to visit his ailing father.
collocations.example_zh: 这位初级军官请假去探望生病的父亲。

collocations.example_en: Journalists gathered outside the hall to ask tough questions about the subsidy cuts.
collocations.example_zh: 记者们聚集在大厅外，就削减补贴一事提出了尖锐的质问。

senses.example_en: So far, we haven't encountered any major technical issues with the new system.
senses.example_zh: 到目前为止，我们还没有在新系统上遇到任何重大技术问题。

senses.meaning: 到某种程度，有限度地（常与 go 连用）
senses.example_en: Personal savings can only go so far when facing long-term unemployment.
senses.example_zh: 面对长期失业，个人积蓄的作用终究是有限的。

senses.meaning: 就……而言，据……（常引出观点或判断）
senses.example_en: As far as I'm concerned, the proposal still needs a lot of work.
senses.example_zh: 就我而言，这项提案还需要做很多完善工作。

senses.meaning: 远至，一直到（指物理距离）
senses.example_en: We walked as far as the edge of the lake before stopping to rest.
senses.example_zh: 我们一直走到湖边才停下来休息。

senses.example_en: The reform went as far as completely restructuring the executive board.
senses.example_zh: 这次改革甚至达到了彻底重组执行董事会的程度。

senses.example_en: The final outcome of the negotiation is far from satisfactory.
senses.example_zh: 谈判的最终结果远非令人满意。

senses.example_en: The remote cabin is far from the nearest town, surrounded by silence.
senses.example_zh: 这座偏僻的小木屋远离最近的城镇，周围一片寂静。

senses.meaning: ……得多，大大，最（修饰比较级或最高级）
senses.example_en: This is by far the most challenging project the team has ever undertaken.
senses.example_zh: 这无疑是该团队迄今为止承担过的最具挑战性的项目。

senses.meaning: 无疑，大大，远远（强调差距极大，常修饰最高级）
senses.example_en: She is far and away the most qualified candidate for the leadership role.
senses.example_zh: 她无疑是这一领导职位最合适的人选。

senses.meaning: 前卫的，怪异奇特的，非正统的
senses.example_en: His theories on parallel universes sounded completely far out to mainstream scientists.
senses.example_zh: 他对平行宇宙的理论在主流科学家听来显得极其荒诞怪异。

senses.example_en: You got front-row tickets to the concert? That's far out!
senses.example_zh: 你搞到了演唱会第一排的票？太赞了吧！

senses.example_en: Tourists travel from far and wide to witness the spectacular sunrise over the canyon.
senses.example_zh: 游客们从四面八方赶来，只为一睹峡谷上空壮丽的日出。

phrasal_verbs.phrase: insofar as / in so far as

senses.example_en: The experiment was successful insofar as it proved the initial hypothesis.
senses.example_zh: 就证实了最初的假设而言，这项实验是成功的。

idioms.meaning: 与……大相径庭；与……相差甚远
idioms.example_en: The lavish hotel was a far cry from the cramped cabin they stayed in last summer.
idioms.example_zh: 这家奢华的酒店与他们去年夏天住的狭小木屋相去甚远。

idioms.meaning: 稀少；罕见；不常发生
idioms.example_en: Affordable housing options in the city centre are becoming few and far between.
idioms.example_zh: 市中心经济实惠的住房选择正变得越来越少。

idioms.meaning: 做得过火；做得太过分
idioms.example_en: Constructive criticism is fine, but personal insults really go too far.
idioms.example_zh: 提出建设性意见没问题，但人身攻击就实在太过分了。

idioms.phrase: far be it from me to do sth
idioms.meaning: 绝非我想（委婉表达批评、异议或干涉）
idioms.example_en: Far be it from me to tell you how to run your team, but morale seems low.
idioms.example_zh: 我绝无意对你的团队管理指手画脚，但现在团队士气似乎很低落。

idioms.meaning: 看某人能走多远；看某种尝试能取得多大进展（常带怀疑口吻）
idioms.example_en: He refused our assistance, so let's see how far he gets on his own.
idioms.example_zh: 他拒绝了我们的帮助，那就看看他凭自己能撑多久吧。

idioms.meaning: 在有限范围内尚可；就其本身而言还行（暗示不够全面或彻底）
idioms.example_en: His analysis is accurate as far as it goes, but it ignores the underlying economic factors.
idioms.example_zh: 就其本身而言他的分析是准确的，但忽略了深层的经济因素。

collocations.meaning: 与……相隔甚远；与……毫无关联
collocations.example_en: Academic theories are often far removed from everyday classroom reality.
collocations.example_zh: 学术理论往往与日常课堂的实际情况相差甚远。

collocations.example_en: The tech firm remains far ahead of its competitors in chip innovation.
collocations.example_zh: 该科技公司在芯片创新方面依然遥遥领先于竞争对手。

collocations.example_en: Without digital infrastructure, rural schools will fall far behind urban ones.
collocations.example_zh: 如果没有数字化基础设施，乡村学校将远远落后于城市学校。

collocations.meaning: 远道；远离家乡；远离本题
collocations.example_en: Researchers had to travel far afield to find undamaged rainforest ecosystems.
collocations.example_zh: 研究人员不得不远涉他乡，寻找未遭破坏的雨林生态系统。

collocations.meaning: 大得多 / 糟糕得多 / 好得多（程度副词搭配）
collocations.example_en: The environmental consequences turned out to be far greater than predicted.
collocations.example_zh: 事实证明，对环境造成的后果远比预期的严重得多。

collocations.example_en: Their initial quarterly revenue estimates were far off the mark.
collocations.example_zh: 他们最初对季度营收的估算大错特错。

senses.meaning: （人或物）遭遇……，落得……结果（常用于以 what 开头的疑问句）
senses.example_en: Whatever became of that brilliant young pianist we met in Vienna?
senses.example_zh: 我们在维也纳见到的那个才华横溢的年轻钢琴家后来怎么样了？

idioms.meaning: 成为第二本能；成为习惯；习以为常
idioms.example_en: After months of rigorous drill, safety protocols have become second nature to the crew.
idioms.example_zh: 经过数月的严格操练，安全规范已成为机组人员的下意识本能。

idioms.meaning: 成为历史；被淘汰；不复存在
idioms.example_en: Traditional incandescent light bulbs have virtually become history in many markets.
idioms.example_zh: 传统的白炽灯泡在许多市场上几乎已经成为历史。

idioms.phrase: become a shadow of one's former self
idioms.meaning: 风光不再；大不如前；憔悴不堪
idioms.example_en: Following the chronic illness, the legendary athlete became a shadow of his former self.
idioms.example_zh: 长期患病之后，这位传奇运动员的风采已大不如前。

idioms.meaning: 某人/某事将来会怎么样；命运将如何
idioms.example_en: If the factory closes down, what will become of the local workers and their families?
idioms.example_zh: 如果工厂倒闭，当地的工人和他们的家庭该何去何从？

idioms.meaning: 成年；达到法定年龄；（事物）达到成熟期
idioms.example_en: The young prince took control of the estate once he became of age.
idioms.example_zh: 年轻的王子一旦成年，便接管了这处庄园。

collocations.example_en: Consumers have become acutely aware of data privacy issues in recent years.
collocations.example_zh: 近年来，消费者已经敏锐地意识到了数据隐私问题。

collocations.example_en: It took the exchange students several weeks to become accustomed to the local diet.
collocations.example_zh: 交换生们花了几个星期才习惯当地的饮食。

collocations.meaning: 变得明朗；水落石出；显而易见
collocations.example_en: It soon became clear that the contract negotiations were heading toward a breakdown.
collocations.example_zh: 形势很快明朗起来，合同谈判正走向破裂。

collocations.example_en: With the launch of commercial space flights, orbital tourism has finally become a reality.
collocations.example_zh: 随着商业太空飞行的启动，轨道旅游终于成为了现实。

collocations.example_en: She decided to become involved in local politics to improve community schooling.
collocations.example_zh: 她决定投身地方政治，以改善社区学校教育。

collocations.meaning: 显现出来；变得显而易见
collocations.example_en: The design flaws became apparent as soon as the prototype entered the stress testing phase.
collocations.example_zh: 原型机一旦进入压力测试阶段，设计缺陷就立刻显现出来了。

collocations.example_en: Without urgent habitat protection, dozens of rare amphibian species will become extinct.
collocations.example_zh: 如果不紧急保护栖息地，数十种珍稀两栖动物将会灭绝。

collocations.example_en: Rapid advances in software may cause standard hardware devices to become obsolete faster.
collocations.example_zh: 软件技术的飞速进步可能会使标准硬件设备更快地被淘汰。

senses.meaning: 把……归入；将……算作（成员或一类）
senses.example_en: He numbers several prominent artists among his closest personal friends.
senses.example_zh: 他把几位杰出的艺术家算作自己最亲密的私交好友。

senses.meaning: 总数达到；以（成百上千等数量级）计
senses.example_en: The crowd gathered in the main square numbered in the tens of thousands.
senses.example_zh: 聚集在主广场上的人群数以万计。

senses.example_en: The drill sergeant ordered the squad to fall in and number off from right to left.
senses.example_zh: 训练军士命令全班集合，并从右至左依次报数。

senses.example_en: The archivist spent the morning numbering up all the newly cataloged manuscripts.
senses.example_zh: 档案管理员花了一上午的时间给所有新编目的手稿依次编号。

senses.example_en: Literary critics frequently number her debut novel with the finest works of the decade.
senses.example_zh: 文学评论家们经常将她的处女作与近十年最优秀的作品并列相提。

senses.example_en: She is proud to be numbered among the pioneers of modern renewable energy research.
senses.example_zh: 她为能够跻身现代可再生能源研究的先驱之列而深感自豪。

senses.meaning: 按编号逐一核对；依序清点
senses.example_en: The warehouse staff numbered down the crates on the manifest before signing the delivery form.
senses.example_zh: 仓库人员在货运单上按编号逐一核对了板条箱，随后才签署了交货确认书。

senses.example_en: The teacher numbered out the examination booklets carefully before distributing them to the class.
senses.example_zh: 老师在将考卷分发给全班之前，仔细地按份数清点核准。

idioms.meaning: 屈指可数；时日无多；气数已尽
idioms.example_en: With profits plummeting, the CEO's days at the company are numbered.
idioms.example_zh: 随着利润暴跌，这位首席执行官在该公司的日子屈指可数了。

idioms.meaning: 狠狠伤害/打击某人；严重损坏某物；欺骗愚弄
idioms.example_en: That flu really did a number on me; I was in bed for a whole week.
idioms.example_zh: 那场流感可把我折腾惨了，我整整卧床了一周。

idioms.meaning: 看穿某人的底细；摸透某人的把戏
idioms.example_en: He tried to charm his way out of trouble, but the boss already had his number.
idioms.example_zh: 他试图靠献殷勤脱困，但老板早就看穿了他的底细。

idioms.meaning: 机械死板地；照章办事；按步就班地
idioms.example_en: The film follows the genre conventions strictly by the numbers without any surprises.
idioms.example_zh: 这部电影完全是按部就班地套用类型片套路，没有任何惊喜。

idioms.meaning: 某人气数已尽；死期已到；大祸临头
idioms.example_en: When the engine caught fire at 30,000 feet, the pilot thought his number was up.
idioms.example_zh: 当引擎在三万英尺高空起火时，飞行员以为自己的死期到了。

idioms.meaning: 人多势众；人多更安全
idioms.example_en: Hikers are advised to travel in groups because there is safety in numbers.
idioms.example_zh: 建议徒步旅行者结伴同行，因为人多更安全。

idioms.meaning: 数字游戏（只注重冷冰冰的统计量而忽略质量或实质）
idioms.example_en: Modern recruitment has become a ruthless numbers game dominated by algorithms.
idioms.example_zh: 现代招聘已沦为一场由算法主导的残酷数字游戏。

idioms.meaning: 许多；大量的
idioms.example_en: There could be any number of reasons why she didn't reply to your email.
idioms.example_zh: 她没回复你的邮件可能会有许多种原因。

collocations.example_en: Casualties from the earthquake are feared to number in the thousands.
collocations.example_zh: 据恐，地震中的伤亡人数已达数千人。

collocations.example_en: She has faced hardships without number throughout her career.
collocations.example_zh: 在她的职业生涯中，她经历了无数的艰难困苦。

collocations.example_en: The endangered birds are steadily dwindling in number due to habitat loss.
collocations.example_zh: 由于栖息地丧失，这种濒危鸟类的数量正不断缩减。

collocations.example_en: The exhibits must be numbered consecutively for the auction catalog.
collocations.example_zh: 拍卖图录中的展品必须按顺序连续编号。

collocations.example_en: Subscribers to the online platform continue to grow in number each month.
collocations.example_zh: 该在线平台的用户订阅数量每月都在持续增长。

collocations.example_en: A vast number of complaints were lodged after the train service collapsed.
collocations.example_zh: 列车服务瘫痪后，收到了大量的投诉。

senses.meaning: 自作主张；随自己的便；自行其是
senses.example_en: You don't have to follow our travel plan; you can just please yourself this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 你不需要跟着我们的旅行计划走，这个周末你完全可以随自己的便。

senses.example_en: The client was thoroughly pleased with the final design submitted by the architect.
senses.example_zh: 客户对建筑师提交的最终设计方案感到非常满意。

senses.meaning: 很乐意做某事；荣幸地做某事
senses.example_en: The committee is pleased to welcome all international delegates to the conference.
senses.example_zh: 组委会非常荣幸地欢迎各位国际代表出席本次会议。

senses.example_en: She was deeply pleased by the overwhelmingly positive reception her speech received.
senses.example_zh: 她的演讲获得了极其热烈的反响，这让她感到格外欣喜。

senses.meaning: 致力于让客户满意；尽力讨人喜欢
senses.example_en: The staff at this boutique hotel clearly aim to please every single guest.
senses.example_zh: 这家精品酒店的员工显然致力于让每一位入住的客人都感到称心如意。

senses.example_en: As a new intern, he strove to please his supervisors by working late into the evening.
senses.example_zh: 作为新来的实习生，他每晚加班到很晚，竭力取悦主管们。

senses.example_en: Despite its enormous budget, the film sequel completely failed to please both critics and fans.
senses.example_zh: 尽管耗资巨大，这部电影续集却未能让影评人和粉丝满意。

senses.example_en: Politicians who constantly seek to please everyone often end up satisfying no one.
senses.example_zh: 那些总想面面讨好各方利益的政客，往往最终谁也满足不了。

idioms.meaning: 非常高兴；心满意足；得意扬扬
idioms.example_en: When she heard she won the scholarship, she was as pleased as Punch.
idioms.example_zh: 当听说自己赢得了奖学金时，她高兴得合不拢嘴。

idioms.meaning: 随你的便；极其/非常（如 calm as you please）
idioms.example_en: He walked right past the security guards, cool as you please.
idioms.example_zh: 他从保安身边大摇大摆地走了过去，显得极其淡定。

idioms.meaning: 难以取悦；挑剔苛刻
idioms.example_en: The food critic is notoriously hard to please, but she loved the soup.
idioms.example_zh: 这位美食评论家出了名的难以取悦，但她却非常喜欢这道汤。

idioms.meaning: 请问；请听我说；竟然（用于表示惊讶、愤慨或嘲讽）
idioms.example_en: They charged us fifty dollars for parking, if you please!
idioms.example_zh: 他们竟然收了我们五十美元的停车费，真不可思议！

idioms.meaning: 但愿；老天保佑
idioms.example_en: Please God, may the surgery go smoothly and the biopsy come back clear.
idioms.example_zh: 老天保佑，但愿手术一切顺利且活检结果正常。

idioms.meaning: 赏心悦目；养眼
idioms.example_en: The minimalist interior design is functional and pleases the eye.
idioms.example_zh: 极简主义的室内设计兼具实用性与赏心悦目的美感。

idioms.meaning: 容易满足；随和不挑剔
idioms.example_en: Grandpa is very easy to please; a cup of tea and a good book make his day.
idioms.example_zh: 爷爷非常容易满足，一杯茶和一本好书就能让他开心一整天。

collocations.meaning: 急于讨好；渴望令人满意
collocations.example_en: As a newcomer to the firm, he was overly anxious to please his superiors.
collocations.example_zh: 作为公司的新人，他过分急于讨好自己的上司。

collocations.meaning: 随心所欲；想做什么就做什么
collocations.example_en: Now that she is retired, she can travel the world and do as she pleases.
collocations.example_zh: 现在她退休了，可以环游世界，随心所欲地生活。

collocations.meaning: 使某人极其高兴；深得某人欢心
collocations.example_en: The glowing reviews pleased the author immensely after months of anxiety.
collocations.example_zh: 经历数月的焦虑后，这些热烈的好评让作者感到无比欣慰。

collocations.meaning: 试图讨好每个人；面面俱到
collocations.example_en: You cannot lead effectively if you spend all your time trying to please everyone.
collocations.example_zh: 如果你把所有时间都花在试图讨好每个人上，你就无法进行有效的领导。

collocations.example_en: Working under an impossible to please supervisor burned out the entire marketing team.
collocations.example_zh: 在一名称得上无法讨好的主管手下工作，让整个营销团队心力交瘁。

collocations.example_en: Golden retrievers are famous for being friendly and eager to please.
collocations.example_zh: 金毛寻回犬以性格友善、乐于讨人欢心而闻名。

senses.meaning: 为……配备（设施、设备或人员）
senses.example_en: The newly built conference center is serviced with high-speed fiber-optic internet and modern audiovisual gear.
senses.example_zh: 新建的会议中心配备了高速光纤网络和现代化的视听设备。

senses.meaning: 用……向（某地或机构）提供补给或服务
senses.example_en: The military outpost is serviced with essential supplies by weekly helicopter flights.
senses.example_zh: 该军事哨所由每周一班的直升机提供必需物资补给。

senses.meaning: 将（设备维护或技术服务）外包给第三方
senses.example_en: To reduce operational overhead, the company decided to service out its printer fleet to a local vendor.
senses.example_zh: 为了削减运营开销，该公司决定将打印机机群的维护外包给一家本地供应商。

senses.meaning: 由（交通线路、公共网络或市政机构）覆盖并提供服务
senses.example_en: This residential neighborhood is well serviced by several bus routes and a light rail station.
senses.example_zh: 这个居民区有多条公交线路和轻轨站覆盖，交通非常便利。

senses.meaning: 由（指定机构或技术人员）进行检修与保养
senses.example_en: All company-owned vehicles must be serviced by certified mechanics every six months.
senses.example_zh: 所有公司车辆必须每半年由持证机械师检修一次。

senses.meaning: 为……送修或进行保养检修
senses.example_en: I need to take my car in to the dealership for its annual service.
senses.example_zh: 我需要把车开到经销店做年度保养。

senses.meaning: 为（债务、贷款）支付利息或偿付本息
senses.example_en: The firm generates sufficient operating cash flow to service its existing loans comfortably.
senses.example_zh: 该公司的经营性现金流充足，能够轻松偿还现有贷款的本息。

senses.meaning: 调入（人员或设备）投入服务或检修作业
senses.example_en: Additional engineers were serviced in from headquarters to help resolve the critical pipeline failure.
senses.example_zh: 总部紧急调派了多名工程师入场，协助解决严重的管道故障。

senses.meaning: 停机检修；逐级关闭设备进行全面维护
senses.example_en: The refinery operators had to service down the entire processing unit for emergency repairs.
senses.example_zh: 炼油厂操作员不得不停机检修整个加工装置以进行紧急抢修。

idioms.meaning: 对……口惠而实不至；空口说白话；敷衍应付
idioms.example_en: The management paid lip service to environmental protection while continuing to dump waste.
idioms.example_zh: 管理层口口声声说支持环保，实际上却在继续倾倒废物。

idioms.meaning: 临时征用；把……派上临时用场
idioms.example_en: When the bus broke down, local minivans were pressed into service to transport the passengers.
idioms.example_zh: 大巴抛锚后，当地的小型面包车被临时征用来转运乘客。

idioms.meaning: 对某人有用；能为某人效劳/提供帮助
idioms.example_en: Please let me know if I can be of any service to you during your stay.
idioms.example_zh: 在您逗留期间，如果我能为您提供任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

idioms.meaning: 随时听候某人吩咐；乐意为某人效劳
idioms.example_en: "I am entirely at your service, sir," the concierge replied with a courteous bow.
idioms.example_zh: “先生，我随时听候您的吩咐，”门房礼貌地鞠躬回答道。

idioms.meaning: 为某人提供服务；帮某人一个忙；效劳
idioms.example_en: He rendered a valuable service to the company by negotiating a critical truce with suppliers.
idioms.example_zh: 他通过与供应商达成关键和解，为公司立下了一大功劳。

idioms.meaning: （机器、车辆或工具）经久耐用、服役多年；参军服役
idioms.example_en: This old tractor has seen service on the farm for over four decades and still runs smoothly.
idioms.example_zh: 这台老拖拉机在农场服役了四十多年，运转依然顺畅。

collocations.meaning: 偿还债务/贷款的利息（或本息）
collocations.example_en: The developing nation is struggling to service its enormous foreign debt.
collocations.example_zh: 这个发展中国家正苦于偿还其巨额的外债利息。

collocations.meaning: 检修/保养汽车、车辆或引擎
collocations.example_en: You ought to have your car serviced regularly to prevent costly breakdowns.
collocations.example_zh: 你应当定期保养汽车，以防出现花费高昂的故障。

collocations.meaning: 服务/维护客户或业务账户
collocations.example_en: Our senior account executives are assigned to service high-net-worth clients.
collocations.example_zh: 我们的资深客户经理被指派专门维护高净值客户。

collocations.meaning: 向某个区域或市场提供营运路线、基础设施或商业服务
collocations.example_en: The low-cost airline plans to service several emerging secondary cities next year.
collocations.example_zh: 这家廉价航空公司计划明年开通多条飞往新兴二线城市的航线。

collocations.meaning: 满足……的需求；为……的需要服务
collocations.example_en: The revised curriculum is tailored to service the needs of an increasingly digital workforce.
collocations.example_zh: 修订后的课程专为满足日益数字化劳动力队伍的需求而设计。

collocations.meaning: 全面检修；定期维护保养
collocations.example_en: The elevator was fully serviced last month, so the sudden breakdown surprised everyone.
collocations.example_zh: 电梯上个月才做过全面检修，因此突然故障让大家十分惊讶。

senses.meaning: 陪伴并支持某人度过（困境、危机、疾病等）
senses.example_en: Her family rallied around her to support her through the arduous cancer treatments.
senses.example_zh: 家人团结在她身边，支持她度过了艰难的癌症治疗期。

senses.meaning: 在（某项行动、决策或职业追求）中支持某人
senses.example_en: His parents fully supported him in his decision to leave law and pursue culinary school.
senses.example_zh: 父母全力支持他放弃法律专业去读厨艺学校的决定。

senses.meaning: 用（资金、技术或物资等资源）资助或扶持
senses.example_en: The municipal government agreed to support the local startup with a substantial research grant.
senses.example_zh: 市政府同意向这家本地初创公司提供大额研发补助资金予以支持。

senses.meaning: 用（证据、数据或事实）佐证或支撑（观点）
senses.example_en: You need to support your central thesis with concrete empirical data.
senses.example_zh: 你需要用具体的实证数据来佐证你的核心论点。

senses.meaning: （用支架或木桩等）撑起，支护使之不倒
senses.example_en: The gardeners used bamboo stakes to support up the heavily laden tomato plants.
senses.example_zh: 园丁们用竹竿将结满果实的西红柿植株撑了起来。

senses.meaning: 在精神或体力上支撑（某人）不致崩溃
senses.example_en: Her deep religious faith helped support her up during months of intense grief.
senses.example_zh: 深厚坚定的信仰支撑着她度过了数月极度悲痛的日子。

senses.example_en: The massive glass dome is supported by eight curved steel pillars.
senses.example_zh: 巨大的玻璃穹顶由八根弯曲的钢柱支撑。

senses.meaning: 由……资助、赞助或维持生计
senses.example_en: The international cultural festival is largely supported by corporate sponsorships.
senses.example_zh: 该国际文化节主要由企业赞助维持。

senses.meaning: 由（证据、事实或权威意见）证实或支持
senses.example_en: The team's revolutionary theory is well supported by findings from subsequent clinical trials.
senses.example_zh: 该团队的革命性理论得到了后续临床试验结果的有力支持。

senses.meaning: （IT/运维）维持外部兼容支持；延伸技术兜底服务
senses.example_en: The software vendor agreed to support out the legacy API integration until all clients migrate to the new platform.
senses.example_zh: 该软件供应商同意继续维护旧版API集成，直到所有客户迁移至新平台。

idioms.meaning: 作为支持……的理由；为了声援/支援……
idioms.example_en: Thousands of demonstrators marched through the capital in support of electoral reform.
idioms.example_zh: 数以千计的示威者在首都游行，以声援选举制度改革。

idioms.meaning: 支持……；为（理论、观点）提供依据；增添可信度
idioms.example_en: Recent archaeological findings lend strong support to the theory of early human migration.
idioms.example_zh: 最新的考古发现为早期人类迁徙理论提供了强有力的支持。

idioms.meaning: 公开表态支持/拥护（某人或观点）
idioms.example_en: Several prominent economists have come out in support of the proposed tax cuts.
idioms.example_zh: 几位著名经济学家已公开表态支持这项减税提案。

idioms.meaning: 争取/赢得……的支持与协助
idioms.example_en: The charity aims to enlist the support of local businesses to build the community shelter.
idioms.example_zh: 该慈善机构旨在争取当地企业的支持来建立社区收容所。

idioms.meaning: 团结聚集起来声援/支持
idioms.example_en: Voters across the country rallied in support of the embattled prime minister.
idioms.example_zh: 全国选民团结一致，声援深陷政治困境的首相。

idioms.meaning: 承受……的重量；（引申）担负起……的沉重负担
idioms.example_en: The old stone bridge can no longer support the weight of heavy commercial trucks.
idioms.example_zh: 这座古老的石桥已无法再承受重型商业货车的重量。

collocations.example_en: He worked two jobs simultaneously to support his growing family.
collocations.example_zh: 他同时打两份工来抚养他人口日增的家庭。

collocations.meaning: 证实/支持假说、理论或主张
collocations.example_en: There is currently insufficient clinical data to support this controversial claim.
collocations.example_zh: 目前尚无充分的临床数据能够证实这一有争议的主张。

collocations.meaning: 支持/拥护（某个运动队、俱乐部）
collocations.example_en: He has supported Liverpool Football Club ever since he was a little boy.
collocations.example_zh: 从孩提时代起，他就一直是利物浦足球俱乐部的忠实球迷。

collocations.meaning: 支持/赞成提案、动议或政策
collocations.example_en: The majority of lawmakers voted to support the climate transition bill.
collocations.example_zh: 多数立法议员投票支持这项气候转型法案。

collocations.meaning: 极力/全力/全心全意支持
collocations.example_en: We wholeheartedly support the peace initiatives undertaken by the United Nations.
collocations.example_zh: 我们全心全意支持联合国采取的和平倡议。

collocations.meaning: 在经济上资助/在资金与精神上给予支持
collocations.example_en: The endowment fund was established to financially support underprivileged college students.
collocations.example_zh: 该留本基金的设立旨在资助家庭贫困的大学生。

senses.example_en: It took months of therapy before he finally began to open up about his childhood.
senses.example_zh: 经过几个月的心理治疗，他终于开始敞开心扉谈论自己的童年。

senses.example_en: Learning a new language can open up completely new career opportunities.
senses.example_zh: 学习一门新语言能带来崭新的职业机遇。

senses.example_en: The bakery opens up at six in the morning every day.
senses.example_zh: 这家面包店每天清晨六点开门营业。

senses.example_en: Once he hit the straight highway, he opened up and reached top speed.
senses.example_zh: 一驶上笔直的高速公路，他就开足马力飙到了极速。

senses.example_en: She opened out the map on the table to plan their route.
senses.example_zh: 她在桌上铺开地图来规划他们的路线。

senses.example_en: As we rounded the bend, the valley opened out before us.
senses.example_zh: 当我们绕过弯道时，山谷在眼前豁然开朗。

senses.example_en: He was shy at first, but after a few drinks he began to open out.
senses.example_zh: 他起初很拘谨，但喝了几杯酒后就活跃健谈起来了。

senses.example_en: French doors open onto a terrace with stunning sea views.
senses.example_zh: 法式双开门通向一个拥有绝美海景的露台。

senses.meaning: 连通到，直接进入（另一空间）
senses.example_en: The narrow hallway opens into a spacious, light-filled living room.
senses.example_zh: 狭窄的过道连通着一间宽敞明亮的起居室。

senses.example_en: The keynote speaker opened with an amusing anecdote about his early failures.
senses.example_zh: 主讲人以一段关于自己早期失败经历的趣事开场。

senses.example_en: Several small bedrooms opened off the main corridor.
senses.example_zh: 主走廊两侧连通着几间小卧室。

senses.meaning: 向…猛烈开火；对…发起激烈抨击
senses.example_en: The media opened up on the politician following the leaked documents.
senses.example_zh: 文件泄露后，各大媒体对这位政客发起了猛烈抨击。

senses.example_en: The folding partitions open back completely to create one huge hall.
senses.example_zh: 折叠隔板可以完全向后收折，从而形成一个宽敞的大厅。

idioms.meaning: 引起一连串麻烦；触碰棘手复杂的难题
idioms.example_en: Investigating that corruption rumor will open a huge can of worms for the board.
idioms.example_zh: 调查那起腐败传闻会给董事会惹来一大堆极难处理的麻烦。

idioms.meaning: 使某人大开眼界；使某人看清事实真相
idioms.example_en: Working in rural clinics really opened her eyes to the severe healthcare inequalities.
idioms.example_zh: 在乡村诊所工作的经历真正让她看清了医疗资源匮乏与不平等的现实。

idioms.meaning: 大开方便之门；引发无法遏制的连锁反应/泛滥之势
idioms.example_en: Approving this single exception could open the floodgates to hundreds of similar requests.
idioms.example_zh: 批准这一个特例可能会打开闸门，引来成百上千个类似的申请。

idioms.meaning: 保持开放的心态；不带成见
idioms.example_en: We should keep an open mind until we have examined all the available evidence.
idioms.example_zh: 在审查完所有现有证据之前，我们应该保持客观开放的态度。

idioms.meaning: 创造机会；铺平道路
idioms.example_en: Earning a degree from a prestigious university often opens doors in the financial sector.
idioms.example_zh: 从名牌大学获得学位通常能在金融行业为个人开启大量机遇之门。

idioms.meaning: 揭开旧伤疤；重提令人痛苦的往事
idioms.example_en: I didn't mean to open an old wound by bringing up her previous marriage.
idioms.example_zh: 我提起她上一段婚姻并不是存心想揭她的旧伤疤。

collocations.example_en: You need two forms of identification to open a bank account.
collocations.example_zh: 你需要两种身份证明文件才能开立银行账户。

collocations.example_en: The soldiers were ordered not to open fire unless directly threatened.
collocations.example_zh: 士兵们接到命令，除非受到直接威胁，否则不得开火。

collocations.example_en: Both nations agreed to open a constructive dialogue to de-escalate border tensions.
collocations.example_zh: 两国同意展开建设性对话，以缓解边境紧张局势。

collocations.example_en: The senator will open the debate on the proposed climate bill tomorrow morning.
collocations.example_zh: 参议员将于明早带头就拟议的气候法案展开辩论。

collocations.example_en: The auctioneer opened the bidding at five thousand dollars.
collocations.example_zh: 拍卖师以五千美元作为起拍价拉开了竞价序幕。

collocations.example_en: The dentist asked the patient to open wide so she could inspect the molar.
collocations.example_zh: 牙医让患者把嘴张大，以便检查臼齿。

senses.example_en: She decided to set up her own consulting firm after years in the corporate world.
senses.example_zh: 在企业界打拼多年后，她决定创立自己的咨询公司。

senses.example_en: I'll ask my assistant to set up a conference call for tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 我会让助手安排明天上午的电话会议。

senses.example_en: We arrived at the campsite before sunset and set up the tent.
senses.example_zh: 我们在日落前赶到了露营地并搭建好了帐篷。

senses.example_en: He claimed he was completely innocent and that someone had set him up.
senses.example_zh: 他坚称自己完全是无辜的，是有人设局陷害了他。

senses.example_en: They packed their bags and set off on an epic road trip across the country.
senses.example_zh: 他们收拾好行囊，踏上了横穿全国的壮丽公路之旅。

senses.example_en: Smoke from the burnt toast was enough to set off the fire alarm.
senses.example_zh: 烤糊吐司冒出的烟雾足以触发火灾警报。

senses.example_en: His controversial remark set off a heated debate among the delegates.
senses.example_zh: 他引发争议的言论在代表们中间激起了一场激烈的辩论。

senses.example_en: The dark velvet dress set off her porcelain skin beautifully.
senses.example_zh: 那身深色天鹅绒连衣裙把她如瓷般的肌肤衬托得格外动人。

senses.example_en: The explorers set out for the South Pole at the break of dawn.
senses.example_zh: 探险队员在破晓时分启程前往南极。

senses.meaning: 着手，打算（实现特定目标）
senses.example_en: She never set out to become famous; she just loved painting.
senses.example_zh: 她从未打算成名，她只是纯粹热爱画画。

senses.example_en: The contract clearly sets out the obligations of both parties.
senses.example_zh: 合同中清楚阐明了双方各自的义务。

senses.example_en: He set out all the tools neatly on the workbench before starting repairs.
senses.example_zh: 他在开始维修前把所有工具整齐地陈列在工作台上。

senses.example_en: As soon as she finished unpacking, she set about cleaning the kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 她一拆完行李，就立刻着手清理厨房。

senses.example_en: A gang of thugs set about him as he was walking home through the alley.
senses.example_zh: 他在穿过小巷回家时，遭到了一帮暴徒的殴打。

senses.meaning: （恶劣天气、疾病或消极状态）到来并持续，开始蔓延
senses.example_en: Winter has firmly set in, bringing weeks of freezing temperatures.
senses.example_zh: 寒冬已经真正降临，带来了持续数周的刺骨低温。

senses.example_en: The unexpected supply chain shortage set back production by three months.
senses.example_zh: 意料之外的供应链短缺使生产进度推迟了三个月。

senses.example_en: That luxury watch must have set him back thousands of dollars.
senses.example_zh: 那块名牌手表肯定花了他好几千美元。

senses.example_en: The villa is set back from the main road behind a thick line of trees.
senses.example_zh: 别墅坐落在远离主干道的一排浓密树林之后。

senses.example_en: Try to set aside twenty minutes every day for light exercise.
senses.example_zh: 尽量每天留出二十分钟来进行适度锻炼。

senses.meaning: 把…置于一旁，搁置（分歧、情绪等）
senses.example_en: They agreed to set aside their political differences to solve the crisis.
senses.example_zh: 他们同意暂时搁置政治分歧，携手化解这场危机。

senses.example_en: The appellate court set aside the original verdict due to new evidence.
senses.example_zh: 上诉法院鉴于新的证据撤销了原判。

senses.example_en: She sat at her desk to set down her thoughts in a personal journal.
senses.example_zh: 她坐在书桌前，在个人日记中写下自己的想法。

senses.example_en: Strict safety guidelines have been set down by the regulatory authority.
senses.example_zh: 监管部门已经制定了严格的安全准则。

senses.example_en: The bus driver kindly set the elderly passenger down near her door.
senses.example_zh: 公交司机好心地在那位年长乘客家门附近让她下了车。

senses.example_en: The document sets forth a clear strategy for renewable energy adoption.
senses.example_zh: 该文件阐明了一项采用可再生能源的明确战略。

senses.example_en: The fleet set forth on its voyage across the uncharted ocean.
senses.example_zh: 舰队启程远航，驶向未知的大洋深处。

senses.meaning: 使与众不同，使脱颖而出
senses.example_en: Her meticulous attention to detail sets her apart from other designers.
senses.example_zh: 她对细节的一丝不苟使她在众多设计师中脱颖而出。

senses.example_en: Two rooms were set apart for use as a makeshift clinic.
senses.example_zh: 腾出了两间屋子专门用作临时诊所。

senses.example_en: The disputed inheritance set brother against brother.
senses.example_zh: 有争议的遗产使得亲兄弟反目成仇。

senses.example_en: The potential gains must be set against the high operational risks.
senses.example_zh: 必须将潜在收益与高昂的运营风险进行权衡。

senses.meaning: 袭击，攻击；唆使（狗等）扑向
senses.example_en: The guard threatened to set his dogs on anyone who trespassed.
senses.example_zh: 保安威胁说要放狗扑向任何非法闯入的人。

senses.meaning: 全力以赴干起来，大干起来
senses.example_en: With so much work left, the whole team set to without wasting any time.
senses.example_zh: 剩下这么多工作，整个团队分秒必争地大干了起来。

senses.example_en: After exchanging harsh words, the two drivers set to in the middle of the street.
senses.example_zh: 在互飙难听话后，两名司机在马路中间大打出手。

senses.example_en: He sets by a small portion of his salary every month for a rainy day.
senses.example_zh: 他每个月都会从薪水中存下一小笔钱以备不时之需。

senses.example_en: Don't forget to set your clocks forward one hour for daylight saving time.
senses.example_zh: 别忘了为了夏令时将时钟拨快一小时。

senses.example_en: The minister set forward several proposals to reform the tax system.
senses.example_zh: 部长提出了几项改革税收制度的建议。

senses.example_en: A new project manager was set over the construction division.
senses.example_zh: 一名新项目经理被委任主管施工部门。

idioms.meaning: 澄清事实；纠正误解
idioms.example_en: The spokesperson called a press briefing to set the record straight regarding the allegations.
idioms.example_zh: 发言人召开了新闻发布会，以澄清针对这些指控的事实真相。

idioms.meaning: 把目光投向；立志追求/争取
idioms.example_en: Having dominated the national tournament, the swimmer has set her sights on Olympic gold.
idioms.example_zh: 在横扫全国锦标赛后，这位游泳选手已将目光锁定在奥运金牌上。

idioms.meaning: 板上钉钉；一成不变/不可更改
idioms.example_en: These schedule proposals are preliminary, so none of the dates are set in stone yet.
idioms.example_zh: 这些日程安排只是初步方案，因此日期都还没板上钉钉。

idioms.meaning: 定下基调；确立风气
idioms.example_en: The CEO's opening remarks set an optimistic tone for the entire annual summit.
idioms.example_zh: 首席执行官的开幕致辞为整场年度峰会定下了乐观积极的基调。

idioms.meaning: 一心想要；渴望得到
idioms.example_en: He had set his heart on studying architecture in Paris ever since childhood.
idioms.example_zh: 他从小就一心渴望去巴黎攻读建筑学。

idioms.meaning: 使某人感到放松/自在
idioms.example_en: The interviewer's friendly smile instantly set the nervous candidate at ease.
idioms.example_zh: 面试官友善的微笑让紧张的应聘者立刻放松了下来。

idioms.meaning: 取得惊人成就；引起轰动（常用于否定句）
idioms.example_en: His debut novel won praise, but it hardly set the world on fire commercially.
idioms.example_zh: 他的处女作小说获得了好评，但在商业上并未引起太大轰动。

collocations.example_en: Senior managers are expected to set an example of punctuality and accountability.
collocations.example_zh: 高级管理人员应当在守时和负责方面树立榜样。

collocations.example_en: The Supreme Court ruling is likely to set a legal precedent for future privacy cases.
collocations.example_zh: 最高法院的裁决很可能会为未来的隐私权案件开创司法先例。

collocations.example_en: The committee set a strict deadline of Friday at noon for submitting project bids.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会设定了严格的截止日期：周五中午前必须提交项目投标书。

collocations.example_en: Protesters set fire to piles of trash outside the embassy during the demonstration.
collocations.example_zh: 抗议者在游行示威期间点燃了使馆外的垃圾堆。

collocations.example_en: The athlete set a new world record in the 400-meter hurdles yesterday.
collocations.example_zh: 这位运动员昨天在400米栏比赛中创下了新的世界纪录。

collocations.example_en: New evidence presented by the defense persuaded the judge to set the prisoner free.
collocations.example_zh: 辩方出示的新证据促使法官当庭释放了该名囚犯。

collocations.example_en: Detectives set an elaborate trap to catch the counterfeiters red-handed.
collocations.example_zh: 便衣警探设下周密的圈套，企图将造假分子当场人赃并获。

senses.example_en: I really fucked up on that presentation yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 我昨天的演讲彻底搞砸了。

senses.example_en: He fell off his bike and completely fucked up his shoulder.
senses.example_zh: 他从自行车上摔下来，把肩膀伤得不轻。

senses.meaning: 使精神崩溃，在心理上造成严重伤害
senses.example_en: Growing up in that toxic household really fucked him up.
senses.example_zh: 在那个充满戾气的家庭中长大，给他的心灵造成了极大的创伤。

senses.meaning: 滚开，走开（极不礼貌的驱赶）
senses.example_en: Just fuck off and leave me alone!
senses.example_zh: 赶紧滚开，别来烦我！

senses.meaning: 游手好闲，消磨时间，翘班
senses.example_en: We spent the whole afternoon just fucking off in the park.
senses.example_zh: 我们整个下午都在公园里闲逛打发时间。

senses.example_en: Stop fucking around and finish your homework.
senses.example_zh: 别胡闹了，赶紧去把作业写完。

senses.example_en: She divorced him after she found out he was fucking around.
senses.example_zh: 发现他在外面鬼混乱搞后，她跟他离了婚。

senses.meaning: 瞎摆弄，乱动（机械或物品）
senses.example_en: Don't fuck around with the thermostat; it's set properly.
senses.example_zh: 别乱动恒温器，已经调好了。

senses.example_en: Don't fuck with him; he has a notoriously bad temper.
senses.example_zh: 别去招惹他，他的臭脾气是出了名的。

senses.example_en: Are you being serious, or are you just fucking with me?
senses.example_zh: 你是认真的，还是在故意耍我？

senses.example_en: Who told you to fuck with my computer settings?
senses.example_zh: 谁让你乱动我的电脑设置的？

senses.example_en: His business partner stole the funds and completely fucked him over.
senses.example_zh: 他的商业合伙人卷走了资金，狠狠地坑了他一把。

senses.meaning: 故意耍弄某人，出尔反尔，浪费某人时间
senses.example_en: Stop fucking me around and give me a straight answer.
senses.example_zh: 别再忽悠我了，给我个明确的答复。

senses.example_en: He fucked away his entire inheritance in less than two years.
senses.example_zh: 他不到两年就挥霍光了整笔遗产。

senses.meaning: 仓促且马虎地做完某事；胡乱混过去
senses.example_en: He didn't study at all and just tried to fuck through the exam.
senses.example_zh: 他根本没复习，就想着在考试里胡乱混过去。

idioms.meaning: 在乎，介意（常用于否定句或疑问句）
idioms.example_en: I honestly don't give a fuck what they think of me.
idioms.example_zh: 我真的一点都不在乎他们怎么看我。

idioms.meaning: 到底怎么回事；搞什么鬼（表达极度震惊或愤怒）
idioms.example_en: What the fuck is going on out there?
idioms.example_zh: 外头到底搞什么鬼？

idioms.meaning: 一无所有，屁都没有；毫无作用
idioms.example_en: I worked all day and got fuck all to show for it.
idioms.example_zh: 我辛苦干了一整天，结果什么都没拿到。

idioms.meaning: 闭上臭嘴；彻底闭嘴
idioms.example_en: Shut the fuck up and listen to what I'm saying.
idioms.example_zh: 闭上你的臭嘴，听我把话说完。

idioms.meaning: 去他的，算了（表示放弃、厌烦或听天由命）
idioms.example_en: Fuck it, let's just go home and forget about the party.
idioms.example_zh: 去他的，咱们直接回家吧，别管那个派对了。

idioms.meaning: 极其，非常（口语强化副词短语）
idioms.example_en: It's cold as fuck outside, so put on a warm coat.
idioms.example_zh: 外面冷得要命，穿件暖和的大衣吧。

collocations.phrase: scare the fuck out of sb
collocations.example_en: That sudden loud noise scared the fuck out of me.
collocations.example_zh: 那声巨响把我的魂都快吓飞了。

collocations.phrase: beat the fuck out of sb
collocations.example_en: They threatened to beat the fuck out of him if he talked.
collocations.example_zh: 他们威胁说如果他敢走漏风声，就打断他的腿。

collocations.phrase: annoy / bother the fuck out of sb
collocations.meaning: 把某人烦死；极度惹恼某人
collocations.example_en: His constant complaining annoys the fuck out of everyone.
collocations.example_zh: 他没完没了的抱怨快把所有人都烦死了。

collocations.example_en: A single mistake could fuck up the whole operation completely.
collocations.example_zh: 一个细小的疏忽就可能把整项行动彻底毁掉。

collocations.example_en: We were freezing the fuck out waiting for the delayed bus.
collocations.example_zh: 等那趟晚点的公交车时，我们快被冻成冰棍了。

senses.example_en: The cold wind made the hikers group together for warmth.
senses.example_zh: 寒风让徒步旅行者们聚拢在一起取暖。

senses.example_en: We can group these smaller expenses together under travel costs.
senses.example_zh: 我们可以把这些零碎开支统统归并到差旅费项下。

senses.example_en: The teacher told the students to group up in pairs for the assignment.
senses.example_zh: 老师让学生们两人一组组队完成这项作业。

senses.example_en: The children grouped around the storyteller, eager to hear the tale.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们围在讲故事的人身旁，急切地想听故事。

senses.example_en: The participants were grouped into three different age brackets.
senses.example_zh: 参与者被分成了三个不同的年龄段。

senses.example_en: In the catalog, all of these items are grouped under 'Office Supplies'.
senses.example_zh: 在商品目录中，所有这些物品都被归在“办公用品”一类。

senses.example_en: You can group the search results by date or relevance.
senses.example_zh: 你可以按照日期或相关度对搜索结果进行分组。

senses.meaning: 分批分开，分成若干小队分别行动
senses.example_en: The volunteers grouped off to search different sections of the forest.
senses.example_zh: 志愿者们分成几个小组，前往森林的不同区域进行搜寻。

senses.meaning: 与……归为一组；把……与……归并在一起
senses.example_en: In this demographic study, teenagers are grouped with young adults.
senses.example_zh: 在这项人口学研究中，青少年与青年人被归并为同一组。

idioms.meaning: 集体努力；团队合作成果
idioms.example_en: Winning this championship was truly a group effort.
idioms.example_zh: 赢得这次锦标赛确实是整个团队共同努力的结果。

idioms.meaning: 群体动力学；团队人际互动关系
idioms.example_en: The manager needs to understand the group dynamics before assigning roles.
idioms.example_zh: 经理在分派角色之前需要先摸清团队的人际互动情况。

idioms.meaning: 群体盲思（因屈从团队共识而缺乏独立判断）
idioms.example_en: The board's disastrous decision was a classic case of groupthink.
idioms.example_zh: 董事会灾难性的决定是典型的群体盲思产物。

idioms.meaning: 融入群体；成为圈内人
idioms.example_en: It took several months for the newcomer to really feel part of the group.
idioms.example_zh: 新来的人花了几个月的时间才真正感觉自己融入了这个集体。

idioms.meaning: 同龄人；年龄段群组
idioms.example_en: This educational program is tailored specifically for the 6-to-12 age group.
idioms.example_zh: 这个教育项目是专门为6至12岁年龄段儿童量身打造的。

collocations.example_en: The teacher asked the class to break into small groups for discussion.
collocations.example_zh: 老师让全班分成若干小组进行讨论。

collocations.example_en: Local residents formed a support group to help flood victims.
collocations.example_zh: 当地居民成立了一个互助小组来帮助洪灾灾民。

collocations.meaning: 按类别对某物进行归类
collocations.example_en: The librarian grouped the new books by subject category.
collocations.example_zh: 图书管理员按主题门类对新书进行了归类。

collocations.example_en: Adolescents are heavily influenced by the opinions of their peer group.
collocations.example_zh: 青少年深受其同辈群体观点的影响。

collocations.example_en: We conducted a focus group to gather customer feedback on the new prototype.
collocations.example_zh: 我们组织了一次焦点小组访谈，以收集客户对新原型的反馈。

collocations.example_en: Young urban professionals are the primary target group for this product.
collocations.example_zh: 年轻的都市白领是该产品的主要目标受众。

senses.meaning: 把（员工或官员）临时借调至，调派到
senses.example_en: She was seconded to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for six months.
senses.example_zh: 她被借调到外交部工作了六个月。

senses.meaning: 次于，仅次于（通常作形容词短语 second to none 等）
senses.example_en: His reputation as a surgeon is second to none.
senses.example_zh: 作为一名外科医生，他的声誉首屈一指。

senses.meaning: 临时调离，抽调（某人）至外地或外单位
senses.example_en: Several key engineers were seconded away to handle the crisis at the overseas plant.
senses.example_zh: 几位骨干工程师被临时抽调去处理海外工厂的危机。

senses.meaning: 借调进入（某项目组、部门或工作团队）
senses.example_en: He was seconded into the task force investigating corporate fraud.
senses.example_zh: 他被借调进了负责调查公司欺诈案的特别工作组。

senses.meaning: 外派，借调到外部机构任职
senses.example_en: The university regularly seconds staff out to regional businesses for technology transfer.
senses.example_zh: 该大学定期将员工借调到当地企业，以促进技术转化。

senses.meaning: （拳击或决斗中）担任助手，做副手
senses.example_en: The veteran trainer agreed to second him out during his title defence.
senses.example_zh: 这位经验丰富的教练同意在他的卫冕战中担任其场角助手。

senses.meaning: 在竞赛、拳击或决斗中充当助手/场角副手
senses.example_en: His brother seconded him in the national championships.
senses.example_zh: 他弟弟在全国锦标赛中担任他的场角副手。

senses.meaning: 协助将（人员）借调输入进（内部机构）
senses.example_en: The department managed to second in specialists from private consultancy firms.
senses.example_zh: 该部门设法从私营咨询公司借调引进了专家。

idioms.meaning: 首屈一指，不亚于任何人或物
idioms.example_en: The quality of their customer service is second to none in the industry.
idioms.example_zh: 他们的客户服务质量在业内首屈一指。

idioms.meaning: 转念一想；进一步考虑后
idioms.example_en: I was going to stay home, but on second thought, I think I'll join you.
idioms.example_zh: 我原本打算留在家里，但转念一想，我觉得还是跟你们一起去吧。

idioms.meaning: 屈居次席，充当副手；处于次要地位
idioms.example_en: He was tired of playing second fiddle to his more charismatic partner.
idioms.example_zh: 他厌倦了充当那个更有魅力的搭档的副手。

idioms.meaning: （对决定或计划）产生动摇、疑虑或后悔
idioms.example_en: She started having second thoughts about moving across the country alone.
idioms.example_zh: 她开始对自己独自一人搬到全国另一端产生疑虑。

idioms.meaning: 恢复精力，缓过劲来；重拾干劲
idioms.example_en: After a short break and a hot cup of coffee, the runners got a second wind.
idioms.example_zh: 短暂休息并喝了杯热咖啡后，选手们恢复了体力，重拾干劲。

idioms.meaning: 成为第二天性，习以为常的习惯
idioms.example_en: After decades behind the wheel, driving defensively has become second nature to him.
idioms.example_zh: 驾车数十年后，防御性驾驶对他来说已经成了第二天性。

idioms.meaning: 间接地；从旁人处传闻得知
idioms.example_en: I only heard the news at second hand, so take it with a grain of salt.
idioms.example_zh: 这消息我只是间接听来的，所以姑且听之，别全信。

collocations.example_en: I would like to second the motion to approve the proposed budget.
collocations.example_zh: 我愿附议批准拟定预算的动议。

collocations.example_en: The committee member stood up immediately to second her nomination for president.
collocations.example_zh: 委员会成员立即起立附议她担任总裁的提名。

collocations.meaning: 被临时借调/派往（某组织或部门）
collocations.example_en: Dr. Evans has been seconded to the World Health Organization for six months.
collocations.example_zh: 埃文斯博士已被借调到世界卫生组织工作六个月。

collocations.meaning: 赞同/支持某人的言论或观点
collocations.example_en: I heartily second your remarks regarding the need for better communication.
collocations.example_zh: 对于你提到需要加强沟通的看法，我由衷赞同。

collocations.example_en: Profits must never come before safety, but here they seem to come second to nothing.
collocations.example_zh: 利润绝不能凌驾于安全之上，但在这里安全似乎总要给利润让路。

collocations.meaning: 每隔一天/周（即每两天/两周一次）
collocations.example_en: The team holds progress check-in meetings every second week.
collocations.example_zh: 团队每隔一周举行一次项目进展审查会。

senses.meaning: 用拉索加固，拉紧牵索以固定（桅杆、帐篷或塔架）
senses.example_en: The workers guyed up the temporary antenna tower before the storm hit.
senses.example_zh: 工人们在暴风雨来临前用拉索加固了临时天线塔。

senses.meaning: 向外拉出牵索并固定，以保持平衡稳定
senses.example_en: Make sure to guy out the marquee ropes evenly so the tent doesn't lean.
senses.example_zh: 确保把大帐篷的牵索向外均匀拉紧固定，以免帐篷倾斜。

senses.meaning: 用地锚或拉索向下牵拉牢固固定
senses.example_en: They had to guy down the tall scaffolding securely to the ground.
senses.example_zh: 他们不得不把高高的脚手架用拉索牢牢固定在地面上。

senses.meaning: 胡闹，开玩笑，打闹嬉戏（口语非正式）
senses.example_en: Stop guying around and finish your homework before dinner.
senses.example_zh: 别闹了，晚饭前把作业写完。

senses.meaning: 拿某人取笑，捉弄/打趣某人
senses.example_en: His colleagues guyed him about his sudden obsession with modern art.
senses.example_zh: 同事们拿他突然迷上现代艺术这件事来打趣他。

idioms.meaning: 自作聪明的人；自命不凡者；（美俚）黑帮分子
idioms.example_en: Don't get smart with me, you wise guy, or you'll be sent to the principal's office.
idioms.example_zh: 别跟我耍小聪明，你这个自作聪明的家伙，否则就把你送到校长办公室去。

idioms.meaning: 替罪羊；顶黑锅的人
idioms.example_en: The junior manager realized he was being set up as the fall guy for the company's financial fraud.
idioms.example_zh: 那位初级经理意识到自己正被当成公司财务欺诈案的替罪羊。

idioms.meaning: 随和亲切的普通人；老好人
idioms.example_en: Despite his immense wealth and celebrity status, he behaves like a regular guy.
idioms.example_zh: 尽管坐拥巨额财富与明星声望，他待人接物却像个随和朴素的普通人。

idioms.meaning: 硬汉；作风强硬不容招惹的人
idioms.example_en: He acts like a tough guy on the outside, but deep down he has a gentle heart.
idioms.example_zh: 他表面上装作一副硬汉模样，但内心深处其实非常温柔。

idioms.phrase: the good guys and the bad guys
idioms.meaning: 正派与反派；好人与恶徒
idioms.example_en: Real-world international politics is rarely a simple battle between good guys and bad guys.
idioms.example_zh: 现实世界中的国际政治极少能被简单地归纳为好人与坏人之间的决斗。

idioms.meaning: 平民百姓；处于弱势的小人物/小公司
idioms.example_en: The proposed tax reforms are designed to ease the economic burden on the little guy.
idioms.example_zh: 这项拟议中的税制改革旨在减轻普通底层老百姓的经济负担。

collocations.meaning: 充当替罪羊，出面背黑锅
collocations.example_en: He refused to play the fall guy for the blunders committed by his superiors.
collocations.example_zh: 他拒绝为上司犯下的愚蠢错误去充当替罪羊。

collocations.meaning: 为人正直靠谱、讲义气值得信赖的人
collocations.example_en: You can count on Mark to keep his word; he is a completely stand-up guy.
collocations.example_zh: 你可以完全信赖马克恪守诺言，他是个极其正直讲义气的人。

collocations.example_en: Inspect every guy wire thoroughly to ensure the radio antenna withstands high winds.
collocations.example_zh: 仔细检查每一根缆风绳，以确保无线电天线能够抵御强风。

collocations.meaning: 无情地嘲弄/戏谑某事或某人
collocations.example_en: The satirist guying the pompous political rhetoric had the entire audience in stitches.
collocations.example_zh: 那位讽刺作家无情地调侃浮夸的政治辞令，逗得全场观众哄堂大笑。

collocations.meaning: 你们（北美口语中广泛指代群体，不分男女）
collocations.example_en: What are you guys planning to order for dinner tonight?
collocations.example_zh: 你们大家今晚打算点什么当晚餐？

collocations.meaning: 好好先生；老实友善的人（有时带贬义，暗示缺乏魄力）
collocations.example_en: They say nice guys finish last, but his genuine integrity eventually won everyone over.
collocations.example_zh: 人常说‘老好人往往吃亏’，但他真诚的为人最终赢得了所有人的赞同。

senses.example_en: Let's meet up for coffee sometime next week.
senses.example_zh: 下周找个时间我们碰头喝杯咖啡吧。

senses.meaning: 遭遇，遭到，蒙受（反对、批评、挫折等）
senses.example_en: The proposal met with fierce opposition from local residents.
senses.example_zh: 这项提议遭到了当地居民的强烈反对。

senses.example_en: The foreign minister will meet with his counterpart tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 外交部长将于明天与对方同行举行正式会晤。

senses.example_en: I'm going to meet up with some old classmates after work.
senses.example_zh: 下班后我要和几个老同学碰个头。

senses.example_en: On my travels, I met up with a group of backpackers from Japan.
senses.example_zh: 在旅行途中，我偶遇了一群来自日本的背包客。

senses.meaning: （到车站、机场等）接（下车/下飞机的）人
senses.example_en: Could you meet me off the train at five o'clock?
senses.example_zh: 你能在五点钟去火车站接我下车吗？

senses.example_en: The committee members meet together once a month to review progress.
senses.example_zh: 委员会成员每月聚拢一次，审议工作进展。

senses.meaning: 返回原处碰头，重新集合
senses.example_en: Everyone explore on your own, and let's meet back here at noon.
senses.example_zh: 大家各自自由活动，中午再回到这里集合。

idioms.meaning: 收支相抵；维持生计
idioms.example_en: With rising living costs, many young families struggle to make ends meet.
idioms.example_zh: 随着生活成本攀升，许多年轻家庭难以维持收支平衡。

idioms.meaning: 迁就某人；各让半步；达成妥协
idioms.example_en: If you are willing to lower the price slightly, we can meet you halfway on the delivery date.
idioms.example_zh: 如果你方愿意稍作降价，我们可以在交货日期上做出让步。

idioms.phrase: more (to sth) than meets the eye
idioms.meaning: 别有内情；表面之下另有玄机；并不像看上去那么简单
idioms.example_en: Don't dismiss his strange behavior; there is definitely more to this than meets the eye.
idioms.example_zh: 别对他的反常举动不以为意，这事情肯定远没有表面那么简单。

idioms.meaning: 棋逢对手；遇上劲敌
idioms.example_en: The reigning champion finally met his match in yesterday's intense final.
idioms.example_zh: 卫冕冠军在昨天的激烈决赛中终于遇到了旗鼓相当的劲敌。

idioms.meaning: 惨遭覆灭；遭到毁灭性打击
idioms.example_en: The tech startup met its Waterloo when a major competitor launched a free alternative.
idioms.example_zh: 当一家巨头竞争对手推出同类免费产品时，这家科技初创公司遭遇了滑铁卢。

idioms.meaning: 去世；归西；见上帝
idioms.example_en: The old sailor felt his time had come to meet his maker.
idioms.example_zh: 老水手感到自己大限已到，该去见上帝了。

collocations.meaning: 赶上截止日期；按期完成
collocations.example_en: The team worked around the clock to meet the strict project deadline.
collocations.example_zh: 团队日夜连轴转以赶上项目紧迫的截止日期。

collocations.example_en: Applicants must meet all the academic criteria before being considered for an interview.
collocations.example_zh: 申请者必须先符合所有学术标准，才会进入面试考量。

collocations.meaning: 达到某人的期望；满足预期
collocations.example_en: The final cut of the film failed to meet the critics' high expectations.
collocations.example_zh: 这部电影的最终公映版未能达到影评人们的高期望。

collocations.example_en: The healthcare system has shown remarkable resilience in meeting the challenge.
collocations.example_zh: 该医疗体系在应对这一挑战时展现出了非凡的韧性。

collocations.meaning: 直视某人的双眼；与某人目光相接
collocations.example_en: She was too ashamed to meet her father's eyes after confessing the truth.
collocations.example_zh: 坦白真相之后，她羞愧得不敢直视父亲的双眼。

collocations.example_en: The scholarship is designed to help gifted students meet the cost of tuition.
collocations.example_zh: 该奖学金旨在帮助有天赋的学生承担学费开支。

senses.meaning: 逐步建立，创立（事业、财富等）
senses.example_en: She spent twenty years building up a successful cosmetics business.
senses.example_zh: 她花了二十年时间白手起家建立起一家成功的化妆品企业。

senses.meaning: 增强，加强（体质、信心、声誉等）
senses.example_en: Regular exercise will help build up your immune system.
senses.example_zh: 规律锻炼有助于增强你的免疫系统。

senses.meaning: 逐渐聚集，积聚（压力、交通、情绪等）
senses.example_en: Traffic begins to build up on the highway around 5 PM.
senses.example_zh: 下午五点左右，高速公路上的车流开始积聚拥堵。

senses.example_en: The movie was built up so much by the media that it ended up disappointing audiences.
senses.example_zh: 这部电影被媒体吹得神乎其神，结果反而让观众大失所望。

senses.meaning: 以……为基础，在……基础上进一步发展
senses.example_en: We must build on the success of our previous campaign.
senses.example_zh: 我们必须在上一轮活动取得的成功基础上继续推进。

senses.meaning: 将……嵌入；把……作为固定组成部分纳入
senses.example_en: The kitchen has several built-in cupboards that save a lot of space.
senses.example_zh: 厨房里装了几个嵌入式橱柜，节省了大量空间。

senses.meaning: 把……构建进……；使（条款、特质等）成为……的固有部分
senses.example_en: Flexibility needs to be built into the project timeline.
senses.example_zh: 必须在项目时间表中留出一定的灵活性。

senses.meaning: 扩建，扩展（基础设施、功能模块或业务网络）
senses.example_en: The telecom company is spending billions to build out its 5G network.
senses.example_zh: 该电信公司正斥资数十亿美元扩展其5G网络。

senses.meaning: 围绕……构建；以……为核心组织
senses.example_en: The team's entire offensive strategy is built around their star quarterback.
senses.example_zh: 该球队的整套进攻战术都是围绕他们的明星四分卫量身打造的。

senses.meaning: 朝……方向积蓄努力；为……逐步推进
senses.example_en: Everything the athletes do is building towards the upcoming championship.
senses.example_zh: 运动员们所做的一切都在为即将到来的锦标赛做积淀。

senses.meaning: 在……之上建造；（建筑）覆盖遮挡
senses.example_en: Much of the old Roman settlement was built over during the Middle Ages.
senses.example_zh: 中世纪时期，古罗马定居点的大部分遗址上面都建起了新的建筑。

idioms.meaning: 架设桥梁；消除分歧，建立友好沟通关系
idioms.example_en: The diplomat worked tirelessly to build bridges between the two hostile nations.
idioms.example_zh: 那位外交官不知疲倦地工作，以在敌对的两国之间架起沟通的桥梁。

idioms.meaning: 建造空中楼阁；做白日梦；耽于幻想
idioms.example_en: Stop building castles in the air and start putting your ideas into practical action.
idioms.example_zh: 别再构筑空中楼阁了，赶紧把想法付诸实际行动吧。

idioms.meaning: 从头开始搭建；从零做起；白手起家
idioms.example_en: They had to build the software infrastructure from the ground up after the server crash.
idioms.example_zh: 在服务器彻底崩溃后，他们不得不从零开始重新构建软件底层架构。

idioms.meaning: 收集论据；为支持或反对……建立充分论据或证据链
idioms.example_en: Detectives spent months quietly building a solid case against the fraud ring.
idioms.example_zh: 侦探们耗费数月时间，悄悄搜集证据，构建了针对该诈骗团伙的完整指控链。

idioms.meaning: 把希望寄托在……上
idioms.example_en: You shouldn't build all your hopes on getting that specific promotion.
idioms.example_zh: 你不应该把所有希望都寄托在获得那次特定的晋升上。

idioms.meaning: 推陈出新；发明/制造更胜一筹的革新产品
